local local_class = newclass("BossHarvesterRaidBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	self.request = {
		change_phase2 = 1
	}

	self.state = {
		rest = 1,
		action = 2,
		fly_bounce = 3,
		fly_laser = 4
	}

	self.battle_action_key = {
		double_slash = 1,
		bounce_ball = 2,
		wave = 3,
		laser = 4,
		liquid_shooting = 5
	}

	self.phase = {
		phase1 = 1,
		phase2 = 2
	}

	self.is_phase2_only = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "IsPhase2Only", false)
	self.rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RestTime", 0.8)
	self.phase2_hp = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Phase2HPPercentage", 60)
	self.fly_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FlyHeight", 6)
	self.fly_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FlyDistance", 5)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1)

	self.follow_duration = 3.0
	self.shock_wave_effect_scale = 1.5
	self.shock_wave_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_Chapter6_Sapa_GroundHit")

	self.sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	self.sfx_info.sfxName = "02_harvester_idle_01"
	self.sfx_info.loop = true
	self.sfx_info.parent = self.character
	self.sfx_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Loop
	self.sfx_info.playerPriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Boss
end

function local_class:init_battle_action_map()
	-- 좌우베기
	local double_slash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossHarvesterDoubleSlash")
	-- 바운스 볼
	local bounce_ball_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossHarvesterBounceBallRaid")
	-- 스플릿 슬래시
	local wave_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossCommonWave:RaidHarvesterFury")
	-- 레이저 광역공격
	local laser_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossHarvesterLaserBounceBall:RaidHarvesterFury")

	if not self.is_phase2_only then
		-- 액체발사
		local liquid_shooting = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossHarvesterLiquidShooting")
		self.battle_action_map[self.battle_action_key.liquid_shooting] = liquid_shooting
	else
		local liquid_shooting = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossHarvesterLiquidShooting:NewRaid")
		self.battle_action_map[self.battle_action_key.liquid_shooting] = liquid_shooting
	end


	self.battle_action_map[self.battle_action_key.double_slash] = double_slash_action
	self.battle_action_map[self.battle_action_key.wave] = wave_action
	self.battle_action_map[self.battle_action_key.bounce_ball] = bounce_ball_action
	self.battle_action_map[self.battle_action_key.laser] = laser_action

end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_key()
	self.battle_action_index = self.battle_action_index + 1

	if self.battle_action_index == 0 then
		self:change_target()
		return self.battle_action_key.laser
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 1 then
		self:change_target()
		return self.battle_action_key.bounce_ball
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 2 then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		return self.battle_action_key.liquid_shooting
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 3 then
		self:change_target()
		return self.battle_action_key.double_slash
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 4 then
		self:change_target()
		return self.battle_action_key.wave
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 5 then
		self:change_target()
		self.battle_action_index = self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 and 0 or -1
		return self.battle_action_key.bounce_ball
	end
end

-- 시즌 3 개선 배틀 ai
-- 좌우베기 - 바운스볼 - 스플릿 - 액체발사 - 레이저
function local_class:pick_battle_action_key_without_phase()
	self.battle_action_index = self.battle_action_index + 1
	-- 다섯번째까지 돌고 다시 0부터
	self.battle_action_index = self.battle_action_index % 5

	if self.battle_action_index == 0 then
		self:change_target()
		return self.battle_action_key.double_slash
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 1 then
		self:change_target()
		return self.battle_action_key.bounce_ball
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 2 then
		self:change_target()
		return self.battle_action_key.wave
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 3 then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		return self.battle_action_key.liquid_shooting
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 4 then
		self:change_target()
		return self.battle_action_key.laser
	end
end

function local_class:handle_request()
	if self.current_request == self.request.change_phase2 then
		if self.current_phase ~= self.phase.phase2 then
			self:change_phase(self.phase.phase2)
		end
	end
	self.current_request = nil
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:get_support_target()
	-- return IFieldObject
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if self.battle_zone_bound == nil then
		self.battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 실제 캐릭터 위치 Bound
	self.destination_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.battle_zone_bound.center,
			unity_class.vector3(self.battle_zone_bound.size.x - self.character.Bounds.size.x,
					self.battle_zone_bound.size.y - self.character.Bounds.size.y,
					self.battle_zone_bound.size.z - self.character.Bounds.size.z))

	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.follow_time = 0

	self.shadow_transform = self.character.Transform:Find("shadow")
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.current_state = self.state.rest
	self.battle_action_map = {}
	self:init_battle_action_map()

	self.battle_action_map[self.battle_action_key.liquid_shooting].MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.battle_zone_bound)

	if CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.params_dict, "ForceReturn", true) and
			lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterCharacterController) then
		self.character.FieldObjectController.ForceReturnFlag = true
	end

	local current_hp_percentage = self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP / self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 100
	if current_hp_percentage <= self.phase2_hp then
		self.battle_action_index = -1
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
	else
		self.battle_action_index = 0
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase1
	end

	-- 페이즈 구분 없는 경우 동작
	if self.is_phase2_only then
		self.battle_action_index = -1
	end
	-- 스테이트 변경
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Instance)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_local_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.current_running_action = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fly_bounce then
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero

		self.shadow_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		self.flying_audio_source_holder:FadeOut()

		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		message_system:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.AnalogueAirbourneEndEvent.Instance)

		self.character:RemoveAnimation()

		self.hit_calculator:End()
		self.hit_calculator = nil
		self.destination = nil
		self.xz_move_direction = nil
		self.fly_speed = nil
		self.move_duration = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fly_laser then
		local pos = self.character.Position
		pos.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(pos):GetHeightAt(pos)
		self.character.Position = pos

		self.shadow_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		self.flying_audio_source_holder:FadeOut()

		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		message_system:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.AnalogueAirbourneEndEvent.Instance)

		self.character:RemoveAnimation()

		self.hit_calculator:End()
		self.hit_calculator = nil
		self.destination = nil
		self.xz_move_direction = nil
		self.fly_speed = nil
		self.move_duration = nil
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.rest then
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.current_running_action = self.battle_action_map[self.current_battle_action_key]
		CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.current_running_action)
	elseif next_state == self.state.fly_bounce then
		self.destination = user_party_leader.Position

		-- destination이 갈 수 없는 위치면 수정
		local destination_change = { x = self.destination.x, z = self.destination.z }
		if self.destination_bound.min.x > self.destination.x then
			destination_change.x = self.destination_bound.min.x
		elseif self.destination_bound.max.x < self.destination.x then
			destination_change.x = self.destination_bound.max.x
		end
		if self.destination_bound.min.z > self.destination.z then
			destination_change.z = self.destination_bound.min.z
		elseif self.destination_bound.max.z < self.destination.z then
			destination_change.z = self.destination_bound.max.z
		end
		self.destination = unity_class.vector3(destination_change.x, self.destination.y, destination_change.z)

		local fly_dist = math.min(self.fly_distance, (user_party_leader.Position - self.character.Position):GetX0z().magnitude)
		self.xz_move_direction = (self.destination - self.character.Position):GetX0z().normalized

		local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
				self.character.Bounds,
				CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, self.xz_move_direction * fly_dist
		)
		if closest_object ~= nil then
			local distance = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(self.character.Bounds, closest_object.Bounds, self.xz_move_direction)
			fly_dist = distance
		end

		self.destination = self.character.Position + self.xz_move_direction * fly_dist

		local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.xz_move_direction)
		self.character.Direction = look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None and self.character.Direction or look_dir

		local hit_spec = CS.Oak.SphereCollisionInfo()
		hit_spec.Center = self.destination
		hit_spec.DamageTerm = -1
		hit_spec.Duration = 30
		hit_spec.Radius = self.character.Bounds.extents.x
		self.hit_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, hit_spec)
		self.hit_calculator:Start()

		if self.flying_audio_source_holder == nil or not self.flying_audio_source_holder.IsUsing then
			self.flying_audio_source_holder = music_player:PlaySfx(self.sfx_info)
		end

		local speed_modifier = 3.5
		self.fly_speed = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.WalkSpeed * speed_modifier
		self.move_duration = math.max(0.2, fly_dist / self.fly_speed)

		self.character:SetAnimation(CS.Oak.AnimationRequest("walk", CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))

		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		message_system:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.AnalogueAirbourneStartEvent.Instance)
	elseif next_state == self.state.fly_laser then
		self.destination = self.battle_zone_bound.center
		local real_dist = (self.destination - self.character.Position):GetX0z().magnitude
		self.xz_move_direction = (self.destination - self.character.Position):GetX0z().normalized

		local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.xz_move_direction)
		self.character.Direction = look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None and self.character.Direction or look_dir

		local hit_spec = CS.Oak.SphereCollisionInfo()
		hit_spec.Center = self.destination
		hit_spec.DamageTerm = -1
		hit_spec.Duration = 30
		hit_spec.Radius = self.character.Bounds.extents.x
		self.hit_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, hit_spec)
		self.hit_calculator:Start()

		if self.flying_audio_source_holder == nil or not self.flying_audio_source_holder.IsUsing then
			self.flying_audio_source_holder = music_player:PlaySfx(self.sfx_info)
		end

		local speed_modifier = 3.5
		self.fly_speed = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.WalkSpeed * speed_modifier
		self.move_duration = real_dist / self.fly_speed

		self.character:SetAnimation(CS.Oak.AnimationRequest("walk", CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))

		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		message_system:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.AnalogueAirbourneStartEvent.Instance)
	else
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

	self.battle_zone_bound = nil
	self.destination_bound = nil

	self.shadow_transform = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.follow_time = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_index = nil


	self.battle_action_map = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.current_phase = nil
	self.current_request = nil
	self.current_battle_action_key = nil
end

function local_class:change_phase(phase)
	if self.is_phase2_only then
		return
	end

	if phase == self.phase.phase2 then
		if self.current_battle_action_key == self.battle_action_key.wave or self.wait_flag then
			self.current_battle_action_key = nil
			self.wait_flag = true
			return
		end

		local param = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleGenerateParam.Convert(
				self.character.transform, CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleNew.BubbleType.Shout,
				CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString("harvester_change_phase_shout"))

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.character.gameObject, CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleManager.Instance:ShowSpeechBubbleAsync(param))

		self.battle_action_index = -1
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2

		if CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
			self.current_battle_action_key = self.battle_action_key.laser
			self.battle_action_index = 0
			self:change_local_state(self.state.fly_laser)
		end
	else
		self.battle_action_index = 0
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase1
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	-- 단일 페이즈만 사용하는 경우 해당 이벤트 받지 않음.
	if self.is_phase2_only then
		return false
	end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 or self.current_request ~= nil then
		return false
	end

	local current_hp_percentage = e.Info.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100
	if current_hp_percentage > self.phase2_hp then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.current_request = self.request.change_phase2
	else
		self:change_phase(self.phase.phase2)
	end

	return false
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.wait_flag then
		if self.time_passed > 1.0 then
			self.wait_flag = false
			self:change_phase(self.phase.phase2)
			self.time_passed = 0
		end
		return
	end

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState)) then
		self.follow_time = self.follow_time + dt
		if self.follow_time >= self.follow_duration or
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.battle_action_map[self.battle_action_key.double_slash], self.target) then
			self.follow_time = 0
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Instance)
			self:change_local_state(self.state.action)
		end
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then
		if self.time_passed >= self.rest_time then
			if self.target ~= nil and CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then

				if not self.is_phase2_only then
					self.current_battle_action_key = self:pick_battle_action_key()
				else
					self.current_battle_action_key = self:pick_battle_action_key_without_phase()
				end

				if self.current_battle_action_key == self.battle_action_key.laser then
					self:change_local_state(self.state.fly_laser)
				elseif self.current_battle_action_key == self.battle_action_key.bounce_ball then
					self:change_local_state(self.state.fly_bounce)
				elseif self.current_battle_action_key == self.battle_action_key.double_slash then
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.battle_action_map[self.battle_action_key.double_slash], self.target) then
						self:change_local_state(self.state.action)
					else
						self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
					end
				else
					self:change_local_state(self.state.action)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.current_running_action) then
			if self.current_request ~= nil then
				self:handle_request()
			else
				self:change_local_state(self.state.rest)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fly_bounce then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_duration then
			local shock_wave = self.shock_wave_effect_pool:Instantiate(self.destination:GetX0z(0.05))
			shock_wave.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.shock_wave_effect_scale

			local fo_list = self.hit_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				local target_dir = (fo.Position - self.character.Position):GetX0z().normalized
				if target_dir:IsAlmostZero() then target_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction) end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = 1
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = target_dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

				local new_pos = self.character.Position
				if math.abs(target_dir.z / target_dir.x) > math.abs(self.character.Bounds.extents.z / self.character.Bounds.extents.x) then
					local temp = self.character.Bounds.extents.z * target_dir.x / target_dir.z
					local diagonal = math.sqrt(self.character.Bounds.extents.z * self.character.Bounds.extents.z + temp * temp)
					new_pos = new_pos + target_dir * diagonal
				else
					local temp = target_dir.z / target_dir.x * self.character.Bounds.extents.x
					local diagonal = math.sqrt(self.character.Bounds.extents.x * self.character.Bounds.extents.x + temp * temp)
					new_pos = new_pos + target_dir * diagonal
				end
				local movement = new_pos - fo.Position
				local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
				move_info.direction = movement.normalized
				move_info.magnitude = movement.magnitude
				local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, fo.Direction, false)
				message_system:SendSync(fo, move_event)

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end

			-- 바운스 볼 발사
			self:change_local_state(self.state.action)
		else
			local move_amount = self.fly_speed * dt * self.xz_move_direction
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.move_duration)
			self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3(0, math.sin(math.pi * progress) * self.fly_height, 0)

			self.shadow_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - math.sin(math.pi * progress))

			local movement = move_amount
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = movement.normalized
			move_info.magnitude = movement.magnitude
			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fly_laser then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_duration then
			local shock_wave = self.shock_wave_effect_pool:Instantiate(self.destination:GetX0z(0.05))
			shock_wave.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.shock_wave_effect_scale

			local fo_list = self.hit_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				local target_dir = (fo.Position - self.character.Position):GetX0z().normalized
				if target_dir:IsAlmostZero() then target_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction) end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = 1
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = target_dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

				local new_pos = self.character.Position
				if math.abs(target_dir.z / target_dir.x) > math.abs(self.character.Bounds.extents.z / self.character.Bounds.extents.x) then
					local temp = self.character.Bounds.extents.z * target_dir.x / target_dir.z
					local diagonal = math.sqrt(self.character.Bounds.extents.z * self.character.Bounds.extents.z + temp * temp)
					new_pos = new_pos + target_dir * diagonal
				else
					local temp = target_dir.z / target_dir.x * self.character.Bounds.extents.x
					local diagonal = math.sqrt(self.character.Bounds.extents.x * self.character.Bounds.extents.x + temp * temp)
					new_pos = new_pos + target_dir * diagonal
				end
				local movement = new_pos - fo.Position
				local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
				move_info.direction = movement.normalized
				move_info.magnitude = movement.magnitude
				local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, fo.Direction, false)
				message_system:SendSync(fo, move_event)

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end

			-- Flying 에서는 무조건 레이저로 이행
			self:change_local_state(self.state.action)
		else
			local next_pos = self.character.Position
			next_pos = next_pos + self.fly_speed * dt * self.xz_move_direction
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.move_duration)
			next_pos.y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * self.fly_height

			self.shadow_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - math.sin(math.pi * progress))

			local movement = next_pos - self.character.Position
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = movement.normalized
			move_info.magnitude = movement.magnitude
			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
		end
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.shock_wave_effect_pool = nil
	self.sfx_info = nil

	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,

local local_class = newclass("BossHarvesterSingleRaidBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)

		fly_bounce = 3,

function local_class:handle_request()
	if self.current_request == self.request.change_phase2 then
		if self.current_phase ~= self.phase.phase2 then
			self:change_phase(self.phase.phase2)
		end
	end
	self.current_request = nil
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

	return self.target
end

function local_class:get_support_target()
	-- return IFieldObject
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if self.battle_zone_bound == nil then
		self.battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 실제 캐릭터 위치 Bound
	self.destination_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.battle_zone_bound.center,
			unity_class.vector3(self.battle_zone_bound.size.x - self.character.Bounds.size.x,
					self.battle_zone_bound.size.y - self.character.Bounds.size.y,
					self.battle_zone_bound.size.z - self.character.Bounds.size.z))

	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.follow_time = 0

	self.shadow_transform = self.character.Transform:Find("shadow")

	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.current_state = self.state.rest



	self.battle_action_map = {}
	self:init_battle_action_map()

	self.battle_action_map[self.battle_action_key.liquid_shooting].MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.battle_zone_bound)

	if CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.params_dict, "ForceReturn", true) and
			lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterCharacterController) then
		self.character.FieldObjectController.ForceReturnFlag = true
	end

	local current_hp_percentage = self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP / self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 100
	if current_hp_percentage <= self.phase2_hp then
		self.battle_action_index = -1
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
	else
		self.battle_action_index = 0
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase1
	end

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Instance)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_local_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.current_running_action = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fly_bounce then
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero

		self.shadow_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		self.flying_audio_source_holder:FadeOut()

		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		message_system:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.AnalogueAirbourneEndEvent.Instance)

		self.character:RemoveAnimation()

		self.hit_calculator:End()
		self.hit_calculator = nil
		self.destination = nil
		self.xz_move_direction = nil
		self.fly_speed = nil
		self.move_duration = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fly_laser then
		local pos = self.character.Position
		pos.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(pos):GetHeightAt(pos)
		self.character.Position = pos

		self.shadow_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		self.flying_audio_source_holder:FadeOut()

		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		message_system:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.AnalogueAirbourneEndEvent.Instance)

		self.character:RemoveAnimation()

		self.hit_calculator:End()
		self.hit_calculator = nil
		self.destination = nil
		self.xz_move_direction = nil
		self.fly_speed = nil
		self.move_duration = nil
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.rest then
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.current_running_action = self.battle_action_map[self.current_battle_action_key]
		CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.current_running_action)
	elseif next_state == self.state.fly_bounce then
		self.destination = user_party_leader.Position

		-- destination이 갈 수 없는 위치면 수정
		local destination_change = { x = self.destination.x, z = self.destination.z }
		if self.destination_bound.min.x > self.destination.x then
			destination_change.x = self.destination_bound.min.x
		elseif self.destination_bound.max.x < self.destination.x then
			destination_change.x = self.destination_bound.max.x
		end
		if self.destination_bound.min.z > self.destination.z then
			destination_change.z = self.destination_bound.min.z
		elseif self.destination_bound.max.z < self.destination.z then
			destination_change.z = self.destination_bound.max.z
		end
		self.destination = unity_class.vector3(destination_change.x, self.destination.y, destination_change.z)

		local fly_dist = math.min(self.fly_distance, (user_party_leader.Position - self.character.Position):GetX0z().magnitude)
		self.xz_move_direction = (self.destination - self.character.Position):GetX0z().normalized

		local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
				self.character.Bounds,
				CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, self.xz_move_direction * fly_dist
		)
		if closest_object ~= nil then
			local distance = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(self.character.Bounds, closest_object.Bounds, self.xz_move_direction)
			fly_dist = distance
		end

		self.destination = self.character.Position + self.xz_move_direction * fly_dist

		local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.xz_move_direction)
		self.character.Direction = look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None and self.character.Direction or look_dir

		local hit_spec = CS.Oak.SphereCollisionInfo()
		hit_spec.Center = self.destination
		hit_spec.DamageTerm = -1
		hit_spec.Duration = 30
		hit_spec.Radius = self.character.Bounds.extents.x

		local speed_modifier = 3.5
		self.fly_speed = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.WalkSpeed * speed_modifier
		self.move_duration = math.max(0.2, fly_dist / self.fly_speed)

		self.character:SetAnimation(CS.Oak.AnimationRequest("walk", CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))

		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		message_system:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.AnalogueAirbourneStartEvent.Instance)
	elseif next_state == self.state.fly_laser then

		self.xz_move_direction = (self.destination - self.character.Position):GetX0z().normalized

		local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.xz_move_direction)
		self.character.Direction = look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None and self.character.Direction or look_dir

		local hit_spec = CS.Oak.SphereCollisionInfo()
		hit_spec.Center = self.destination
		hit_spec.DamageTerm = -1
		hit_spec.Duration = 30
		hit_spec.Radius = self.character.Bounds.extents.x
		self.hit_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, hit_spec)
		self.hit_calculator:Start()

		if self.flying_audio_source_holder == nil or not self.flying_audio_source_holder.IsUsing then
			self.flying_audio_source_holder = music_player:PlaySfx(self.sfx_info)
		end

		local speed_modifier = 3.5
		self.fly_speed = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.WalkSpeed * speed_modifier
		self.move_duration = real_dist / self.fly_speed

		self.character:SetAnimation(CS.Oak.AnimationRequest("walk", CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))

		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		message_system:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.AnalogueAirbourneStartEvent.Instance)
	else
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

	self.battle_zone_bound = nil
	self.destination_bound = nil

	self.shadow_transform = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.follow_time = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_index = nil


	self.battle_action_map = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.current_phase = nil
	self.current_request = nil
	self.current_battle_action_key = nil
end

function local_class:change_phase(phase)
	if phase == self.phase.phase2 then
		if self.current_battle_action_key == self.battle_action_key.wave or self.wait_flag then
			self.current_battle_action_key = nil
			self.wait_flag = true
			return
		end

		local param = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleGenerateParam.Convert(
				self.character.transform, CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleNew.BubbleType.Shout,
				CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString("harvester_change_phase_shout"))

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.character.gameObject, CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleManager.Instance:ShowSpeechBubbleAsync(param))

		self.battle_action_index = -1
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2

		if CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
			self.current_battle_action_key = self.battle_action_key.laser
			self.battle_action_index = 0
			self:change_local_state(self.state.fly_laser)
		end
	else
		self.battle_action_index = 0
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase1
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 or self.current_request ~= nil then
		return false
	end

	local current_hp_percentage = e.Info.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100
	if current_hp_percentage > self.phase2_hp then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.current_request = self.request.change_phase2
	else
		self:change_phase(self.phase.phase2)
	end

	return false
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.wait_flag then
		if self.time_passed > 1.0 then
			self.wait_flag = false
			self:change_phase(self.phase.phase2)
			self.time_passed = 0
		end
		return
	end

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState)) then
		self.follow_time = self.follow_time + dt
		if self.follow_time >= self.follow_duration or
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.battle_action_map[self.battle_action_key.double_slash], self.target) then
			self.follow_time = 0
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Instance)
			self:change_local_state(self.state.action)
		end
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then
		if self.time_passed >= self.rest_time then
			if self.target ~= nil and CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
				self.current_battle_action_key = self:pick_battle_action_key()

				if self.current_battle_action_key == self.battle_action_key.laser then
					self:change_local_state(self.state.fly_laser)
				elseif self.current_battle_action_key == self.battle_action_key.bounce_ball then
					self:change_local_state(self.state.fly_bounce)
				elseif self.current_battle_action_key == self.battle_action_key.double_slash then
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.battle_action_map[self.battle_action_key.double_slash], self.target) then
						self:change_local_state(self.state.action)
					else
						self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
					end
				else
					self:change_local_state(self.state.action)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.current_running_action) then
			if self.current_request ~= nil then
				self:handle_request()
			else
				self:change_local_state(self.state.rest)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fly_bounce then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_duration then
			local shock_wave = self.shock_wave_effect_pool:Instantiate(self.destination:GetX0z(0.05))
			shock_wave.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.shock_wave_effect_scale

			local fo_list = self.hit_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				local target_dir = (fo.Position - self.character.Position):GetX0z().normalized
				if target_dir:IsAlmostZero() then target_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction) end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = 1
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = target_dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

				local new_pos = self.character.Position
				if math.abs(target_dir.z / target_dir.x) > math.abs(self.character.Bounds.extents.z / self.character.Bounds.extents.x) then
					local temp = self.character.Bounds.extents.z * target_dir.x / target_dir.z
					local diagonal = math.sqrt(self.character.Bounds.extents.z * self.character.Bounds.extents.z + temp * temp)
					new_pos = new_pos + target_dir * diagonal
				else
					local temp = target_dir.z / target_dir.x * self.character.Bounds.extents.x
					local diagonal = math.sqrt(self.character.Bounds.extents.x * self.character.Bounds.extents.x + temp * temp)
					new_pos = new_pos + target_dir * diagonal
				end
				local movement = new_pos - fo.Position
				local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
				move_info.direction = movement.normalized
				move_info.magnitude = movement.magnitude
				local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, fo.Direction, false)
				message_system:SendSync(fo, move_event)

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end

			-- 바운스 볼 발사
			self:change_local_state(self.state.action)
		else
			local move_amount = self.fly_speed * dt * self.xz_move_direction
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.move_duration)
			self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3(0, math.sin(math.pi * progress) * self.fly_height, 0)

			self.shadow_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - math.sin(math.pi * progress))

			local movement = move_amount
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = movement.normalized
			move_info.magnitude = movement.magnitude
			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fly_laser then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_duration then
			local shock_wave = self.shock_wave_effect_pool:Instantiate(self.destination:GetX0z(0.05))
			shock_wave.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.shock_wave_effect_scale

			local fo_list = self.hit_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				local target_dir = (fo.Position - self.character.Position):GetX0z().normalized
				if target_dir:IsAlmostZero() then target_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction) end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = 1
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = target_dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

				local new_pos = self.character.Position
				if math.abs(target_dir.z / target_dir.x) > math.abs(self.character.Bounds.extents.z / self.character.Bounds.extents.x) then
					local temp = self.character.Bounds.extents.z * target_dir.x / target_dir.z
					local diagonal = math.sqrt(self.character.Bounds.extents.z * self.character.Bounds.extents.z + temp * temp)
					new_pos = new_pos + target_dir * diagonal
				else
					local temp = target_dir.z / target_dir.x * self.character.Bounds.extents.x
					local diagonal = math.sqrt(self.character.Bounds.extents.x * self.character.Bounds.extents.x + temp * temp)
					new_pos = new_pos + target_dir * diagonal
				end
				local movement = new_pos - fo.Position
				local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
				move_info.direction = movement.normalized
				move_info.magnitude = movement.magnitude
				local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, fo.Direction, false)
				message_system:SendSync(fo, move_event)

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end

			-- Flying 에서는 무조건 레이저로 이행
			self:change_local_state(self.state.action)
		else
			local next_pos = self.character.Position
			next_pos = next_pos + self.fly_speed * dt * self.xz_move_direction
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.move_duration)
			next_pos.y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * self.fly_height

			self.shadow_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - math.sin(math.pi * progress))

			local movement = next_pos - self.character.Position
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = movement.normalized
			move_info.magnitude = movement.magnitude
			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
		end
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.shock_wave_effect_pool = nil

		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

local local_class = newclass("BossHelicopterBattleAIState")
--보스 헬리콥터 기본 스테이트
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	-- 기본 구현
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.battle_zone_bound = nil
	self.boss_android_mafia = nil

	-- AI 스펙 로드 * 이 시점에서 파싱하고 딕셔너리 굳이 들고 있지 않도록
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FollowTime', 7.0)
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'InitialRestTime', 4)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MinRestTime', 6.0)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxRestTime', 6.5)
	-- 패턴종료후 도망치기 시작해서 얼마동안 사라졌다 돌아오게 되는지
	self.max_retreat_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxRetreatTime', 7.0)
	self.tracking_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TrackingSpeed', 1.0)
	--[[  현재 테이블에 Vector3 List 받아오는 부분이 없어, Json 형식으로 받아오도록 함.
  		좌표값은 현재 배틀존의 center 값을 중심(0,0,0)으로 하는 상대값으로 들어가게 됨]]
	self.move_path_json = CS.Utils.GetJsonObjectFromDictionary(params, 'PatrolPath')
	self.move_path_right = CS.Utils.GetVector3ListFromDictionary(self.move_path_json, 'RightPath')
	self.move_path_left = CS.Utils.GetVector3ListFromDictionary(self.move_path_json, 'LeftPath')
	--[[ 헬기 스팅어 맞은 후 도망칠 포지션 키 = Direction, 값 = Vector3 값.
	    좌표값은 현재 전투가 일어나는 배틀존의 center 값을 중심(0,0,0)으로 하는 상대값으로 들어가게 됨 ]]
	self.retreat_joson = CS.Utils.GetJsonObjectFromDictionary(params, 'RetreatPosition')
	self.retreat_right = CS.Utils.GetVector3FromDictionary(self.retreat_joson, 'Right')
	self.retreat_left = CS.Utils.GetVector3FromDictionary(self.retreat_joson, 'Left')
	-- 퇴각 이동시 속도 조정가능하도록 추가.
	self.retreat_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RetreatSpeed', 1.0)
	-- 헬기 진입시 속도 조정 가능하도록
	self.assult_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AssultSpeed', 1.0)

	self.retreat_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.angle_y = 0
	self.angle_look_left = 0
	self.angle_look_up = 90
	self.angle_look_right = 180
	self.angle_look_down = 270

end

--방향에 따른 위치 변경
function local_class:select_direction()
-- C# Generic 간 할당시 reference 할당이 이루어지므로 값 복사를 위해 매번 리스트에서 값만 꺼내와서 큐에 넣음.
	self.select_path_queue:Clear()
	if self.retreat_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		self.look_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		self.angle_y = self.angle_look_left
		local convert_path = nil
		for i = 0, self.move_path_right.Count - 1 do
			convert_path = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertToZoneRelativeToWorldToLua(self.battle_zone_bound, self.move_path_right[i])
			self.select_path_queue:Enqueue(convert_path)
		end

	elseif self.retreat_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		self.look_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		self.angle_y = self.angle_look_right
		for i = 0, self.move_path_left.Count - 1 do
			convert_path = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertToZoneRelativeToWorldToLua(self.battle_zone_bound, self.move_path_left[i])
			self.select_path_queue:Enqueue(convert_path)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()

	if self.boss_android_mafia == nil then

	end

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.last_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.look_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	local convert_path = nil

	self.retreat_position_list:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Left, left)

		self:on_boss_stinger_step_event(e)
	end
	self.on_boss_helicopter_laser_call_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_boss_helicopter_laser_call_event(e)

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BossHelicopterLaserCallEvent), self.on_boss_helicopter_laser_call_event_func)

	sfx_info.maxDistance = 10

	sfx_info.playerPriority = CS.Oak.SfxPlayerPriorityExtensions.GetPlayerType(self.character)
	self.music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)

	-- 헬리콥터 상태 관련 세팅
	self.character.Position = right

	self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
	self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end
		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end
		self.target = new_target
	end
	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if self.battle_count >= 3 then
		self.battle_count = 0
	end

	if self.battle_count == 0 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.support_fire
	elseif self.battle_count == 1 then
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(0, 1)
		if rand == 0 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.laser_fire
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.single_fire
		end
	elseif self.battle_count == 2 and self.last_battle_action == self.laser_fire then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.single_fire
	elseif self.battle_count == 2 and self.last_battle_action == self.single_fire then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.laser_fire
	end

	self.battle_count = self.battle_count + 1
	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
end

function local_class:return_current_action_string()
	if self.picked_battle_action == self.support_fire then
		return 'support fire selected'
	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.single_fire then
		return 'single fire selected'
	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.laser_fire then
		return 'laser fire selected'
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	-- 이벤트 구독 해제
	if self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func)
		self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_boss_stinger_step_event_func then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BossStingerStepEvent), self.on_boss_stinger_step_event_func)
		self.on_boss_stinger_step_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_boss_helicopter_laser_call_event_func then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BossHelicopterLaserCallEvent), self.on_boss_helicopter_laser_call_event_func)
		self.on_boss_helicopter_laser_call_event_func = nil
	end

	self:change_state()
	self.battle_zone_bound = nil
	self.laser_fire = nil
	self.support_fire = nil
	self.single_fire = nil
	self.retreat_fire = nil
	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
	self.max_retreat_time = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.current_rest_time = nil

	self.laser_point = nil
	self.missile_point_1 = nil
	self.missile_point_2 = nil
end

function local_class:return_current_state_string ()
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIOnThePathFollowingSubState)) then
		return 'AIOnThePathFollowingSubState'
	elseif CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIEtherealMovePositionSubState)) then
		return 'AIEtherealMovePositionSubState'
	elseif CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIRetreatToOffScreenSubState)) then
		return 'AIRetreatToOffScreenSubState'
	elseif CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		return 'AIIdleSubState'
	else
		return 'No State Matched!!'
	end
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end
	--print('currentState:', self:return_current_state_string())
	-- 헬기가 특정 위치에서 호버링 하는 중..
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIOnThePathFollowingSubState)) then
		-- 픽된 액션이 없다면 movePath 위에서 캐릭터 쫒아서 지정 Path 위에서 타겟 방향으로 이동

		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		else --선택된 액션이 있어..
			if self.battle_action_triggered then--그리고 그게 끝났어..
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 OnThePathFollow로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					if self.battle_count == 3 then
					-- TODO: 차후 C# AIRetreatToOffScreenSubState 에서 Exit 될때 딕셔너리 날리지 않도록 할것.
						if self.retreat_position_list.Count == 0 then
							local right = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertToZoneRelativeToWorldToLua(self.battle_zone_bound, self.retreat_right)
							self.retreat_position_list:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Right, right)
							local left = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertToZoneRelativeToWorldToLua(self.battle_zone_bound, self.retreat_left)
							self.retreat_position_list:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Left, left)
						end
						self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIRetreatToOffScreenSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.retreat_position_list,
								self.retreat_direction, self.look_direction, self.retreat_speed, self.angle_y))
					else
						self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIOnThePathFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.select_path_queue,
								false, self.look_direction, true, self.tracking_speed, self.angle_y))
					end
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
				end
			end
		end
		--첫 시작 위치로 이동
	elseif CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIEtherealMovePositionSubState)) then
		if self.cs_state.CurrentState.Done then
			--이동 끝나면 본격적으로 시작함.
			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIOnThePathFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.select_path_queue, false,
						self.look_direction, true, self.tracking_speed, self.angle_y))
			end
		end
		--첫 등장 후 멈춰있다면
	elseif CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self:select_direction()
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIEtherealMovePositionSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.select_path_queue:Peek(), self.assult_speed, self.angle_y))
			else
				self:change_target()
			end
		end
	elseif CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIRetreatToOffScreenSubState)) then
		self.time_passed_retreat = self.time_passed_retreat + dt
		if self.time_passed_retreat >= self.max_retreat_time then
			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then--도망친 이후 방향 바꿔서 다시 진입처리
				self.time_passed_retreat = 0
				self.time_passed = 0

				if self.retreat_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
					self.retreat_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
				elseif self.retreat_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
					self.retreat_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
				end
				self:select_direction()


				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_boss_stinger_step_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_boss_helicopter_laser_call_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if e == nil then
		return false
	end

	if e.FieldObject == self.boss_android_mafia then
		self:die()
	end

	if e.FieldObject == self.target then

		self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:is_retreat()
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIRetreatToOffScreenSubState)) then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:get_direction()
 return self.select_direction()
end

function local_class:die()

	self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIRetreatToOffScreenSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.retreat_position_list,
			self.retreat_direction, self.look_direction, self.retreat_speed, self.angle_y))

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.All
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = self.character
	damage_info.modifier = 101
	damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.character)

	local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func)
		self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func = nil

	if self.on_boss_stinger_step_event_func then

		self.on_boss_stinger_step_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_boss_helicopter_laser_call_event_func then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BossHelicopterLaserCallEvent), self.on_boss_helicopter_laser_call_event_func)
		self.on_boss_helicopter_laser_call_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil

	self.laser_point = nil
	self.missile_point_1 = nil
	self.missile_point_2 = nil

	self.retreat_position_list = nil

end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)

	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("BossHyunckelBattleAIState")

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	-- 기본 구현
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	-- AI 스펙 로드
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 7.0)
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 3)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 1.0)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 1.5)
	self.dark_hand_teleport_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DarkHandTeleportDistance", 3)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
	end

	self.zone_bounds = battle_zone_bound

	-- 배틀 액션 데이터
	self.earth_slash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossHyunckelEarthSlash")
	self.wave_slash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossHyunckelWaveSlash")
	self.slash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "MinotaursSlash:Hyunckel")
	self.dark_hand_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossHyunckelDarkHand")
	self.bloody_scryde_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossHyunckelBloodyScryde")
	--zone 분할해서 teleport할 수 있도록 만들어 줘야됨
	self.teleport_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "CustomTeleport:Hyunckel")

	self.dark_hand_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)

	-- 이동가능한 지점 지정
	local center = self.zone_bounds.center
	local modX = self.zone_bounds.size.x / 4
	local modZ = self.zone_bounds.size.z / 4
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX, self.zone_bounds.size.y, modZ)

	self.sliced_zone_bounds = {}
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, -modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, -modZ), size))

	self.dark_hand_teleport_pos_list = {}
	table.insert(self.dark_hand_teleport_pos_list, self.zone_bounds.center + vector(0, 0, self.dark_hand_teleport_distance))
	table.insert(self.dark_hand_teleport_pos_list, self.zone_bounds.center + vector(self.dark_hand_teleport_distance, 0, 0))
	table.insert(self.dark_hand_teleport_pos_list, self.zone_bounds.center + vector(0, 0, -self.dark_hand_teleport_distance))
	table.insert(self.dark_hand_teleport_pos_list, self.zone_bounds.center + vector(-self.dark_hand_teleport_distance, 0, 0))

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0
	self.is_dark_hand_teleport = false

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:get_next_move_position()
	local pos = nil
	local target_dist = 0

	for _,v in pairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
		local dist = (v.center - self.target.Position).magnitude
		if math.abs(dist) > target_dist then
			target_dist = dist
			pos = v.center
		end
	end

	self.teleport_action.MetaTable:set_destination(pos)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false


	--test
	--self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	--self.picked_battle_action = self.dark_hand_action

	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 5

	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.earth_slash_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	elseif idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.wave_slash_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	elseif idx == 2 then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
		self.is_dark_hand_teleport = true
		self:get_dark_hand_pos()
		self.picked_battle_action = self.teleport_action
	elseif idx == 3 then
		local is_restriction, target = self.dark_hand_action.MetaTable:get_restriction_target()
		if is_restriction then
			self:get_next_move_position()
			self.picked_battle_action = self.teleport_action
			self.restriction_target = target
		else
			self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		end
	elseif idx == 4 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.bloody_scryde_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:get_dark_hand_pos()
	local pos = self.dark_hand_teleport_pos_list[1]
	local target_dist = (pos - self.target.Position).magnitude

	for _,v in pairs(self.dark_hand_teleport_pos_list) do
		local dist = (v - self.target.Position).magnitude
		if math.abs(dist) < target_dist then
			target_dist = dist
			pos = v
		end
	end

	self.teleport_action.MetaTable:set_destination(pos)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.earth_slash_action = nil
	self.wave_slash_action = nil
	self.slash_action = nil
	self.dark_hand_action = nil
	self.bloody_scryde_action = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.sliced_zone_bounds = nil
	self.dark_hand_teleport_pos_list = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					if self.picked_battle_action == self.teleport_action then
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						if self.is_dark_hand_teleport then
							self.picked_battle_action = self.dark_hand_action
							self.is_dark_hand_teleport = false
						else
							self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
						end

						self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
						--self.target = self.restriction_target
					else
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
						self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
					end
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
					end
				end

				if self.picked_battle_action ~= self.teleport_action then
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}
