local local_class = newclass("BossIceDragonBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	self.phase = {
		one = 1,
		two = 2,
	}
	self.current_phase = self.phase.one

	-- 페이즈 전환
	self.phase_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PhaseHpRatio', 0.75)

	-- 쉴드
	self.shield_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ShieldHpRatio', 0.5)
	self.shield_repeat_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ShieldRepeatHpRatio', 0.1)
	self.shield_max_count = math.ceil(self.shield_hp_ratio / self.shield_repeat_hp_ratio)
	self.shield_count = 0

	-- 빙하석(쉴드 있으면 쉴드 다 까고, 쉴드 없으면 보스 체력 n% 만큼 데미지)
	self.stone_gen_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'StoneGenAmount', 3)
	self.stone_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StoneRadius', 1.5)
	self.stone_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StoneDamageModifier', 0.01)
	self.fo_stone_list = { }

	-- 한 사이클에서 빙하발사 패턴 수에 따라 곱해줄 것
	for i = 1, self.stone_gen_amount * 2 do
		local stone_fo = get_field_object('icedragon_stone_' .. i)
		if stone_fo ~= nil then
			stone_fo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
			table.insert(self.fo_stone_list, stone_fo)
		end
	end

	self.fx_stone_explosion_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_obj_icedragon_stone_explosion')
	self.stone_pop_start_num = 0
	self.stone_pop_count = 0

	-- 스위칭 구슬
	self.bead_amount_large = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'BeadAmountLarge', 10)
	self.bead_amount_small = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'BeadAmountSmall', 2)
	self.bead_event_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'BeadEventId', 1001)

	-- etc
	self.current_rest_duration = 0
	self.rest_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RestDuration", 1.0)

	-- event sub
	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)

	self.on_party_switching_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_party_switching_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)

	self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = function(e)
		self:on_fieldobject_destroyed_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(self.character))
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	self:set_action_and_battle_zones()

	self.battle_action_count = 0
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.shield_count = 0

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.bead_zone = field:GetZone('bead')
	local zone_name = self.bead_zone ~= nil and 'bead' or battle_util.get_zone(self.character.Position).Name
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'init_expedition_bead_controller', zone_name }))

	local ui_dict = stage.FieldUIManager:GetUI(user_party)
	if ui_dict ~= nil and ui_dict:ContainsKey(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBarForBoss) then
		local top_hp_bar = ui_dict[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBarForBoss]
		if top_hp_bar ~= nil then
			top_hp_bar:TurnOnShieldVisibility()
		end
	end
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	self:update_shield(dt)

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_rest_duration > self.time_passed then
		return
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		return
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
			self.current_rest_duration = self.rest_duration
			self.time_passed = 0
		end
	else
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_shield(dt)
	local curr_ratio = character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character)
	if curr_ratio > self.shield_hp_ratio then
		return
	end

	if self.shield_count == 0 then
		self.battle_action_triggered = false
		self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentResetEvent.Instance)
		buff_util.cure_all_debuffs(self.character, self.character)
		self.picked_battle_action = self.shield_action
		self.time_passed = 0
		self.shield_count = self.shield_count + 1
	else
		local count = math.ceil(curr_ratio / self.shield_repeat_hp_ratio)
		local result = self.shield_count < self.shield_max_count - count + 1
		if result then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_icedragon_shield' }))
			self.shield_count = self.shield_count + 1
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_phase()
	if self.current_phase >= self.phase.two then
		return
	end

	if character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character) <= self.phase_hp_ratio then
		self:change_phase(self.phase.two)
	end
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self:update_phase()

	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
		self:pick_battle_action_phase_one()

	elseif self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
		self:pick_battle_action_phase_two()
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == self.breath_action then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_icedragon_remove_left_hand' }))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_icedragon_remove_right_hand' }))
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_phase_one()
	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 4
	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.punch_action

	elseif idx == 1 then
		self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true)
		self.picked_battle_action = self.strike_action

	elseif idx == 2 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.strike_action

	elseif idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.breath_action
	end

	self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_phase_two()
	if self.battle_action_count == -1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.phase_action
		self.battle_action_count = 0

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_icedragon_remove_left_hand' }))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_icedragon_remove_right_hand' }))
		return
	end

	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 6
	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.glacier_action
		self.stone_pop_start_num = 0

	elseif idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.scratch_action

	elseif idx == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.eruption_action

	elseif idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.glacier_action
		self.stone_pop_start_num = 3

	elseif idx == 4 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.scratch_action

	elseif idx == 5 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.breath_action
	end

	self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
end

function local_class:change_phase(phase)
	if self.current_phase == phase then
		return
	end

	self.current_phase = phase
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_icedragon_phase_change', self.current_phase}))

	if self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
		self.battle_action_count = -1
	end
end

function local_class:check_shield_ready()
	if self.shield_count <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	local curr_ratio = character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character)
	if curr_ratio > self.shield_hp_ratio then
		return false
	end

	local count = math.ceil(curr_ratio / self.shield_repeat_hp_ratio)
	local result = self.shield_count < self.shield_max_count - count + 1
	return result
end

function local_class:create_stone(pos)
	local idx = self.stone_pop_count % #self.fo_stone_list + 1
	local fo = self.fo_stone_list[idx]
	if fo ~= nil then
		fo.Position = pos
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('icedragon_stone_' .. idx, 0, false, self.fo_stone_list[idx])
	end

	self.stone_pop_count = self.stone_pop_count + 1
end

function local_class:remove_stone(index, bead_amount)
	local fo = self.fo_stone_list[index]
	local pos = nil
	if fo ~= nil then
		pos = fo.Position
		fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('icedragon_stone_' .. index)
	end

	if pos ~= nil then
		self:create_bead(pos, bead_amount)
		if self.fx_stone_explosion_pool ~= nil then
			self.fx_stone_explosion_pool:Instantiate(pos)
		end
	end
end

-- clear는 패턴에서 클리어 시킴
function local_class:clear_stone()
	local manual_character = user_party.Leader
	local leader_state = manual_character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local held = manual_character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		character_util.clear_holdup_state(user_party.Leader, held)
	end

	for i, _ in pairs(self.fo_stone_list) do
		self:remove_stone(i, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:create_bead(pos, amount)
	-- 위치, 생성될 구슬 갯수, 해당 구슬에 할당될 이벤트 id
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil,
			{ 'expedition_bead_drop_request', pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, amount, self.bead_event_id }))
end

function local_class:on_damage_stone(index)
	local have_shield = self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.ActualShield > 0
	local damage = have_shield and
			self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.ActualShield or
			math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(self.character) * self.stone_damage_modifier)

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
	damage_info.sender = user_party.Leader
	damage_info.target = self.character
	damage_info.damage = damage
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

	if have_shield then
		self:remove_stone(index, self.bead_amount_large)
	else
		self:remove_stone(index, self.bead_amount_small)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Info.target) then
		for i, v in pairs(self.fo_stone_list) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, v) then
				self:on_damage_stone(i)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_icedragon_create_stone' then
		local pos = vector(tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1)), tonumber(e:GetParamAt(2)), tonumber(e:GetParamAt(3)))
		self:create_stone(pos)

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_icedragon_stone_remove' then
		local index = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		local cause = e:GetParamAt(2)
		if cause == 'shield' then
			self:remove_stone(index, self.bead_amount_large)
		elseif cause == 'normal' or cause == 'pattern' then
			self:remove_stone(index, self.bead_amount_small)
		else
			self:remove_stone(index, 0)
		end

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_icedragon_clear_everything' then
		self:clear_stone()

	-- 혹시 모르니 해당 이벤트 publish는 sync로
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_icedragon_add_debuff' then
		local name = e:GetParamAt(1)
		self:add_ice_resistance_debuff(name)

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_icedragon_hand_appear' then

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_icedragon_hand_destroy' then
	end
end

function local_class:on_party_switching_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.CurrentParty[0]) then
		self.target = e.CurrentParty[0]
	end

	-- 이전 리더가 fo를 집어든 상태로 스위칭했다면 fo를 강제로 내려줌
	-- 내려지는 방향은 캐릭터 센터가 bead zone(스위칭 구슬 존) 센터 바라보는 방향으로
	local manual_character = e.PrevParty[0]
	local leader_state = manual_character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local held = manual_character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		character_util.clear_holdup_state(manual_character, held)
		--local height = field:GetTileInfoAt(held.Position).y
		local center_pos = self.zone_bound.center
		if self.bead_zone ~= nil then
			center_pos = self.bead_zone.Bounds.center
		end
		local character_pos = manual_character.Position
		local direction = vector_util.get_x0z((center_pos - character_pos)).normalized
		local drop_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(character_pos + direction * 1.0)
		held.Position = drop_pos
	end
end

function local_class:on_fieldobject_destroyed_event(e)
	-- 서리 고룡은 deathtype이 boss가 아니다.
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.character) then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent.Create(e.character))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'skip_boss_deathtype_check' }))
	end
end

function local_class:set_action_and_battle_zones()
	self.eruption_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossIceDragonEruption')
	self.glacier_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossIceDragonGlacier')
	self.breath_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossIceDragonIceBreath')
	self.punch_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossIceDragonPunch')
	self.scratch_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossIceDragonScratch')
	self.shield_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossIceDragonShield')
	self.strike_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossIceDragonStrike')
	self.phase_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossIceDragonPhaseShift')

	self.eruption_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.glacier_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.breath_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.punch_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.scratch_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.shield_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.strike_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.phase_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	local is_right = self.zone_bound.center.x < self.character.Bounds.center.x
	self.character.Direction = is_right and CS.Oak.Direction.Left or  CS.Oak.Direction.Right
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)
		self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)
		self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = nil
	end
end

return {

local local_class = newclass('BossInquisitorBattleAIState')

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		move = 1, --범위이내로 들어가서 이동 하는 상태
		battle = 2, --배틀액션 사용 가능 상태
		check_position = 3 --현재 위치를 파악
	}

	-- 추적하지 않고 일정 시간 대기 후 다음 패턴으로 감.
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 4)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 5)
	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingDistance', 2.5)
	self.circling_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingSpeed', 2)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingSpeed", 1)
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxFlowTime", 1)
	self.phase2_hp = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Phase2HP", 70)

	--타겟과 범위 이내이면 이동
	self.battle_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BattleDistance', 3)

	--도망 경과 시간
	self.run_max_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RunawayMaxTime', 1)

	--배틀존 벽과 범위 이내이면 중앙 텔레포트
	self.wall_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'WallDistance', 2)

end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
	end

	self.zone_bounds = battle_zone_bound

	self.circle_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInquisitorCircle")
	self.rush_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInquisitorRush")
	self.boomerang_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInquisitorBoomerang")
	self.phase_shift_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInquisitorPhaseshift")
	self.guillotine_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInquisitorGuillotine")
	self.circle_phase2_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInquisitorCircle:Phase2")
	self.rush_phase2_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInquisitorRush:Phase2")
	self.boomerang_phase2_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInquisitorBoomerang:Phase2")


	self.circle_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.rush_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.phase_shift_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.circle_phase2_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.rush_phase2_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.boomerang_phase2_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.guillotine_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)

	-- 진행시간
	self.time_passed = 0
	-- 선택된 배틀액션
	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	-- 배틀액션 실행중인지
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.battle_action_count = 0
	self.runaway_time_passed = 0
	self.ready_guillotine = false

	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end

	-- 현재 체력에 따라 페이즈 적용해둠
	self.phase = {
		phase1 = 1,
		phase2 = 2
	}

	self.current_phase = self.phase.phase1
	if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 < self.phase2_hp then
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
	end

	if self.is_immune then
		self:reset_ailment()
		--self:reset_immune_damage()
	end
	self.is_immune = false

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	self.current_state = self.state.none
	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	--test pattern
	--self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	--self.picked_battle_action = self.phase_shift_action

	if self.ready_guillotine then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.guillotine_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
		self.current_state = self.state.battle
		self.ready_guillotine = false
		self.time_passed = 0
		return
	end

	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 4

	if idx == 0 then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
		if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.circle_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.circle_phase2_action
		end
	elseif idx == 1 or idx == 3 then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
		if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.rush_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.rush_phase2_action
		end
	elseif idx == 2 then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
		if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.boomerang_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.boomerang_phase2_action
		end
	end

	self.current_state = self.state.battle
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:set_immune_damage()
	self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	--self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
	self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
	self.is_immune = true
end

function local_class:reset_immune_damage()
	if self.is_immune then
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
		self.death_type = nil
		--self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		self.is_immune = false
	end
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.guillotine_action, options)
end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.guillotine_action)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		return
	end

	--TOOD:메뉴얼캐릭 또는 존외곽과의 거리에 따른 행동 결정정
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.check_position then
		self:update_state()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 거리 파악해서 다음행동 이행
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then

				if self.picked_battle_action == self.guillotine_action then
					--self:reset_immune_damage()
					self:reset_ailment()
				end

				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
				self.current_state = self.state.check_position
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
			end
		else
			-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
			-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
				if self.picked_battle_action ~= self.phase_shift_action and self.picked_battle_action ~= self.guillotine_action then
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
				-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
		if self.runaway_time_passed > self.run_max_time then
			self.current_state = self.state.none
			self.runaway_time_passed = 0
		else
			self.runaway_time_passed = self.runaway_time_passed + dt
		end

		--이동하면서 거리유지
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
			if not self:is_come_close_target() then
				self:update_state()
			end
		else
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
					random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, true, self.circling_speed))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_state()
	--타겟 거리에 따른 state설정
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < self.battle_distance then
		self.current_state = self.state.move
	else
		self.current_state = self.state.none
	end

	if self.current_state ~= self.state.move then
		self.runaway_time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:is_come_close_target()
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < self.battle_distance then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:check_battle_zone_for_runaway()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.wall_distance)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
		if character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character) * 100 < self.phase2_hp and self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
			self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
			self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentResetEvent.Instance)
			buff_util.cure_all_debuffs(self.character, self.character)
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
			self.picked_battle_action = self.phase_shift_action
			self.battle_action_count = 0
			self.current_state = self.state.battle
			self.ready_guillotine = true

			self:set_ailment_resist()
			--self:set_immune_damage()

			self.time_passed = 0
		end
	end

	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end
end

		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 6
	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.lighting_shot]
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	elseif idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.rapid_fire]
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	elseif idx == 2 then
		if random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.rapid_fire]
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.lighting_shot]
		end
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	elseif idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.teleport]
		self.picked_battle_action:SetTriggerDest(self.battle_zone_bound.center);
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	elseif idx == 4 then
		if not self.is_clone_action_switch then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.summon_clone]
			self.is_clone_action_switch = true
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.bounce_charge]
			self.is_clone_action_switch = false
		end
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	elseif idx == 5 then
		if not self.is_clone_action_switch then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.teleport]
			self.picked_battle_action:SetTriggerDest(self.battle_zone_bound.center);
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		else

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.is_move_target_position then
		self:update_move_to_target(dt)
		return
	end

	--move -> battleaction 순으로 반복복
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
				self.time_passed = 0
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end

				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then

					if self.picked_battle_action ~= self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.bounce_charge] then
						self:get_next_move_position()
					end
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					--TODO: custom stage event를 clone에게 전달
					self:publish_event_to_clone(self.picked_battle_action)
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIStraightProjectileFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:publish_event_to_clone(ba)
	local ba_name = ''
	if ba == self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.lighting_shot] or ba == self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.bounce_charge] then
		ba_name = 'lighting_shot'
	elseif ba == self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.rapid_fire] or ba == self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.summon_clone] then
		ba_name = 'rapid_fire'

		if not self.is_start_clone then
			self.is_start_clone = true
			return
		end
	end

	local target_name = self.target.Name
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {
		ba_name,
		target_name
	}))

	if self.move_current_move_index >= #self.move_index_list then
		self.move_current_move_index = 1
	end

	self.current_move_position = self.sliced_zone_bounds[self.move_index_list[self.move_current_move_index]].center
	self.move_current_move_index = self.move_current_move_index + 1

	local is_teleport = false

	if not self.is_clone_action_switch then
		is_teleport = true
	end

	self.is_move_target_position = true

function local_class:update_move_to_target(dt)
	-- 대쉬 이동 처리
	local stat = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour
	local move_speed = stat.DashSpeed
	local movement = move_speed * dt

	local remains = vector_util.get_x0z(self.current_move_position - self.character.Position)

	if remains.magnitude < 0.15 then

	local look_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	move_info.direction = move_dir
	move_info.magnitude = movement
	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, true)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	return false

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.is_move_target_position then

			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then

				self.time_passed = 0

		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 다음 이동포인트로 이동
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then

					if self.picked_battle_action ~= self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.bounce_charge] then
						self:get_next_move_position()
					end
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					--TODO: custom stage event를 clone에게 전달
					self:publish_event_to_clone(self.picked_battle_action)
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIStraightProjectileFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:publish_event_to_clone(ba)
	local ba_name = ''
	if ba == self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.lighting_shot] or ba == self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.bounce_charge] then
		ba_name = 'lighting_shot'
	elseif ba == self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.rapid_fire] or ba == self.battle_Actions[self.battle_action_keys.summon_clone] then
		ba_name = 'rapid_fire'

		if not self.is_start_clone then
			self.is_start_clone = true
			return
		end
	end

	local target_name = self.target.Name
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {
		ba_name,
		target_name
	}))
end

function local_class:get_next_move_position()
	if self.move_current_move_index >= #self.move_index_list then
		self.move_current_move_index = 1
	end

	self.current_move_position = self.sliced_zone_bounds[self.move_index_list[self.move_current_move_index]].center
	self.move_current_move_index = self.move_current_move_index + 1

	local is_teleport = false

	if not self.is_clone_action_switch then
		is_teleport = true
	end

	self.is_move_target_position = true
end

function local_class:update_move_to_target(dt)
	-- 대쉬 이동 처리
	local stat = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour
	local move_speed = stat.DashSpeed
	local movement = move_speed * dt

	local remains = vector_util.get_x0z(self.current_move_position - self.character.Position)

	if remains.magnitude < 0.15 then
		self.is_move_target_position = false
		return
	end

	movement = math.min(movement, remains.magnitude)

	local move_dir = remains.normalized
	local look_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = move_dir
	move_info.magnitude = movement
	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, true)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
end

		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)

	self.current_move_position = self.sliced_zone_bounds[self.move_index_list[self.move_current_move_index]].center
	self.move_current_move_index = self.move_current_move_index + 1

	local is_teleport = false

	if not self.is_clone_action_switch then
		is_teleport = true
	end

	self.is_move_target_position = true
end

function local_class:update_move_to_target(dt)
	-- 대쉬 이동 처리
	local stat = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour
	local move_speed = stat.DashSpeed
	local movement = move_speed * dt

	local remains = vector_util.get_x0z(self.current_move_position - self.character.Position)

	if remains.magnitude < 0.15 then
		self.is_move_target_position = false
		return
	end

	movement = math.min(movement, remains.magnitude)

	local move_dir = remains.normalized
	local look_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = move_dir
	move_info.magnitude = movement
	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, true)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
end


function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

-- 인베이더 드래곤 배틀 AI
-- 좌 우 팔 및 페이즈 컨트롤
-- 이동 안함
local local_class = newclass("BossInvaderDragonBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	-- AI 스펙 로드
	self.follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 5.0)
	self.breath_hp = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BreathHp", 50)

	-- 내부 배틀액션 흐름
	self.state = {
		lead_shot = 1,
		smash = 2,
		combo_shot = 3,
		slash = 4,
		breath = 5
	}
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	local zone_bound
	local zone = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleZoneBounds(self.character)

	if zone ~= nil then
		zone_bound = zone.Bounds
	else
		zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector2.one * 20)
	end

	-- 배틀 액션 정리
	self.shot_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInvaderDragonShot")
	self.breath_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInvaderDragonDimensionBreath")

	-- 배틀 존 정보 필요한 액션들
	self.breath_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(zone_bound)
	self.breath_action.MetaTable:initialize_summons()

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.flag = false
	self.time_passed = 0

	-- 이벤트 처리
	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)

	self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(CS.Oak.Direction.Down, CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom))

	-- center 는 캐스팅 보여야 하므로 UI 일부만 수동으로 끔
	local ui_dict = stage.FieldUIManager:GetUI(self.character)
	if ui_dict:ContainsKey(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats) then
		local stats_ui = ui_dict[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats]
		stats_ui.Offset.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	self.character.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
	self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType

	-- 현재 체력에 따라서 브레스 쏠 수 있나 플래그 세팅
	self.can_breath = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 > self.breath_hp

	if random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5 then
		self.current_state = self.state.lead_shot
	else
		self.current_state = self.state.smash
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	-- 구독 해제
	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.shot_action = nil
	self.breath_action = nil
	self:restore_damaged_behaviour()
end

function local_class:restore_damaged_behaviour()
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour)) then
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
	else
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
	end
end

--- 브레스 쏠때의 특별한 처리
function local_class:modification_for_breath()
	-- 어그로 리셋
	local battle = battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.character)
	local targets = battle_manager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if battle ~= nil and targets ~= nil then
		for index = 0, targets.Count-1 do
			battle:ResetAggro(targets[index], self.character)
		end

		targets:Dispose()
	end

	-- 비헤이비어 변경
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local key = e:GetParamAt(0)
	if key == "invader_dragon_cast_start" then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))))
	elseif key == "invader_dragon_cast_end" then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif key == "invader_dragon_breath_ready" then
		self:modification_for_breath()
	elseif key == "invader_dragon_breath_done" then
		self:restore_damaged_behaviour()
	elseif key == "invader_dragon_smash_finish" then
		if self.current_state == self.state.smash then
			self:progress_state()
		end
	elseif key == "invader_dragon_slash_finish" then
		if self.current_state == self.state.slash then
			self:progress_state()
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:select_battle_action()
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	-- 현재 페이즈에 따른 액션 선택
	if self.current_state == self.state.lead_shot or self.current_state == self.state.combo_shot then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.shot_action
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.smash then
		self.picked_battle_action = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash then
		self.picked_battle_action = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.breath then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.breath_action
	end

	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
end

function local_class:progress_state()
	self.flag = false
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if self.current_state == self.state.breath then
		-- 브레스 완료 후 초기 패턴 부터 재진행
		if random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5 then
			self.current_state = self.state.lead_shot
		else
			self.current_state = self.state.smash
		end
	elseif self.can_breath == true and self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 < self.breath_hp then
		-- 체력 낮으면 브레스
		self.can_breath = false
		self.current_state = self.state.breath
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.lead_shot then
		-- 샷1 다음에 스매쉬
		self.current_state = self.state.smash
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.smash then
		-- 스매쉬 다음에 샷2
		self.current_state = self.state.combo_shot
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.combo_shot then
		-- 샷2 다음에 슬래시
		self.current_state = self.state.slash
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash then
		-- 슬래시 다음에 샷1 또는 스매쉬
		if random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5 then
			self.current_state = self.state.lead_shot
		else
			self.current_state = self.state.smash
		end
	end
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if self.current_state == nil then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.smash then
		if not self.flag then
			self.flag = true
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { "invader_dragon_smash_ready" }))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash then
		if not self.flag then
			self.flag = true
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { "invader_dragon_slash_ready" }))
		end
	else
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			self:select_battle_action()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 다음 진행
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self:progress_state()
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					if self.picked_battle_action == self.breath_action then
						CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { "invader_dragon_breath_ready" }))
					end
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						if self.picked_battle_action == self.breath_action then
							CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { "invader_dragon_breath_ready" }))
						end
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

	self.target = fo

	-- AI 스펙 로드
	self.follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 5.0)

function local_class:get_target()

end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	local zone_bound
	local zone = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleZoneBounds(self.character)

	if zone ~= nil then
		zone_bound = zone.Bounds
	else
		zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector2.one * 20)
	end

	-- 배틀 액션
	self.battle_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInvaderDragonMineSlash")
	self.battle_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(zone_bound)

	-- 이벤트 처리
	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end
	self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	end
	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(CS.Oak.Direction.Right, CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom))
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.All)
	self.character.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
	self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType

function local_class:exit()

	end
	if self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func)
		self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.battle_action = nil
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state)
	self:restore_damaged_behaviour()

function local_class:restore_damaged_behaviour()
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour)) then
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
	else
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
end

--- 브레스 쏠때의 특별한 처리
function local_class:modification_for_breath()
	-- 어그로 리셋
	local battle = battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.character)
	local targets = battle_manager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if battle ~= nil and targets ~= nil then
		for index = 0, targets.Count-1 do
			battle:ResetAggro(targets[index], self.character)
		end

		targets:Dispose()
	end

	-- 비헤이비어 변경
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance

	-- 커스텀 애니메이션
	self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_breath_cast)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local key = e:GetParamAt(0)

	-- 커스텀 이벤트 받아서 상태 레디로 바꿈
	if key == "invader_dragon_slash_ready" then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		self.current_state = self.state.ready
		self.time_passed = 0
	elseif key == "invader_dragon_breath_ready" then
		self:modification_for_breath()
	elseif key == "invader_dragon_breath_done" then
		self:restore_damaged_behaviour()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Info.target) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Info.sender) then
		return false
	end

	-- 데미지 비헤이비어 변경된 상태면 안보냄
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.head_character.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour)) then
		self.head_character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = self.head_character
		damage_info.damage = e.Info.damage
		damage_info.fireDamage = e.Info.fireDamage
		damage_info.iceDamage = e.Info.iceDamage
		damage_info.earthDamage = e.Info.earthDamage
		damage_info.lightDamage = e.Info.lightDamage
		damage_info.darkDamage = e.Info.darkDamage
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

		self.head_character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.head_character, e.FieldObject) then
		return false
	end

	-- 걸려있던 옵션 삭제
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state)

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour)) then
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
	else
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
	end

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = self.character
	damage_info.damage = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour)) then
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	-- 완료 상태
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 팔이 아니라 머리 기준 컨트롤
	if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.head_character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState)) then
		-- 현재 상태에 따라 처리
		if self.current_state == self.state.ready then
			-- 아직 사용 안했다면 그냥 대기
		elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
			-- 이미 사용했다면 cancel
			self.battle_action.MetaTable:cancel()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { "invader_dragon_slash_finish" }))
			self.current_state = self.state.none
			self.time_passed = 0
		end

		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.ready then
		-- 타겟 확인
		if is_unity_null(self.target) or self.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		end

		-- 배틀 액션 사용 시도
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.battle_action) then
			-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
			self.current_state = self.state.action
			self.time_passed = 0

		elseif self.time_passed >= self.follow_time then
			-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.battle_action) then
				self.current_state = self.state.action
				self.time_passed = 0

			else
				-- 타겟 갱신 및 타이머 초기화 하고 재시도
				self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
				self.time_passed = 0
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 다음 진행
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.battle_action) then
			-- 완료 이벤트 메세지로 전파 (머리에서 받아서 처리)
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { "invader_dragon_slash_finish" }))
			self.current_state = self.state.none
			self.time_passed = 0
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func)
		self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("BossInvaderDragonMainBattleAIState")

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	-- AI params
	self.follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 5.0)
	self.rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 0.85)
	self.center_marker_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "CenterMarker", "dragon_center")
	self.right_marker_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "RightMarker", "dragon_right")
	self.left_marker_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "LeftMarker", "dragon_left")
	self.phase2_hp = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Phase2HP", 10)

	-- 중앙일때/더미세울때 애니
	self.anim_req_disappear_center = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('groggy', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false, 1, -1, nil, nil, 'groggy_loop')
	self.anim_req_appear_center = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('revive', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false, 1, -1, nil, nil, 'idle')

	-- 좌우에서 애니
	self.anim_req_disappear_side = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('out', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false, 1, -1, nil, nil, nil)
	self.anim_req_appear_side = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('in', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false, 1, -1, nil, nil, 'idle')

	self.anim_dummy_loop = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('groggy_loop', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true, 1, -1, nil, nil, nil)

	self.action_keys = {
		meteor = 1,
		missile = 2,
		laser = 3,
		frenzy = 4
	}

	-- internal state (simple)
	self.state = {
		idle = 1,
		transfer = 2,
		action = 3
	}

	self.transfer_state = {
		none = 1,
		disappear = 2,
		appear = 3,
		done = 4
	}
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- set battle actions
	local zone_bound
	local zone = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleZoneBounds(self.character)

	if zone ~= nil then
		zone_bound = zone.Bounds
	else
		zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector2.one * 20)
	end

	self.meteor_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInvaderCoreMeteor")
	self.missile_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInvaderCoreMissile")
	self.laser_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInvaderCoreLaser")
	self.frenzy_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInvaderCoreMeteor:Frenzy")

	self.meteor_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(zone_bound)
	self.laser_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(zone_bound)
	self.frenzy_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(zone_bound)

	-- markers
	self.center_position = field:GetMarker(self.center_marker_name).position
	self.right_position = field:GetMarker(self.right_marker_name).position
	self.left_position = field:GetMarker(self.left_marker_name).position

	-- HACK: 좌 우 머리가 16:9 미만 해상도에서 잘 안보이는 문제 수정을 위해 해상도 기반으로 마커 포지션 가져온 것 조정
	local sc_ratio = CS.ScreenUtil.GetAdjustingScaleByAspectRatio()
	if sc_ratio < 1 then
		local x_mod = (1 - sc_ratio) * 5.5
		self.right_position.x = self.right_position.x - x_mod
		self.left_position.x = self.left_position.x + x_mod
	end

	self.right_anim_position = self.right_position + unity_class.vector3(5,0,0)
	self.left_anim_position = self.left_position + unity_class.vector3(-5,0,0)

	-- 캐스팅 UI만 보이게 설정
	local ui_dict = stage.FieldUIManager:GetUI(self.character)
	if ui_dict:ContainsKey(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats) then
		local stats_ui = ui_dict[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats]
		stats_ui.Offset.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
	self.character.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

	-- 연출용 더미 스파인
	local head_object_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('invader_dragon_main_head')
	self.pooled_head_obj = head_object_pool:Instantiate(self.character.Position)
	self.head_obj_spine_controller = self.pooled_head_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	self.head_obj_spine_controller.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	self.head_obj_spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
	self.head_obj_spine_controller.IsShadowActive = false
	self.head_obj_spine_controller:SetSortingLayer('Default', 1)

	-- init
	self:set_lock_direction(CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	self.character.Position = self.center_position
	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	self.p1_action_key = nil
	self.p2_action_key = nil
	self.p3_action_key = nil

	self.frenzied = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 < self.phase2_hp

	-- 초기 rest time은 길게
	self.current_rest_time = 1.5
	self.transfer_progress = self.transfer_state.none
	self.transfer_time_recorder = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = self.state.idle
end

function local_class:set_lock_direction(direction)
	self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(direction, CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom))
end

function local_class:exit()

	-- 특정 타이밍에 캔슬되지 않는 케이스가 있어 ai 종료시 캔슬되도록 추가
	self.offset_flag = true
	self.character.SpineController:CancelDeviateLocal()

	self.character.Position = self.center_position
	self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
	self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_state)

	-- 더미 스파인 지움
	if not is_unity_null(self.head_obj_spine_controller) then
		self.head_obj_spine_controller.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
		self.pooled_head_obj:Dispose()
	end
	self.pooled_head_obj = nil
	self.head_obj_spine_controller = nil

	self.meteor_action = nil
	self.missile_action = nil
	self.laser_action = nil
	self.frenzy_action = nil

	self.center_position = nil
	self.right_position = nil
	self.left_position = nil

	self.transfer_progress = nil
	self.transfer_time_recorder = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.current_state = nil
end

--- 커스텀 스파인에 애니메이션 주기
function local_class:set_dummy_animation(request)
	if not is_unity_null(self.head_obj_spine_controller) then
		self.pooled_head_obj.transform.position = self.center_position
		self.head_obj_spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		self.head_obj_spine_controller:SetAnimation(1, request.name, request.loop, request.timescale, request.mixDuration, request.sfxHandler, request.nextAnimation)
	end
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

--- 배틀액션 선택 및 타겟 선택
function local_class:pick_action()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	local pick_key

	-- 기준 체력 이하일때 발악패턴
	if self.frenzied or self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 < self.phase2_hp then
		self.frenzied = true
		pick_key = self.action_keys.frenzy
	elseif self.p1_action_key == nil then
		pick_key = self.action_keys.missile
	elseif self.p2_action_key == nil then
		pick_key = self.action_keys.laser
	elseif self.p3_action_key == nil then
		pick_key = self.action_keys.meteor
	else
		if self.p3_action_key == self.p1_action_key then
			--p1(p3), p2 아닌 나머지
			for _, k in pairs(self.action_keys) do
				if k ~= self.p1_action_key and k ~= self.p2_action_key and k ~= self.action_keys.frenzy then
					pick_key = k
					break
				end
			end
		else
			-- p1 이 아닌 두개중 하나
			local candidate = {}
			for _, k in pairs(self.action_keys) do
				if k ~= self.p1_action_key and k ~= self.action_keys.frenzy then
					table.insert(candidate, k)
				end
			end

			pick_key = random_util.get_values_in_array(candidate, { count = 1})[1]
		end
	end

	self.picked_action_key = pick_key
	if pick_key == self.action_keys.meteor then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.meteor_action
	elseif pick_key == self.action_keys.missile then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.missile_action
	elseif pick_key == self.action_keys.laser then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.laser_action
	elseif pick_key == self.action_keys.frenzy then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.frenzy_action
	end

	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
end

--- 위치 이동 제어
function local_class:update_transfer(dt)
	if self.transfer_progress == self.transfer_state.none then
		-- 현재 위치 키
		local prev_location_key = self.p1_action_key
		if prev_location_key == nil then
			prev_location_key = self.action_keys.meteor
		end

		-- 광폭화 이후엔 계속 메테오만 쓸 것임
		if prev_location_key == self.action_keys.frenzy then
			self.frenzied = true
			self.picked_action_key = self.action_keys.frenzy
			self.picked_battle_action = self.frenzy_action
		end

		-- 메테오 미사일 레이저
		-- 이동 불필요한 경우 그대로 종료
		if prev_location_key == self.picked_action_key then
			return true
		end

		-- 메테오 -> 광분인 경우에도 위치가 같다.
		if prev_location_key == self.action_keys.meteor and self.picked_action_key == self.action_keys.frenzy then
			return true
		end

		-- 현재 위치에서 사라지는 애니메이션
		if prev_location_key == self.action_keys.meteor then
			self:set_lock_direction(CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
			self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_req_disappear_center)

			-- 더미 재생 위치 확인
			self:set_dummy_animation(self.anim_req_disappear_center)

		elseif prev_location_key == self.action_keys.missile then
			self:set_lock_direction(CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
			self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_req_disappear_side)
			self.character.SpineController:DeviateLocal(unity_class.vector3(7.5,0,0), 1.85, 10, 10)
		elseif prev_location_key == self.action_keys.laser then
			self:set_lock_direction(CS.Oak.Direction.Right)
			self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_req_disappear_side)
			self.character.SpineController:DeviateLocal(unity_class.vector3(-7.5,0,0), 1.85, 10, 10)
		end

		self.transfer_progress = self.transfer_state.disappear
		self.transfer_time_recorder = self.time_passed
		self.offset_flag = false

	elseif self.transfer_progress == self.transfer_state.disappear then
		-- 사라지는 처리 완료 후 포지션 변경/등장 애니메이션 출력
		if self.time_passed >= self.transfer_time_recorder + 1 then
			if self.offset_flag == true then
				if self.picked_action_key == self.action_keys.meteor or self.picked_action_key == self.action_keys.frenzy then
					-- 중앙으로 복귀
					self:set_lock_direction(CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
					self.character.Position = self.center_position
					self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_req_appear_center)

					-- 머리는 숨김
					self.head_obj_spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None

				elseif self.picked_action_key == self.action_keys.missile then
					self:set_lock_direction(CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
					self.character.Position = self.right_position
					self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_req_appear_side)

					-- 더미 재생 위치 확인
					self:set_dummy_animation(self.anim_dummy_loop)

				elseif self.picked_action_key == self.action_keys.laser then
					self:set_lock_direction(CS.Oak.Direction.Right)
					self.character.Position = self.left_position
					self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_req_appear_side)

					-- 더미 재생 위치 확인
					self:set_dummy_animation(self.anim_dummy_loop)
				end

				self.transfer_progress = self.transfer_state.appear
				self.transfer_time_recorder = self.time_passed
			else
				-- 오프셋만 먼저 처리
				self.offset_flag = true
				self.character.SpineController:CancelDeviateLocal()
			end
		end
	elseif self.transfer_progress == self.transfer_state.appear then
		-- 나타나는 처리 완료 후 상태 변경
		if self.time_passed >= self.transfer_time_recorder + 1 then
			-- 배틀액션 쓰게 될 것이므로 애니 제거
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)

			self.transfer_progress = self.transfer_state.done
			self.transfer_time_recorder = self.time_passed

			return true
		end
	elseif self.transfer_progress == self.transfer_state.done then
		self.transfer_time_recorder = self.time_passed
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if self.current_state == nil then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.idle then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			-- 다음 액션을 정하고, 타겟을 정하고, 이동 하기 위한 처리로 이행
			self:pick_action()
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.current_state = self.state.transfer
			self.transfer_progress = self.transfer_state.none
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.transfer then
		local transfer_done = self:update_transfer(dt)

		if transfer_done then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.transfer_time_recorder = 0
			self.current_state = self.state.action
			self.transfer_progress = self.transfer_state.none
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 배틀액션 사용, 배틀 액션 끝나면 다시 idle
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.p3_action_key = self.p2_action_key
				self.p2_action_key = self.p1_action_key
				self.p1_action_key = self.picked_action_key

				self.current_rest_time = self.rest_time
				self.time_passed = 0
				self.current_state = self.state.idle
			end
		else
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
			elseif self.time_passed >= self.follow_time then
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
				else
					self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.follow_time = nil
	self.rest_time = nil
	self.center_marker_name = nil
	self.right_marker_name = nil
	self.left_marker_name = nil

	self.action_keys = nil
	self.state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.All)

function local_class:restore_damaged_behaviour()

	else
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)

--- 브레스 쏠때의 특별한 처리
function local_class:modification_for_breath()
	-- 어그로 리셋
	local battle = battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.character)
	local targets = battle_manager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if battle ~= nil and targets ~= nil then
		for index = 0, targets.Count-1 do
			battle:ResetAggro(targets[index], self.character)
		end

		targets:Dispose()
	end

	-- 비헤이비어 변경
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance

	-- 커스텀 애니메이션
	self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_breath_cast)

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local key = e:GetParamAt(0)

	-- 커스텀 이벤트 받아서 상태 레디로 바꿈
	if key == "invader_dragon_smash_ready" then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		self.current_state = self.state.ready
		self.time_passed = 0
	elseif key == "invader_dragon_breath_ready" then
		self:modification_for_breath()
	elseif key == "invader_dragon_breath_done" then
		self:restore_damaged_behaviour()
	end

end

-- 본인이 데미지 받았을 때 그만큼 머리에게 보냄. / 데미지 숫자 안뜨게
function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Info.target) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Info.sender) then
		return false
	end

	-- 데미지 비헤이비어 변경된 상태면 안보냄
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.head_character.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour)) then
		self.head_character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = self.head_character
		damage_info.damage = e.Info.damage
		damage_info.fireDamage = e.Info.fireDamage
		damage_info.iceDamage = e.Info.iceDamage
		damage_info.earthDamage = e.Info.earthDamage
		damage_info.lightDamage = e.Info.lightDamage
		damage_info.darkDamage = e.Info.darkDamage
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

		self.head_character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.head_character, e.FieldObject) then
		return false
	end

	-- 걸려있던 옵션 삭제
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state)

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour)) then
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
	else
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
	end

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = self.character
	damage_info.damage = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour)) then
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	-- 완료 상태
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 팔이 아니라 머리 기준 컨트롤
	if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.head_character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState)) then
		-- 현재 상태에 따라 처리
		if self.current_state == self.state.ready then
			-- 아직 사용 안했다면 그냥 대기
		elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
			-- 이미 사용했다면 cancel
			self.battle_action.MetaTable:cancel()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { "invader_dragon_smash_finish" }))
			self.current_state = self.state.none
			self.time_passed = 0
		end

		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.ready then
		-- 타겟 확인
		if is_unity_null(self.target) or self.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		end

		-- 배틀 액션 사용 시도
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.battle_action) then
			-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
			self.current_state = self.state.action
			self.time_passed = 0

		elseif self.time_passed >= self.follow_time then
			-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.battle_action) then
				self.current_state = self.state.action
				self.time_passed = 0

			else
				-- 타겟 갱신 및 타이머 초기화 하고 재시도
				self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
				self.time_passed = 0
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 다음 진행
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.battle_action) then
			-- 완료 이벤트 메세지로 전파 (머리에서 받아서 처리)
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { "invader_dragon_smash_finish" }))
			self.current_state = self.state.none
			self.time_passed = 0
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func)
		self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}
