function local_class:decide_teleport_destination()
	-- 순간이동 위치 결정
	local available_points = {}

	for _, bound in ipairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
		-- 현재 캐릭터의 바운드와 겹치지 않는 곳만 추가
		if not CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(self.character.Bounds, bound) and CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(self.target.Bounds, bound) then
			table.insert(available_points, bound.center)
		end
	end

	local points = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_points, {count = 1})

	if #points > 0 then
		return points[1]
	else
		return self.sliced_zone_bounds[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.sliced_zone_bounds)].center
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.picked_battle_action = self.runaway_action

	if self.phase_change_reserved == true then

		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
		self.battle_action_count = 0
	else
		local idx = self.battle_action_count % 6
		if idx == 0 then
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.enhanced_charge_action
			end
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		elseif idx == 1 then
			self.slash_combo_count = 1
			self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_combo_action_list[self.slash_combo_count]
			self.is_combo_action = true
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		elseif idx == 2 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.stomp_action
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		elseif idx == 3 then
			-- 프레데터 쓰로우 제거됨.
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action

	end

		end

	local available_points = {}

	for _, bound in ipairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
		-- 현재 캐릭터의 바운드와 겹치지 않는 곳만 추가
		if not CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(self.character.Bounds, bound) and CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(self.target.Bounds, bound) then
			table.insert(available_points, bound.center)
		end
	end

	local points = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_points, {count = 1})

	if #points > 0 then
		return points[1]
	else
		return self.sliced_zone_bounds[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.sliced_zone_bounds)].center
	end

	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 6
	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	elseif idx == 1 then
		self.slash_combo_count = 1
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_combo_action_list[self.slash_combo_count]
		self.is_combo_action = true
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	elseif idx == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.stomp_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	elseif idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	elseif idx == 4 then

		local distance = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
		--3타일이내의 어그로 적이 있을 경우 슬래쉬 콤보 아닐 경우 차지어택
		if distance <= 3 then
			self.slash_combo_count = 1
			self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_combo_action_list[self.slash_combo_count]
			self.is_combo_action = true
		else

		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리

				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경

				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then

						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then

				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))

local local_class = newclass("BossJungpaBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.rest_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RestDuration', 0.5)
	self.phase2_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Phase2HpRatio', 0.8)
	self.use_phase_shift = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'UsePhaseShift', true)

	self.state = {
		rest = 1,
		battle = 2,
	}

	self.current_state = self.state.rest
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.kick_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossJungpaBounceballKick')
	self.kick_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position))

	self.punch_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossJungpaPunchDash')

	self.explosion_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossJungpaEnergyExplosion')
	self.explosion_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position))

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.picked_battle_action_table = nil
	self.current_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.battle_action_index_map = {
		[0] = { self.kick_action },
		[1] = { self.punch_action },
		[2] = { self.kick_action }
	}

	self.battle_action_index_map_phase_2 = {
		[0] = { self.explosion_action },
		[1] = { self.kick_action },
		[2] = { self.punch_action },
		[3] = { self.explosion_action, self.kick_action, ['force'] =  nil},
		[4] = { self.punch_action }
	}

	self.current_battle_action_index_map = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.phase2_hp_ratio
			and self.battle_action_index_map_phase_2
			or self.battle_action_index_map
	self.current_battle_action_index_map = self.use_phase_shift
			and self.current_battle_action_index_map
			or self.battle_action_index_map
	self.battle_action_index = -1

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	self:change_state(self.state.rest)
	self.time_passed = self.rest_duration + 1
	self:pick_battle_action_candidate()
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(nil)

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
	self.stomp_action = nil
	self.rush_action = nil

	self.picked_battle_action_table = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_index = nil
	self.battle_action_index_map = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Info.target) then
		return self:handle_damage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentStartedEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Character) then
		if self.current_action == self.punch_action and self.current_battle_action_index_map[self.battle_action_index][1] == self.punch_action then
			self.battle_action_index = self.battle_action_index - 1
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:handle_damage_event(e)
	if not self.use_phase_shift then
		return true
	end

	if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.phase2_hp_ratio
			and self.current_battle_action_index_map ~= self.battle_action_index_map_phase_2 then
		self.phase_shift_reserved = true
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_candidate()

	if self.phase_shift_reserved then
		self.current_battle_action_index_map = self.battle_action_index_map_phase_2
		self.battle_action_index = -1
		self.phase_shift_reserved = false
	end

	self.battle_action_index = self.battle_action_index < 0
			and self.battle_action_index + 1
			or self.battle_action_index % #self.current_battle_action_index_map + 1
	self.picked_battle_action_table = self.current_battle_action_index_map[self.battle_action_index]
	self:change_target_with_picked_action()
end

function local_class:change_target_with_picked_action()
	self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state)
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if not can_control then
		return
	end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then
		if self.time_passed > self.rest_duration then
			local current_action = self:determine_action()
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(current_action, self.target) then
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, current_action)
				self.current_action = current_action
				self:change_state(self.state.battle)
				return
			end
			self:pick_battle_action_candidate()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.current_action == nil or not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.current_action) then
			self:pick_battle_action_candidate()
			self:change_state(self.state.rest)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:determine_action()
	local current_action
	if self.picked_battle_action_table['force'] ~= nil then
		current_action = self.picked_battle_action_table['force']
		self.picked_battle_action_table['force'] = nil
	else
		current_action = self.picked_battle_action_table[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.picked_battle_action_table)]
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action_table == self.battle_action_index_map_phase_2[3] and
			current_action == self.kick_action then
		self.current_battle_action_index_map[3]['force'] = self.explosion_action
	end

	return current_action
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.state.rest then
		self.cs_state:ChangeState((CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false)))
	end
	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

		battle_range_util.show(self.move_ar, self.prepare_duration)

	elseif next_state == self.state.move then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_bosskadenai_matrix_01')

	else
		if self.calc ~= nil then
			self.calc:End()
		end

		if self.fx ~= nil then
			self.fx_cyclone_end_pool:Instantiate(self.position)
		end
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx)
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function cyclone_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.idle then
		self:publish_damage(dt)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.delay then
		if self.time_passed >= self.delay_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self:update_move_ar(dt)
		self:publish_damage(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.move)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
		self:update_move(dt)
		self:publish_damage(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.move_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function cyclone_class:update_move_ar(dt)
	self.direction = (self.target.Position - self.position).normalized
	if vector_util.is_almost_zero(self.direction) then
		self.direction = direction_util.to_4way_vector3_ver2(self.target.Direction)
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.move_ar, self.position, self.direction)
end

function cyclone_class:update_move(dt)
	local move = self.direction * (self.move_speed * dt)
	self.position = self.position + move
	CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx, self.position)
end

function cyclone_class:publish_damage(dt)
	self.calc.Position = self.position

	local objects = self.calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for _, fo in pairs(objects) do
		local is_boss = lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo)
		local is_move = self.current_state == self.state.move
		if not is_move and not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			goto continue
		end

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = is_boss and CS.Oak.DamageType.Death or CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = is_boss and 0 or self.damage_modifier
		damage_info.damage = is_boss and math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(self.character) * self.boss_damage_hp_ratio) or 0
		-- knockback
		if not is_boss then
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			if is_move then
				local d = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
				local xz_target_direction = d:GetXz().normalized
				local xz_move_direction = self.direction:GetXz().normalized
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction)
						and unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.direction
						or unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.direction
			else
				local dir = (fo.Position - self.position).normalized
				if vector_util.is_almost_zero(dir) then
					dir = (self.battle_zone.center - fo.Position).normalized
				end
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			end
			-- 플레이어만 피격음
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_light_06')
		else
			damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment_info)
		end
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

		self.fx_hit_pool:Instantiate(fo.Position)

		:: continue ::
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function cyclone_class:dispose_fx(fx)
	if fx == nil then
		return
	end
	fx:Dispose()
end

function cyclone_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params = params

	self.min_follow_duration = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'MinFollowDuration', 1.0)
	self.max_follow_duration = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'MaxFollowDuration', 3.0)
	self.trigger_cyclone_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'TriggerCycloneAmount', 3)

	self.cyclone_interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CycloneIntervalDuration', 0.2)

	self.idle_cyclones = {}
	self.active_cyclones = {}

	self.fx_cyclone_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_kaden_ai_sword_storm_attack_loop')
	self.fx_cyclone_end_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_kaden_ai_sword_storm_attack_end')
	self.fx_hit_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_kaden_ai_storm_hit')
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)

	self.sword_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossKadenAISword')
	self.cut_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossKadenAICut')
	self.cyclone_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossKadenAICyclone')
	self.matrix_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossKadenAIMatrix')

	self.cut_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.prev_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)

	-- event sub
	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self:update_cyclones(dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			return
		end

		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.rand_follow_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_follow_duration, self.max_follow_duration)
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
			end
		else
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
			end
		end
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed < self.rand_follow_time then
			return
		end
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	end
end

function local_class:update_cyclones(dt)
	for i = #self.active_cyclones, 1, -1 do
		local v = self.active_cyclones[i]
		v:update_frame(dt)

		if v:trigger() then
			self:push_cyclone(table.remove(self.active_cyclones, i))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))

	if self.prev_battle_action == nil then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.sword_action
		self.prev_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
		return
	end

	if self.prev_battle_action == self.sword_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.cut_action

	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.cut_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.cyclone_action

	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.cyclone_action then
		if self:get_count_can_shoot_cyclone() >= self.trigger_cyclone_amount then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.matrix_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.sword_action
		end
	end

	self.prev_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state, nil, true)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:exit()
	for i = #self.active_cyclones, 1, -1 do
		local v = self.active_cyclones[i]
		v:cancel()
		self:push_cyclone(table.remove(self.active_cyclones, i))
	end
end

function local_class:create_cyclone()
	local v = cyclone_class:new(self, self.character, self.cs_battle_action, self.params, self.zone_bound,
			self.fx_cyclone_pool, self.fx_cyclone_end_pool, self.fx_hit_pool)
	return v
end

function local_class:pop_cyclone()
	local v = #self.idle_cyclones > 0 and table.remove(self.idle_cyclones, 1) or self:create_cyclone()
	table.insert(self.active_cyclones, v)
	return v
end

function local_class:push_cyclone(cyclone)
	table.insert(self.idle_cyclones, cyclone)
end

function local_class:get_count_can_shoot_cyclone()
	local count = 0
	for _, v in pairs(self.active_cyclones) do
		if v:can_shoot() then
			count = count + 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_kaden_ai_req_create_cyclone' then
		local x = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		local y = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(2))
		local z = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(3))
		local p = vector(x, y, z)
		local c = self:pop_cyclone()
		c:start(p)

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_kaden_ai_req_cyclone_shoot' then
		for i, v in pairs(self.active_cyclones) do
			if v:can_shoot() then
				v:shoot_cyclone(self.target, (i - 1) * self.cyclone_interval_duration)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params = nil

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("BossLeaderBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	-- AI 스펙 로드 * 이 시점에서 파싱하고 딕셔너리 굳이 들고 있지 않도록
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 7.0)
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 1.0)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 1.5)

	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingDistance", 3.5)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingSpeed", 0.5)

	self.check_enemy_num_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CheckEnemyCountRange', -1)
	self.use_rush_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'UseMissileRushCount', 3)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	local zone_bound
	local zone_name = self.character.FieldObjectController.Zone
	if zone_name then
		zone_bound = field:GetZone(zone_name).Bounds
	else
		zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	end

	if zone_bound == nil then
		zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 현재 서브 시스템 로그체스
	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.RogueChessSystem.Instance
	self.base_obj = self.rc_sub_system ~= nil and self.rc_sub_system.EndCondition.BaseObject or nil
	if self.base_obj ~= nil then
		self.black_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.IFieldObject)
		self.black_list:Add(self.base_obj)
	end

	-- 배틀 액션 데이터
	self.continuous_attack_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossLeaderContinuousAttack")
	self.missile_rush_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossLeaderMissileRush")
	self.charge_buster_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossLeaderChargeBuster")

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.random = CS.System.Random()
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.pattern_state_index = 0
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state, self.black_list, false)

		if new_target == nil then
			new_target = self.base_obj
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if self.pattern_state_index == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.continuous_attack_action
		self.pattern_state_index = 1
	elseif self.pattern_state_index == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.missile_rush_action
		self.pattern_state_index = 2
	elseif self.pattern_state_index == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_buster_action
		self.pattern_state_index = 3
	elseif self.pattern_state_index == 3 then
		local count = self:count_enemies_in_range()
		if count >= self.use_rush_count then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.missile_rush_action
			self.pattern_state_index = 0
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.continuous_attack_action
			self.pattern_state_index = 1
		end
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		return
	end

	local new_target = battle_ai_util.search_closest_target(self.cs_state, false, self.black_list)
	self:change_target(new_target)
end

function local_class:count_enemies_in_range()
	local count = 0
	local current_pos = self.character.Position

	if self.rc_sub_system == nil then
		local targets = battle_manager:GetTargets(self.character, true)
		if targets ~= nil then
			for i = 0, targets.Count -1 do
				local target = targets[i]
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) and
						battle_util.distance_between_xz(target.Position, current_pos) <= self.check_enemy_num_range then
					count = count + 1
				end
			end

			targets:Dispose()
		end
		return count
	end

	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do repeat
		local roster = rosters[i]

		-- 필드 위에 있는지
		if not roster.IsPlaying or roster.IsDead then
			break
		end
		local target = roster.Character

		if self.check_enemy_num_range < 0 then
			count = count + 1
			break
		end

		if battle_util.distance_between_xz(target.Position, current_pos) <= self.check_enemy_num_range then
			count = count + 1
		end
	until true end

	return count
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
							random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.continuous_attack_action = nil
	self.missile_rush_action = nil
	self.charge_buster_action = nil

	self.random = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.base_obj = nil
	self.black_list = nil
	self.rc_sub_system = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil

	self.circling_distance = nil
	self.circling_speed_factor = nil

	self.check_enemy_num_range = nil
	self.use_rush_count = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)

	if self.last_battle_action == self.laser_ball_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.magnetic_stone_action

	elseif self.last_battle_action == self.magnetic_stone_action then
		if self.magnetic_stone_action.MetaTable:is_max_stones() then
			local dist = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
			if dist >= self.pollutant_active_distance then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.pollutant_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.punch_action
			end
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.magnetic_stone_action
		end

	elseif self.last_battle_action == self.pollutant_action or self.last_battle_action == self.punch_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		self.charge_count = 0

	elseif self.last_battle_action == self.charge_action then

		if self.remain_stones > 0 then

			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.wide_attack_action
			end
		else

		end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self.time_passed = 0
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
				end
			else
				local dist = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
				if self.picked_battle_action == self.stomp_action
						and self.time_passed < self.stomp_follow_time
						and self.stomp_near_distance < dist then
					local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position):GetX0z().normalized
					local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
					self.character.Direction = look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None and self.character.Direction or look_dir
					return
				else
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
							CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
					else
						self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end
		end
		return
	end
end

	self.character = nil

	self.params_dict = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_mode_one()
	-- first pattern
	if self.last_battle_action == nil then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.magnetic_stone_action
		self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
		return
	end

	-- basic flow
	if self.last_battle_action == self.magnetic_stone_action then
		if self.magnetic_stone_action.MetaTable:is_max_stones() then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.laser_ball_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.magnetic_stone_action
		end

	elseif self.last_battle_action == self.laser_ball_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.drill_punch_action
		self.drill_action_count = 0

	elseif self.last_battle_action == self.drill_punch_action then
		if self.drill_repeat_count > self.drill_action_count then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.drill_punch_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.magnetic_stone_action
		end

	else
		self.picked_battle_action = self.magnetic_stone_action

	end

	-- count
	if self.picked_battle_action == self.laser_ball_action then
		self.laser_action_count = self.laser_action_count + 1
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == self.drill_punch_action then
		self.drill_action_count = self.drill_action_count + 1
		-- is last?
		local is_last = self.drill_action_count >= self.drill_repeat_count
		self.drill_punch_action.MetaTable.is_last = is_last
	end

	self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action

function local_class:pick_battle_action_mode_two()

		self.picked_battle_action = self.drill_punch_action

	elseif self.last_battle_action == self.drill_punch_action then
		if self.core_attack_drill_repeat_count > self.drill_action_count then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.drill_punch_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
		end

	else
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == self.drill_punch_action then
		self.drill_action_count = self.drill_action_count + 1

	end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	self:update_mode(dt, can_control)

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	-- 코어 어택 체크
	if self.current_mode == self.mode.two and self.picked_battle_action ~= self.core_attack_action and self:can_active_qte() then
		self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(false)
		self.core_attack_action.MetaTable.direct_damage = false
		self.picked_battle_action = self.core_attack_action
		self.battle_action_triggered = false
		self.current_rest_time = 0
		return
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		end
	else
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 다음액션 진행
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)

				-- 완료된 액션이 코어어택이었다면 모드 또한 바꿔준다
				if self.last_battle_action == self.core_attack_action then
					self:change_mode(self.mode.one, true)
				end

			end
		else
			-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
			-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true

			elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_rest_time then
				self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_mode(new_mode, is_success)

			self.current_rest_time = 0

		if self.sfx_alret ~= nil then

		self.last_battle_action = nil
		self.battle_action_triggered = false
		self.current_rest_time = 0
		self.drill_action_count = 0
		self.mode_two_count = self.mode_two_count + 1

		if self.fx_cast_pool ~= nil then
			self.fx_cast = self.fx_cast_pool:Instantiate(self.character.Position + vector_util.forward * 0.6)
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'magnet_drop_on' }))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'magwi_mode2_start' }))
		buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, self.buff_name, self.buff_level, true, false)

		local mode2_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
		mode2_info.sfxName = "02_magwi_chargeloop_01"
		mode2_info.loop = true
		mode2_info.parent = self.character
		mode2_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Event
		mode2_info.playerPriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Boss
		self.sfx_mode2 = music_player:PlaySfx(mode2_info)

		local alret_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
		alret_info.sfxName = "01_siren_loop_06"
		alret_info.loop = true
		alret_info.parent = self.character
		alret_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Event
		alret_info.playerPriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Boss
		self.sfx_alret = music_player:PlaySfx(alret_info)

		self.keep_red_tinting = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_red_tinting, self))

		self:set_ailment_resist()
	end

	self.mode_time_passed = 0
	self.current_mode = new_mode
	print('### change_mode = ' .. tostring(new_mode))
end

function local_class:update_mode(dt, can_control)
	if self.current_mode == self.mode.one then
		if can_control and self:check_hp_ratio() then
			self:change_mode(self.mode.two, false)
		end

	elseif self.current_mode == self.mode.two then
		-- 모드2 만 시간 체크 하면 됨
		self.mode_time_passed = self.mode_time_passed + dt

		if self.mode_time_passed >= self.qte_limit_time and self.picked_battle_action ~= self.core_attack_action then
			-- 실패한 거임
			self:change_mode(self.mode.one, false)
			--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'magwi_qte_time_out' }))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'magnet_created' then
		self.qte_zone_ar:Show()

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'magnet_destroyed' then
		self.qte_zone_ar:Hide()

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_magwi_qte_start' then
		self.qte_zone_ar:Hide()
		if self.fx_cast ~= nil then
			self.fx_cast:Dispose()
			self.fx_cast = nil
		end

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_magwi_qte_success' or e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_magwi_qte_fail' then
		-- 그로기 처리를 배틀액션에서 하고 있어서 여기서 버프 날림
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'magnet_drop_off' }))
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, self.buff_name)

		if self.fx_cast ~= nil then
			self.fx_cast:Dispose()
			self.fx_cast = nil
		end

		if self.sfx_mode2 ~= nil then
			self.sfx_mode2:Stop()
			self.sfx_mode2 = nil
		end

		if self.sfx_alret ~= nil then
			self.sfx_alret:Stop()
			self.sfx_alret = nil
		end
		self.keep_red_tinting = false
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	self.qte_zone_ar:Hide()
end

function local_class:check_hp_ratio()
	local lose_ratio = 100 - character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character) * 100
	local active_count = math.floor(lose_ratio / self.core_attack_hp_ratio)
	local result = self.mode_two_count < active_count
	return result
end

function local_class:can_active_qte()
	if self.current_mode ~= self.mode.two then
		return false
	end

	if self.target == nil then return false end

	if not CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.qte_zone_bound, self.field_magnet_obj.Position) or self.field_magnet_obj.Position.y > 0.5 then
		return false
	end

	local current_state = self.target.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	-- 들고있으면 안된다 던져 넣어야한다.
	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- 상태이상 면역 추가
function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun | CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.core_attack_action, options)
end
-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.core_attack_action)
end

function local_class:start_red_tinting()
	local is_tint = false
	local tint_duration = 0.5
	local timer = tint_duration
	local tint_color = unity_class.color.red
	local tint_key = 'boss_magwi_red_alert'

	self.keep_red_tinting = true

	while self.keep_red_tinting do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if not is_tint then
				is_tint = true
				field:Tint(tint_key, tint_color, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = false
				field:RemoveTint(tint_key, tint_duration)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if is_tint then
		field:RemoveTint(tint_key, tint_duration / 3)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), self.on_battle_end_event_func)

	if self.fx_cast ~= nil then
		self.fx_cast:Dispose()
		self.fx_cast = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("BossMagwiGuildBattleAIState")

-- 길드 레이드용 마귀 2페이즈 AI
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	self.flee_state = {
		none = 1,
		flee = 2,
	}

	self.near_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'NearDistance', 3.0)

	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'InitialRestTime', 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MinRestTime', 1.0)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxRestTime', 1.5)

	self.flee_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FleeDistance', 10.0)
	self.flee_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FleeSpeed', 5.0)
	self.flee_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FleeRange', 10.0)
	self.flee_direction = nil
	self.flee_duration = nil
	self.flee_time_passed = 0

	-- 배틀액션 데이터 가져옴..
	self.action_data = battle_util.parse_ai_action_data(params)

	self.action_count = 0
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	self.laser_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self.action_data[1].action_name)
	self.punch_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self.action_data[2].action_name)
	self.charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self.action_data[3].action_name)
	self.elec_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self.action_data[4].action_name)

	self.laser_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.elec_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.last_battle_action = nil

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time

	self:change_flee_state(self.flee_state.none)
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:change_flee_state(new_state)
	if new_state == self.flee_state.flee then
		self.flee_time_passed = 0
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	else
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	self.current_flee_state = new_state
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	end

	local action_idx = self.action_count % 7
	if action_idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.laser_action
	elseif action_idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.punch_action
	elseif action_idx == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.laser_action
	elseif action_idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
	elseif action_idx == 4 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.punch_action
	elseif action_idx == 5 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.laser_action
	elseif action_idx == 6 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.elec_action
	end

	self.action_count = self.action_count + 1
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_flee_state == self.flee_state.flee then
		if self:update_flee(dt) then
			self:change_flee_state(self.flee_state.none)
		end
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil and (self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time or self:check_closer()) then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			return
		end

		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				return
			end

			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
			self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
			return
		end

		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		else
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		end
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed < self.current_rest_time then
			return
		end

		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))

		if self.picked_battle_action == self.laser_action then
			local flee_pos = self:get_flee_pos()
			if flee_pos ~= nil then
				self.flee_pos = flee_pos
				self:change_flee_state(self.flee_state.flee)
			end
		end
		return
	end
end

function local_class:update_flee(dt)
	self.flee_time_passed = self.flee_time_passed + dt

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.flee_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.flee_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, CS.Oak.Direction.Down, false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	return self.flee_time_passed >= self.flee_duration
end

function local_class:get_flee_pos()
	local mag = (self.character.Position - user_party_leader.Position).magnitude
	if mag > self.flee_range then
		return nil
	end

	local target_poses = { user_party_leader.Position }
	local flee_pos = self:search_flee_pos(target_poses)

	if flee_pos == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(flee_pos - self.character.Position)
	self.flee_direction = diff.normalized
	self.flee_duration = diff.magnitude / self.flee_speed

	return flee_pos
end

function local_class:search_flee_pos(pos_list)
	local flee_dist = self.flee_distance
	local flee_dir, free_dist = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.GetBestEtherealFleeDirection(self.cs_state, pos_list, 0, self.flee_distance)

	if vector_util.is_almost_zero(flee_dir) or math.abs(free_dist) < 0.0001 then
		return nil
	end

	local actual_move_dist = math.min(flee_dist, free_dist)
	local dest_pos = self.character.Position + flee_dir * actual_move_dist

	if field:IsThereFloorAt(dest_pos) == false then
		return nil
	end

	return dest_pos
end

function local_class:check_closer()
	if self.target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	return diff <= self.near_distance
end

function local_class:exit()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossMechHellBattleAIState')

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	-- 기본 구현
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	--- 초기 대기 시간
	self.initial_rest_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'InitialRestTime')
	--- 최소 대기 시간
	self.min_rest_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MinRestTime')
	--- 최대 대기 시간
	self.max_rest_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MaxRestTime')
	--- 트리거 상태 유지 시간
	self.max_trigger_try = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MaxTriggerTry')

	--- 패턴 정보 집합체
	local has_param, pattern_params = params:TryGetValue('PatternInfo')
	--- 패턴 정보 테이블
	self.pattern_table = {}
	-- 패턴 정보 집햅체 탐색
	if has_param then
		for _, pattern_param in pairs(pattern_params) do repeat
			--- 패턴 정보
			local pattern_data = {}
			--- 대상 액션 명
			local action_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(pattern_param, 'BattleAction')
			--- 액션 명칭이 없다면 생략함
			if not action_name then
				break
			end
			--- 대상 액션 명
			pattern_data.action_name = action_name
			--- trigger 상태에서 타겟팅을 계속 갱신할 것인지
			pattern_data.dynamic_target_change = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(pattern_param, 'DynamicTargetChange')
			--- 이 거리 안이면 flee를 시도한다.
			pattern_data.min_distance = cs_util.get_nullable_float_from_dictionary(pattern_param, 'MinDistance')
			--- 이 거리 안이면 rest를 시도한다.
			pattern_data.max_distance = cs_util.get_nullable_float_from_dictionary(pattern_param, 'MaxDistance')
			-- 패턴 데이터 할당
			self.pattern_table[action_name] = pattern_data
		until true end
	end

	--- 기본 페이즈 액션 사이클
	self.basic_cycle_names = cs_util.get_string_table_from_dictionary(params, 'BasicCycle')
	--- 하드 페이즈 액션 사이클
	self.hard_cycle_names = cs_util.get_string_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HardCycle')
	--- hp 조건부 패턴
	self.hp_trigger_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'HpTriggerAction')
	--- hp 조건부 패턴 발동 시점
	self.hp_trigger_condition = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'HpTriggerCondition')
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

--- 사이클 처리를 위한 상태들
local cycle_state = {
	--- 초기 대기 상태
	initial_rest = 1,
	--- 액션 시전 상태
	trigger = 2,
	--- 시전 후 대기 상태
	rest = 3
}

function local_class:change_cycle_state(next_state)
	if next_state == cycle_state.initial_rest then
		self:change_idle()
	elseif next_state == cycle_state.trigger then

	elseif next_state == cycle_state.rest then
		--- cycle_state.rest 중에 대기할 시간
		self.current_rest_time = unity_class.random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
		self:change_idle()
	else
		self:change_state(nil)
	end

	-- 지난 시간 초기화
	self.time_passed = 0
	-- 상태 확정
	self.current_cycle_state = next_state
end

--- 페이즈 처리를 위한 값
local phase_state = {
	basic = 1,
	hard = 2
}

function local_class:check_phase2_condition()
	return character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character) <= self.hp_trigger_condition
end

function local_class:get_action_list(phase)
	return phase == phase_state.basic and self.basic_cycle_actions or self.hard_cycle_actions
end

function local_class:enter()
	--- 기본 사이클 액션 테이블
	self.basic_cycle_actions = self:assign_action_list(self.basic_cycle_names)
	--- 강화 사이클 액션 테이블
	self.hard_cycle_actions = self:assign_action_list(self.hard_cycle_names)
	--- hp 트리거 용 액션 할당
	self.hp_trigger_action = battle_util.get_battle_action_by_name(self.character, self.hp_trigger_name)

	--- 액션 테이븦
	self.action_table = {}
	--- 이 캐릭터가 들고있는 액션들
	local held_actions = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions
	--- 순회
	for _, action in pairs(held_actions) do
		table.insert(self.action_table, action)
	end

	--- 액션 인덱스
	self.action_index = 1
	--- 페이즈 설정
	self.current_phase = self:check_phase2_condition() and phase_state.hard or phase_state.basic

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self:change_cycle_state(cycle_state.initial_rest)

	-- 타겟이 존재하면
	if self.target then
		-- 대상이 변경되었음을 커맨드로 공유
		command_util.publish_change_target(self.character, self.target)
	else
		self:change_target()
	end

	--- 데미지 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e) self:on_damage_event(e) end
	-- 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.damage, self.on_damage_event_func)
end

function local_class:assign_action_list(name_list)
	local result = {}
	-- 순회
	for _, action_name in pairs(name_list) do
		local battle_action = battle_util.get_battle_action_by_name(self.character, action_name)

		if battle_action then
			table.insert(result, battle_action)
		end
	end

	return result
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.on_damage_event_func then
		-- 이벤트 구독 취소
		message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.damage, self.on_damage_event_func)
		--- 데미지 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	self:change_cycle_state(nil)

	--- 액션 테이블 할당 해제
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_table)
	self.action_table = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.action_index = nil
	self.current_phase = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	-- cs_state가 해제된 뒤라면 처리할 필요가 없다.
	if not self.cs_state then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟 변경됨 이벤트라면 타겟을 바꿔준다.
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TargetChangedEvent) then
		self.target = e.Target
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:change_target()
	--- 어그로 가장 높은 놈을 타겟팅 한다.
	local new_target = battle_ai_util.search_target(self.cs_state)


	-- 같은 대상이면 굳이 바꿀 필요가 없다.
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = new_target

	-- 대상이 변경되었음을 커맨드로 공유
	command_util.publish_change_target(self.character, self.target)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	--- 액션 사용 상태
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	-- 현재 액션 목록
	local action_list = self:get_action_list(self.current_phase)
	-- 일단 테스트를 위해 단순 패턴 순회
	self.picked_battle_action = action_list[self.action_index]
	-- 대상 변경
	self:change_target()
	-- 액션 인덱스 갱신
	self.action_index = (self.action_index) % #action_list + 1
	-- 이 액션에 지정된 패턴을 가져옴
	self.current_pattern = self.pattern_table[battle_util.get_battle_action_handle_name(self.picked_battle_action)]
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_cycle_state == cycle_state.initial_rest then
		self:wait_for_trigger(self.initial_rest_time)
	elseif self.current_cycle_state == cycle_state.trigger then
		self:update_trigger(dt)
	elseif self.current_cycle_state == cycle_state.rest then
		self:wait_for_trigger(self.current_rest_time)
	end
end

function local_class:wait_for_trigger(target_time)
	--- 대기시간까지 기다린다.
	if self.time_passed < target_time then
		return
	end

	-- 배틀액션 선택
	self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	-- 타겟 선정에 실패한 경우 상태 변화를 생략한다.
	if not self.target then return end
	-- 액션 시전 사이클로 변경
	self:change_cycle_state(cycle_state.trigger)

end

function local_class:update_trigger()
	-- 배틀액션 시전 실패 중 처리
	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
		self.time_passed = 0
		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

		return
	end

	-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 rest로 변경
	if self.battle_action_triggered and not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
		self:change_cycle_state(cycle_state.rest)
		return
	end

	--- 패턴에 따른 서브 스테이트 변경 등을 한다.
	self:update_pattern()

	-- 이미 시전에 성공했다면 아래 로직은 생략한다.
	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		return
	end

	-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
	-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
		CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
		-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
		self.battle_action_triggered = true
	elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_trigger_try then
		-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		else
			-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_pattern()
	-- 대상이 아예 없거나 타겟을 계속 변경하는 패턴인 경우 재 탐색을 한다.
	if self.target == nil or (self.current_pattern and self.current_pattern.dynamic_target_change) then
		self:change_target()
	end

	-- 그럼에도 대상이 없다면 생략한다.
	if self.target == nil then
		return
	end

	-- 패턴 정보가 아예 없는 경우
	if not self.current_pattern then
		self:change_follow()

	-- 패턴 정보가 있는 경우
	else
		-- 원단에서도 center to center로 처리했었기 때문에 동일하게 한다.
		local target_diff = bounds_util.get_center(self.character) - bounds_util.get_center(self.target)
		local target_xz_diff = vector_util.get_x0z(target_diff)
		local target_distance = vector_util.magnitude(target_xz_diff)

		if self.current_pattern.min_distance and  target_distance < self.current_pattern.min_distance then
			self:change_flee()
		elseif self.current_pattern.max_distance and target_distance < self.current_pattern.max_distance  then
			self:change_idle()
		else
			self:change_follow()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_idle()
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		return
	end

	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:change_flee()
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFleeingSubState)) then
		return
	end

	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIFleeingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
end

function local_class:change_follow()
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		return
	end

	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	-- cs_state가 유효할때만 처리함
	if not self.cs_state then return end
	-- 이벤트 대상 검증
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then return end
	--- 이미 페이즈 2에 돌입했다면 생략
	if self.current_phase == phase_state.hard then return end
	--- 페이즈 전환 조건이 성립되지 않은 경우
	if not self:check_phase2_condition() then return end

	--- 페이즈 변경
	self.current_phase = phase_state.hard
	--- 액션 인덱스 초기화
	self.action_index = 1
	--- 모든 배틀액션 캔슬
	self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions()
	--- 걸려있던 상태이상 해제
	message_system_util.send_sync(self.character, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentResetEvent.Instance)
	--- 페이즈 전환 액션으로 강제 할당
	self.picked_battle_action = self.hp_trigger_action
	--- 액션 사용 안한 상태로 변경
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	--- 타겟 갱신
	self:change_target()
	--- 상태 변경
	self:change_cycle_state(cycle_state.trigger)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_damage_event_func then
		-- 이벤트 구독 취소
		message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.damage, self.on_damage_event_func)
		--- 데미지 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass("BossMinisterAIState")

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	-- 기본 구현
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	-- AI 스펙 로드 * 이 시점에서 파싱하고 딕셔너리 굳이 들고 있지 않도록
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 7.0)
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 6.0)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 6.5)
	self.search_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SearchRange", 3)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	self.battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if self.battle_zone_bound == nil then
		self.battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 배틀 액션 데이터
	-- TODO: FIXME: 좀 더 깔끔하게 가져올 수 있도록 해야 함
	self.slash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossMinisterSlash")
	self.jingak_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossMinisterMineJingak")
	self.charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossMinisterChainCharge")
	self.bomb_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossMinisterBombShot")

	self.jingak_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.battle_zone_bound)
	self.charge_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.battle_zone_bound)

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.random = CS.System.Random()
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0
	self.is_center_move = false
	self.sub_state_change_tp = 0

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end


function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

--TODO:
--타입에 맞는 우선 타겟설정 필요 EX) 원거리 > AI > 기타
--기획에 맞는 action순서 설정 필요
function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 5
	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.bomb_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRangedTarget(self.cs_state))
	elseif idx == 1  or idx == 4 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	elseif idx == 2 then
		--1. 3타일이내 적이 2명이상 slash_action
		--2. 원거리적 우선
		--3. slash
		if self:get_target_count_in_range() >= 2 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
			self:change_target()
		elseif CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRangedTarget(self.cs_state) ~= nil then --원거리적 유무 판별
			self.picked_battle_action = self.bomb_action
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRangedTarget(self.cs_state))
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
			self:change_target()
		end
	elseif idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.jingak_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	else
	end
end

function local_class:get_target_count_in_range()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.search_range)

	local count = 0
	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			--타격 가능 대상이면 Count
			count = count + 1
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()

	return count
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.battle_zone_bound = nil

	self.slash_action = nil
	self.jingak_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
	self.bomb_action = nil

	self.random = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState))
	or CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIMovePositionSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
				self.time_passed = 0
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, 3, true))
			else
				self:check_sub_state()
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			self:change_sub_state()
		else
			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self:change_sub_state()
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

--sub_state상태 일때 중앙이동과 주위배회 중 어떤걸 선택할지 체크
--TODO: 좀더 자연스럽게 전환이 필요하다.
function local_class:check_sub_state()
	local dist_to_center = (self.character.Position - self.battle_zone_bound.center).magnitude
	if self.time_passed - self.sub_state_change_tp > 0.3 then

		local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
		local closed_target = true
		if target_list ~= nil then
			for _,v in pairs(target_list) do
				if battle_util.distance_between_xz(v, self.character) <= 0.5 and not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState,
							typeof(CS.Oak.AIMovePositionSubState)) then
						self.sub_state_change_tp = self.time_passed
						self.is_center_move = false
						self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, 4, true, true, 0.2, false, 0.7))
						return
					end
				elseif not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
					closed_target = false
				end
			end
		end

		--if not closed_target then
		--	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState,
		--			typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		--		self.is_center_move = true
		--		self.sub_state_change_tp = self.time_passed
		--		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIMovePositionSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.battle_zone_bound.center, true))
		--		return
		--	end
		--end

		if dist_to_center > 2 then
			if self.is_center_move == false then
				self.is_center_move = true
				self.sub_state_change_tp = self.time_passed
				self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AIMovePositionSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.battle_zone_bound.center, true))
				return
			end
		else
			if self.is_center_move == true then
				self.is_center_move = false
				self.sub_state_change_tp = self.time_passed
				self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, 4, true, true, 0.2, false, 0.7))
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_sub_state()
	local dist_to_center = (self.character.Position - self.battle_zone_bound.center).magnitude
	if dist_to_center > 1 then
		self.is_center_move = true
		self.sub_state_change_tp = self.time_passed
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIMovePositionSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.battle_zone_bound.center, true))
	else
		self.is_center_move = false
		self.sub_state_change_tp = self.time_passed
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, 4, true, true, 0.2, false, 0.7))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState))
	or CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIMovePositionSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리

					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)

					self.battle_action_triggered = true

			end

	end

end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}
