local local_class = newclass('BossOberonPhase1BattleAIState')

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		move = 1, --범위이내로 들어가서 이동 하는 상태
		battle = 2, --배틀액션 사용 가능 상태
		check_position = 3 --현재 위치를 파악
	}

	-- 추적하지 않고 일정 시간 대기 후 다음 패턴으로 감.
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 4)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 5)
	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingDistance', 2.5)
	self.circling_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingSpeed', 2)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingSpeed", 1)
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxFlowTime", 1)

	self.wind_action_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'WindActionCount', 1)

	--벽에 어느정도 접근해야 중앙 텔레포트 할 건지
	self.wall_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BattleDistance', 3)

	--채찍 발동 거리
	self.whip_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'WhipDistance', 5)

	--도망 경과 시간
	self.run_max_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RunawayMaxTime', 1)

	self.phase2_hp = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Phase1HP", 0.8)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentStartedEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Character) then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'remove_all_powder_orb' }))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션
	local battle_zone_bound = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleZoneBounds(self.character).Bounds
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
	end

	self.zone_bounds = battle_zone_bound

	self.battle_action_list = {}
	self.picked_action_index = nil

	self.teleport_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossOberonTeleport")
	self.whip_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossOberonWhip")
	self.missile_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossOberonMissile")
	self.powder_bomb_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossOberonPowderBombing")
	self.powder_explosion_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossOberonPowderexplosion")
	self.wind_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossOberonWind")
	self.powder_bomb_missile_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossOberonPowderBombingMissile")
	self.powder_bomb_marker_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossOberonPowderBombingMarker")

	self.teleport_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.whip_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.wind_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.powder_bomb_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.powder_bomb_missile_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)

	-- 진행시간
	self.time_passed = 0
	-- 도망 경과 시간
	self.runaway_time_passed = 0
	-- 선택된 배틀액션
	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	-- 배틀액션 실행중인지
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0
	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.is_teleport = false
	self.is_explosion = false

	self.current_action_index = 0
	-- 현재 체력에 따라 페이즈 적용해둠
	self.phase = {
		phase1 = 1,
		phase2 = 2
	}

	self.current_phase = self.phase.phase1
	if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 < self.phase2_hp then
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
	end

	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.phase ~= nil and self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
			if character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character) < self.phase2_hp then
				self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
				self.is_phase_0_action = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	--test pattern
	--self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	--self.picked_battle_action = self.powder_bomb_marker_action

	if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 or self.is_phase_0_action then
		self:pick_style_a_battle_action()
	else
		self:pick_style_b_battle_action()
	end

	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	self.current_state = self.state.battle
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:pick_style_a_battle_action()
	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 4
	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.powder_bomb_marker_action
	elseif idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.teleport_action
	elseif idx == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.wind_action
	elseif idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.powder_explosion_action

		if self.is_phase_0_action then
			self.is_phase_0_action = false
			self.battle_action_count = -1
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pick_style_b_battle_action()
	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 12
	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.powder_bomb_marker_action
	elseif idx == 1 or idx == 7 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.powder_bomb_missile_action
	elseif idx == 2 or idx == 8 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.teleport_action
	elseif idx == 3 or idx == 9 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.wind_action
	elseif idx == 4 then
		if self:check_whip_distance() then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.whip_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.missile_action
			self.is_teleport = true
		end
	elseif idx == 5 or idx == 11 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.powder_explosion_action
	elseif idx == 6 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.powder_bomb_action
	elseif idx == 10 then
		if self:check_whip_distance() then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.whip_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.missile_action
		end
		self.is_teleport = true
	end
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	for _,v in pairs(self.battle_action_list) do
		v = nil
	end

	if zone_name then
		zone_bound = field:GetZone(zone_name).Bounds
	else
		zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	end

		zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	if action_idx == 0 then
		-- 기관총
		self.picked_battle_action = self.gun_action
	elseif action_idx == 1 then
		-- 극저온 폭탄
		self.picked_battle_action = self.bomb_action
	elseif action_idx == 2 then
		-- 갈고리 발사
		self.picked_battle_action = self.hook_shot_action
	elseif action_idx == 3 then
		-- 충격파
		self.picked_battle_action = self.big_wave_action
	end

	self:change_target_with_battle_action(self.picked_battle_action)
end

function local_class:change_target_with_battle_action(battle_action)
	local new_target = nil
	if battle_action == self.gun_action or battle_action == self.bomb_action then
		new_target = battle_ai_util.search_closest_target(self.cs_state, false, self.black_list)
		if new_target == nil then
			new_target = self.base_obj
		end
	end
	self:change_target(new_target)
end

function local_class:get_action_index()
	if self.pattern_state == 0 then
		self.pattern_state = 1
		return 0
	elseif self.pattern_state == 1 then
		self.pattern_state = 2
		return 1
	elseif self.pattern_state == 2 then
		self.pattern_state = 3
		return 2
	elseif self.pattern_state == 3 then
		self.pattern_state = 4

		local random = random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5
		if random then
			return 0
		else
			return 1
		end
	elseif self.pattern_state == 4 then
		self.pattern_state = 0
		return 3
	end
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.cs_state.CurrentState == nil then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- rest time
	if self.time_passed < self.rest_time then
		return
	end

	-- rest time 끝나면 바로 배틀액션 시작
	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		self:pick_battle_action()
		return
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 다음액션 진행
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
			if self.min_rest_time >= self.max_rest_time then
				self.rest_time = self.min_rest_time
			else
				self.rest_time = self.min_rest_time + math.random() * (self.max_rest_time - self.min_rest_time)
			end
		end
	else
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
			self.rest_time = 0
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		else
			-- 임시로 일단 다음 패턴으로 안 넘기고 타겟만 다시 찾음
			self:change_target_with_battle_action(self.picked_battle_action)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state, self.black_list, false)

		if new_target == nil then
			new_target = self.base_obj
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
	self.black_list = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

	if not can_control then

	end

	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target()
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		return
	end

	--TOOD:메뉴얼캐릭 또는 존외곽과의 거리에 따른 행동 결정정
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.check_position then
		self:update_state()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 거리 파악해서 다음행동 이행
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false

				self.current_rest_time = self.action_data[self.picked_action_index].rest_time
				self.current_state = self.state.check_position
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
			end
		else
			-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
			-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
				-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
		if self.runaway_time_passed > self.run_max_time then
			self.current_state = self.state.none
			self.runaway_time_passed = 0
		else
			self.runaway_time_passed = self.runaway_time_passed + dt
		end

		--이동하면서 거리유지
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
			if not self:is_come_close_target() then
				self:update_state()
			end
		else
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
					random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, true, self.circling_speed))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_state()
	--타겟 거리에 따른 state설정
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < self.battle_distance then
		self.current_state = self.state.move
	else
		self.current_state = self.state.none
	end

	if self.current_state ~= self.state.move then
		self.runaway_time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:is_come_close_target()
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < self.battle_distance then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:check_battle_zone_for_runaway()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.wall_distance)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.action_data = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)

	end

		return
	end

	--TOOD:메뉴얼캐릭 또는 존외곽과의 거리에 따른 행동 결정정
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.check_position then
		self:update_state()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 거리 파악해서 다음행동 이행
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false

				self.current_rest_time = self.action_data[self.picked_action_index].rest_time
				self.time_passed = 0

				self.current_state = self.state.check_position
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
			end
		else
			-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
			-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
				-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
		if self.runaway_time_passed > self.run_max_time then
			self.current_state = self.state.none
			self.runaway_time_passed = 0
		else
			self.runaway_time_passed = self.runaway_time_passed + dt
		end

		--이동하면서 거리유지
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
			if not self:is_come_close_target() then
				self:update_state()
			end
		else
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_state()
	--타겟 거리에 따른 state설정
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if self.time_passed < self.current_rest_time then
		self.current_state = self.state.move
	else
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
		self.current_state = self.state.none
	end

	if self.current_state ~= self.state.move then
		self.runaway_time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:is_come_close_target()
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < self.battle_distance then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:check_battle_zone_for_runaway()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.wall_distance)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do

			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,

		end

	end

		stage.FieldUIManager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, self.character)
	end

		self.dark_zone_fx:Dispose()
		self.dark_zone_end_fx_pool:Instantiate(self.character.Bounds.center)
		self.dark_zone_fx = nil
	end

	if self.dark_zone_stage_fx ~= nil then
		self.dark_zone_stage_fx:Dispose()
		self.dark_zone_stage_end_fx_pool:Instantiate(self.character.Position)
		self.dark_zone_stage_fx = nil
	end

		self.heart.fx:Dispose()
		self.heart.fx = nil
		self.heart_end_fx_pool:Instantiate(self.heart.vfo.Bounds.center)

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Info.target) then
		self:handle_damage_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:handle_damage_event(e)
	if self.hp_idx < self.dark_zone_hp.Count and not self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.dark_zone_hp[self.hp_idx] then
			self.hp_idx = self.hp_idx + 1

			if self.heart.vfo.ActiveState & CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
				return
			end

			if self.current_action ~= nil and CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.current_action) then
				if self.current_action.MetaTable:is_cast_or_post() then
					self.current_action.MetaTable:force_cancel()
					self:change_state(self.state.dark_zone)
				else
					self.priority_state = self.state.dark_zone
				end
			elseif self.current_state == self.state.rest then
				self:change_state(self.state.dark_zone)

			elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
				self.priority_state = self.state.dark_zone

			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action()

	self.battle_action_index = self.battle_action_index < 0
			and self.battle_action_index + 1
			or self.battle_action_index % #self.battle_action_index_map + 1
	self:change_target_with_picked_action()
end

function local_class:change_target_with_picked_action()
	self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state)
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.heart.fx ~= nil then
		self:update_weakness(dt)
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local current_action = self:determine_action()

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then
		if self.time_passed > self.rest_duration then
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(current_action, self.target) then
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, current_action)
				self.current_action = current_action
				self:change_state(self.state.battle)
				return
			end
			self:pick_battle_action()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.current_action == nil or not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.current_action) then
			self:pick_battle_action()
			if self.priority_state ~= nil then
				self:change_state(self.priority_state)
				self.priority_state = nil
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.rest)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dark_zone then
		if self.time_passed > self.dark_zone_cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.rest)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:determine_action()
	local current_table = self.battle_action_index_map[self.battle_action_index]
	local current_action = nil

	if current_table['force'] ~= nil then
		current_action = current_table['force']
		current_table['force'] = nil
	else
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, #current_table)
		current_action = current_table[rand]
		if self.battle_action_index == 4 then
			current_table['force'] = current_table[rand % 2 + 1]
		end
	end

	return current_action
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == self.state.dark_zone then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_plagueboss_curtain_02')
		self.dark_zone_fx = self.dark_zone_fx_pool:Instantiate(self.character.Bounds.center + vector_util.up * 0.75)
		self.dark_zone_stage_fx = self.dark_zone_stage_fx_pool:Instantiate(self.character.Position)
		self:instantiate_heart()
		self:reset_ailment()
		field:Darken('dark_zone', self.tint_magnitude, 0.5)
		buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, self.buff_name, self.defense_buff_level, true, false)

		stage.FieldUIManager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, self.character)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('cast_dark_curtain_end', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false, 1, 0.7))
		self:propagate_dark_zone_state(true)
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.dark_zone then
		self:set_ailment_resist()

		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('cast_dark_curtain_ready', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false, 1, -1, nil, nil, 'cast_dark_curtain'))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.dark_zone_cast_duration))
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_plagueboss_curtain_01')
	end
end

function local_class:propagate_dark_zone_state(is_activated)
	if self.matter_action ~= nil then
		self.matter_action.MetaTable:set_dark_zone_state(is_activated)
	end

	if self.eruption_action ~= nil then
		self.eruption_action.MetaTable:set_dark_zone_state(is_activated)
	end

	if self.rush_action ~= nil then
		self.rush_action.MetaTable:set_dark_zone_state(is_activated)
	end

	if self.wave_action ~= nil then
		self.wave_action.MetaTable:set_dark_zone_state(is_activated)
	end
end

function local_class:instantiate_heart()
	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target_with_picked_action()
	end

	local pos = self.heart_pos_candidate[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.heart_pos_candidate)]
	while (pos.x - self.character.Position.x) * (self.target.Position.x - self.character.Position.x) > 0 and (pos.z - self.character.Position.z) * (self.target.Position.z * self.character.Position.z) > 0 do
		pos = self.heart_pos_candidate[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.heart_pos_candidate)]
	end

	self.heart.vfo.Position = pos
	self:activate_virtual_fo()

	self:set_heart_hp_bar()

	self.heart.fx = self.heart_fx_pool:Instantiate(self.heart.vfo.Bounds.center)
end

function local_class:set_heart_hp_bar()
	local ui_dict = stage.FieldUIManager:SetUI(self.heart.vfo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	self.timer_bar = ui_dict[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
	self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(75)
	self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, self.heart.vfo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP)
	self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetColor(unity_class.color.red)

	self.timer_bar.BarSprite.Transform.position = self.heart.vfo.Bounds.center + vector_util.up
end

function local_class:update_heart_hp_bar()
	self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.heart.vfo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP, 0)
end

function local_class:activate_virtual_fo()
	local fo_spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('FieldObjectSpecs'):GetSpec(self.heart_spec_id)

	self.heart.vfo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour = CS.Oak.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour()
	self.heart.vfo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec = fo_spec

	self.heart.vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state, options)

end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state)
end

function local_class:update_weakness(dt)
	self:update_heart_hp_bar()

	self.heart.time_passed = self.heart.time_passed + dt
	if self.heart.time_passed > self.weakness_pos_change_time then
		self.heart.time_passed = 0
		self:change_weakness_position()
	end
end

function local_class:change_weakness_position()
	local pos = self.heart_pos_candidate[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.heart_pos_candidate)]
	while (pos.x - self.character.Position.x) * (self.target.Position.x - self.character.Position.x) > 0
			and (pos.z - self.character.Position.z) * (self.target.Position.z * self.character.Position.z) > 0
			or vector_util.is_almost_zero(pos - self.heart.vfo.Position) do
		pos = self.heart_pos_candidate[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.heart_pos_candidate)]
	end

	--disappear fx
	self.heart_end_fx_pool:Instantiate(self.heart.vfo.Bounds.center)
	self.heart.fx:Dispose()
	self.heart.vfo.Position = pos
	self.heart.fx = self.heart_fx_pool:Instantiate(self.heart.vfo.Bounds.center)
	self.timer_bar.BarSprite.Transform.position = self.heart.vfo.Bounds.center + vector_util.up
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.wave_action = nil
	self.rush_action = nil
	self.eruption_action = nil
	self.matter_action = nil
	self:dispose_dark_zone()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func)
	self.dark_zone_hp = nil

	self.heart.vfo = nil
	self.heart = nil

	self.dark_zone_fx_pool = nil

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, self.character) then
		if self.is_leader_in_ailment and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, user_party.Leader) then
			return
		end

		if self.ailment_dict[e.Info.target] ~= nil then
			self.ailment_dict[e.Info.target].ailment_ui:SetAilment()
			self.ailment_dict[e.Info.target].time_passed = 0
		else
			local po = self.ailment_ui_pool:Instantiate(e.Info.target.Position + vector_util.up * 2, unity_class.quaternion.identity, e.Info.target.Transform)

				po = po,

				ailment_ui = po:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.AilmentsUI)),
				time_passed = 0
			}
			ailment_info.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
			ailment_info.transform.localScale = vector(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
			CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(po.transform, 'Default')
			ailment_info.ailment_ui:Init(e.Info.target)
			ailment_info.ailment_ui:SetAilment()
			self.ailment_dict[e.Info.target] = ailment_info
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) and lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.MonsterCheckDistanceDamagedBehaviour) then
		if vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, e.Info.sender.Position) > self.character.DamagedBehaviour.MaxDist then

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
end

function local_class:dispose_all_ailment_ui()

		ui_table.ailment_ui:Dispose()
		ui_table.po:Dispose()

		self.ailment_dict[character] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action()

	self.battle_action_index = self.battle_action_index < 0
			and self.battle_action_index + 1
			or self.battle_action_index % #self.battle_action_index_map + 1
	self:change_target_with_picked_action()
end

function local_class:change_target_with_picked_action()
	self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state)
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	--testplague
	--self.teleport_action.MetaTable:update_test(dt)

	self:check_ailment(dt)

	self:update_ailment_ui(dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local current_action = self:determine_action()

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then
		if self.time_passed > self:get_rest_duration() then
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(current_action, self.target) then
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, current_action)
				self.current_action = current_action
				self:change_state(self.state.battle)
				return
			end
			self:pick_battle_action()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.current_action == nil or not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.current_action) then
			self:pick_battle_action()
			self:change_state(self.state.rest)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_ailment_ui(dt)
	for character, ui_table in pairs(self.ailment_dict) do
		ui_table.time_passed = ui_table.time_passed + dt

		if ui_table.time_passed > self.ailment_ui_show_time or self.is_leader_in_ailment and lua_helper.reference_equals(character, user_party.Leader) then
			ui_table.ailment_ui:Dispose()
			ui_table.po:Dispose()

			self.ailment_dict[character] = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_ailment(dt)
	self.ailment_time_passed = self.ailment_time_passed + dt

	self.is_leader_in_ailment = lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterDownState)

	if self.is_leader_in_ailment and self.ailment_time_passed > self.judge_cool_time then
		self.ailment_time_passed = 0

		if self.current_action ~= nil and CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.current_action) then
			self.current_action.MetaTable:force_cancel()
		end
		self.priority_action = self.judge_action
		self:change_state(self.state.rest)
		self.time_passed = self:get_rest_duration() + 1
	end
end

function local_class:determine_action()
	local current_table = self.battle_action_index_map[self.battle_action_index]
	local current_action = nil

	self.is_aerial = self.teleport_action.MetaTable:is_aerial_state()

	if self.priority_action ~= nil then
		current_action = self.priority_action
		self.priority_action = nil
	elseif current_table['aerial'] ~= nil then
		if self.is_aerial then
			current_action = current_table['aerial']
		else
			current_action = current_table['stage']
		end
	else
		current_action = current_table['default']
	end

	current_action.MetaTable:set_aerial_state(self.is_aerial)

	return current_action
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then
		if not self.is_aerial then
			self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
		else
			self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_rest_duration()
	return self.is_aerial and self.rest_duration_aerial or self.rest_duration_stage
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_all_ailment_ui()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.teleport_action = nil
	self.phantom_sword_action = nil
	self.phantom_dash_action = nil
	self.sword_storm_action = nil
	self.judge_action = nil
	self.current_action = nil

	self.battle_action_index_map = nil

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossPlagueMonsterFatBattleAIState')

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	-- 기본 구현
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	-- 공통 스펙 로드
	self.idle_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'IdleTime', 1)
	local range_usable_dist = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RangeActionUsableDistance', 4)
	self.sqr_range_usable_dist = range_usable_dist * range_usable_dist
	self.dist_from_edge = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DistanceFromEdge', 1)

	-- Circling AI 스펙 로드
	self.circling_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingRadius', 2)
	self.is_circling_clock_wise = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsCirclingClockWise', true)
	self.circling_change_direction = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingChangeDirection', true)
	self.circling_change_direction_Period = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingChangeDirectionPeriod', 3)
	self.is_dash_circling = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsDashCircling', true)
	self.circle_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CircleTime', 3)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingSpeed', 0.5)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 할당
	local get_battle_zone_name = CS.Oak.IFieldObjectControllerExtensions.GetZone(self.character.FieldObjectController)
	local battle_zone = field:GetZone(get_battle_zone_name)
	self.battle_zone_bound = nil
	if battle_zone ~= nil then
		self.battle_zone_bound = battle_zone.Bounds
	else
		self.battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	end
	if self.battle_zone_bound == nil then
		self.battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 배틀액션 로드
	local actions = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions
	for i = 0, actions.Count - 1 do
		--- 현재 인덱스의 액션
		local current_action = actions[i]
		--- 액션의 핸들네임
		local handle_name = battle_util.get_battle_action_handle_name(current_action)

		if string.find(handle_name, 'MinotaursSlash') then
			self.slash_action = current_action
		elseif string.find(handle_name, 'BossPlagueFatCharge') then
			self.charge_action = current_action
		elseif string.find(handle_name, 'BossPlagueFatShockWave') then
			self.shock_action = current_action
		elseif string.find(handle_name, 'BossPlagueFatStomp') then
			self.stomp_action = current_action
			self.stomp_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.battle_zone_bound)
		end
	end

	-- 내부 변수 설정
	self.first_battle_action = true
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self:set_melee_action_seed()

	-- 상태 변경 (필요할지 모름)
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_radius, self.is_circling_clock_wise, self.circling_change_direction, self.circling_change_direction_Period, self.is_dash_circling, self.circling_speed_factor))
end

-- 근접액션 랜덤값 설정
function local_class:set_melee_action_seed()
	self.melee_action_seed = random_util.get_random_int(0, 9)
	self.melee_action_count = 0
end

-- 배틀액션 선택
function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self:change_target()

	local dist_vec = self.character.Position - self.target.Position
	local distance = dist_vec.sqrMagnitude

	if self:is_place_on_edge() then
		-- 배틀존 가장자리에 있을때
		self.picked_battle_action = self.stomp_action
	elseif self.first_battle_action or distance < self.sqr_range_usable_dist then
		-- 최초 배틀액션 or 근거리
		self.first_battle_action = false

		if self.melee_action_count > 1 then
			self:set_melee_action_seed()
		end

		if (self.melee_action_seed + self.melee_action_count) % 2 == 0 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.shock_action
		end

		self.melee_action_count = self.melee_action_count + 1
	else
		-- 원거리
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
	end
end

function local_class:is_place_on_edge()
	local diff = self.battle_zone_bound.center - self.character.Position

	if math.abs(diff.x) > self.battle_zone_bound.extents.x - self.dist_from_edge then
		return true
	elseif math.abs(diff.z) > self.battle_zone_bound.extents.z - self.dist_from_edge then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 보조상태 변경, 지난 시간 초기화
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = nil

		local manual_targets = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchManualCharacterTargets(self.cs_state)
		if manual_targets ~= nil and manual_targets.Count > 0 then
			new_target = manual_targets[0]
		end
		manual_targets:Dispose()

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		if new_target == nil then
			new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
				return
			end
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:exit()
	-- 배틀존 해제
	self.battle_zone_bound = nil

	-- 배틀액션 해제
	self.slash_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
	self.shock_action = nil
	self.stomp_action = nil

	-- 내부 변수 해제
	self.first_battle_action = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.melee_action_seed = nil
	self.melee_action_count = nil

	self.time_passed = nil
	return
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	-- Circling 보조상태이면 이동만 하도록
	if(CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState))) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.circle_time then
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
		end
		return
	end

	if(CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState))) then
		-- 배틀액션이 선택 안된경우 배틀액션 설정
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		end

		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 배틀액션이 끝났으면 선택된 액션 초기화
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_radius, self.is_circling_clock_wise, self.circling_change_direction, self.circling_change_direction_Period, self.is_dash_circling, self.circling_speed_factor))
			end
		else
			-- 공격 가능한지 체크 후 배틀액션 실행
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
				-- 대기시간동안 배틀액션 실행을 못했을 경우 다시 선정
			elseif self.time_passed >= self.idle_time then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false;
			end
		end
		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.idle_time = nil
	self.sqr_range_usable_dist = nil
	self.dist_from_edge = nil

	-- Circling AI 스펙 해제
	self.circling_radius = nil
	self.is_circling_clock_wise = nil
	self.circling_change_direction = nil
	self.circling_change_direction_Period = nil
	self.is_dash_circling = nil
	self.circling_time = nil
	self.circling_speed_factor = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == nil then return end

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then

		self.current_move_state = self.move_state.none

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.picked_battle_action = nil
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)

	else
	end

	if next_state == self.state.rest then
		-- 휴식중엔 할게 없다.
	elseif next_state == self.state.move then
		self.current_location =  self:pick_next_location()
		self.destination = self.move_points[self.current_location]
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance

		self.prev_used_action = nil

		self.sfx_move_info.playPosition = self.character.Position

		self.character_stat_field_ui.Offset.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.character_stat_field_ui:Hide(0)

		--이동 방향에 따른 애니메이션 세팅
		if self.destination.x < self.character.Position.x then
			self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('mad_move_left', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false))
		else
			self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('mad_move_right', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false))
		end

		self.current_move_state = self.move_state.moving

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		self.battle_action_triggered = false
	else
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

-- 타겟 전환
function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:change_location(next_location)
	if next_location == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.current_location == self.location_key.left then
	elseif self.current_location == self.location_key.center then
	elseif self.current_location == self.location_key.right then
	else
	end

	if next_location == self.location_key.left then
	elseif next_location == self.location_key.center then
	elseif next_location == self.location_key.right then
	else
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_location = next_location
end

-- 배틀액션 선택 및 타겟 변경
function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if self.last_battle_action ~= nil then	--최초가 아니라면 패턴에 맞게 선택한다.
		if self.last_battle_action == self.action_drain then	--드레인 -> 메테오 스트라이크
			if self.current_location == self.location_key.left then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.action_meteor
				self:change_target()
			elseif self.current_location == self.location_key.right then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.action_thunder
				self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.action_dark_missile
				self:change_target()
			end

		elseif self.last_battle_action == self.action_sentry then		--센트리인 경우
			self.picked_battle_action = self.action_drain            --드레인으로 넘어간다
			self:change_target()
		elseif self.last_battle_action == self.action_ice_orb then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.action_sentry
			self:change_target()
		elseif self.last_battle_action == self.action_meteor or
				self.last_battle_action == self.action_thunder or
				self.last_battle_action == self.action_dark_missile then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.action_ice_orb
			self:change_target()
			self.prev_used_action = nil
		else
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('[BossPortrait] Picking battle action sequence fail')
		end
	else	--최초라면 다-크 미사일
		self.picked_battle_action = self.action_dark_missile
		self:change_target()
	end
end

function local_class:pick_next_location()
	local value = random_util.get_random_value()
	if self.current_location == self.location_key.left then		--왼쪽에 있었다면
		if value > 0.5 then
			return self.location_key.center
		else
			return self.location_key.right
		end
	elseif self.current_location == self.location_key.center then		--가운데 있었다면
		if value > 0.5 then
			return self.location_key.left
		else
			return self.location_key.right
		end
	else			-- 오른쪽에 있었다면
		if value > 0.5 then
			return self.location_key.center
		else
			return self.location_key.left
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
	self.character.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = self.prev_always_update_spine
	self.character.CharacterBehaviour:UnsetResetAction(self.cs_state)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end


-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then		--RestState
		if self.time_passed >= self.rest_time then
			if is_unity_null(self.target) == false then
				self:change_state(self.state.action)			--parentAI.stateMachine.ChangeState(UseBattleActionState.Create(parentAI, parentAI.PickNextActionKey()));
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then		--MoveState
		if self.current_move_state == self.move_state.moving then
			if self.time_passed >= self.move_anim_duration then

				self.sfx_laugh_info.playPosition = self.destination
				music_player:PlaySfx(self.sfx_laugh_info)

				--이동 방향에 따른 애니메이션 세팅
				if self.destination.x < self.character.Position.x then
					self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('mad_move_left_end', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, false))
				else
					self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('mad_move_right_end', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, false))
				end

				self.character.Position = self.destination
				--self.current_location = self.destination_key
				self.time_passed = 0
				self.current_move_state = self.move_state.showing

			end
		elseif self.current_move_state == self.move_state.showing then
			if self.time_passed >= self.showing_anim_duration then
				self.character_stat_field_ui.Offset.gameObject:SetActive(true)
				self.character_stat_field_ui:Show()
				self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create()

				self.time_passed = 0
				self.current_move_state = self.move_state.move_end
			end

		elseif self.current_move_state == self.move_state.move_end then
			if self.time_passed >= self.move_end_anim_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.action)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then		--UseBattleActionState
		if self.battle_action_triggered == true then			--BattleAction 트리거 성공
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) == false then		--IsActive로 이중 체크
				if self.last_battle_action == self.action_drain then		--마지막이 드레인이였다면
					if self:can_trigger_battle_action() == true then
						self:change_state(self.state.move)
					end
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.rest)
				end
			end
		else
			-- 배틀액션을 쏘지 못하고 시간이 다 지나버렸다면, 일단 휴식상태로 돌린다.	--확인 필요하다
			if self.time_passed >= self.use_battle_action_time then
				self:change_state(self.state.rest)

			elseif self:battle_action_is_hittable() == true then
				if self:trigger_battle_action() == true then
					self.battle_action_triggered = true


					if self.last_battle_action == self.action_sentry or self.last_battle_action == self.action_ice_orb then
						if self.is_first_pattern == true then
							self.prev_used_action = self.last_battle_action
						end
					end
					self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
				else
					self:change_target(nil)
				end
			end
		end

	end
end

function local_class:can_trigger_battle_action()
	return CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stunned)
end

function local_class:battle_action_is_hittable()
	return CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target)
end

function local_class:trigger_battle_action()
	return CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.action_dark_missile = nil
	self.action_drain = nil
	self.action_ice_orb = nil
	self.action_meteor = nil
	self.action_sentry = nil
	self.action_thunder = nil

	self.character_stat_field_ui = nil
	self.last_battle_action = nil
	self.prev_used_action = nil
	self.location_key = nil

	self.move_points = nil
	self.move_state = nil
	self.sfx_laugh_info = nil
	self.sfx_move_info = nil

	self.destination = nil

	self.state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

-- 배틀액션 선택 및 타겟 변경
function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self:change_target()

	if self.last_battle_action ~= nil then	--최초가 아니라면 패턴에 맞게 선택한다.
		if self.last_battle_action == self.action_drain then	--드레인 -> 메테오 스트라이크
			self.picked_battle_action = self.action_meteor_strike

		elseif self.last_battle_action == self.action_meteor_strike then	--메테오 스트라이크 -> 위치별 스킬
			if self.current_location == self.location_key.left then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.action_meteor
			elseif self.current_location == self.location_key.right then
				if self.is_new_thunder then
					self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
				end
				self.picked_battle_action = self.action_thunder
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.action_dark_missile
			end

		elseif self.last_battle_action == self.action_sentry then		--센트리인 경우
			if self.is_first_pattern == true then
				if self.prev_used_action ~= nil and self.prev_used_action == self.action_ice_orb then
					--이전이 아이스 오브였다면
					self.picked_battle_action = self.action_drain            --드레인으로 넘어간다
					self.is_first_pattern = false
				else
					self.picked_battle_action = self.action_ice_orb
				end
			else
				self.is_first_pattern = true
				local value = random_util.get_random_value()
				if value > 0.5 then
					if self.is_new_thunder then
						self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
					end
					self.picked_battle_action = self.action_thunder
				else
					self.picked_battle_action = self.action_dark_missile
				end
			end

		elseif self.last_battle_action == self.action_ice_orb then
			if self.is_first_pattern == true then
				if self.prev_used_action ~= nil and self.prev_used_action == self.action_sentry then
					self.picked_battle_action = self.action_drain
					self.is_first_pattern = false
				else
					self.picked_battle_action = self.action_sentry
				end
			else
				self.is_first_pattern = true
				local value = random_util.get_random_value()
				if value > 0.5 then
					if self.is_new_thunder then
						self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
					end
					self.picked_battle_action = self.action_thunder
				else
					self.picked_battle_action = self.action_dark_missile
				end
			end

		elseif self.last_battle_action == self.action_meteor or
				self.last_battle_action == self.action_thunder or
				self.last_battle_action == self.action_dark_missile then
			local value = random_util.get_random_value()
			if value > 0.5 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.action_sentry
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.action_ice_orb
			end
			self.prev_used_action = nil

		else
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('[BossPortrait] Picking battle action sequence fail')
		end
	else	--최초라면 무작위로 썬더와 다-크 미사일중 고른다.
		local value = random_util.get_random_value()
		if value > 0.5 then
			if self.is_new_thunder then
				self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
			end
			self.picked_battle_action = self.action_thunder
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.action_dark_missile
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pick_next_location()
	local value = random_util.get_random_value()
	if self.current_location == self.location_key.left then		--왼쪽에 있었다면
		if value > 0.5 then
			return self.location_key.center
		else
			return self.location_key.right
		end
	elseif self.current_location == self.location_key.center then		--가운데 있었다면
		if value > 0.5 then
			return self.location_key.left
		else
			return self.location_key.right
		end
	else			-- 오른쪽에 있었다면
		if value > 0.5 then
			return self.location_key.center
		else
			return self.location_key.left
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
	self.character.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = self.prev_always_update_spine
	self.character.CharacterBehaviour:UnsetResetAction(self.cs_state)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end


-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then		--RestState
		if self.time_passed >= self.rest_time then
			if is_unity_null(self.target) == false then
				self:change_state(self.state.action)			--parentAI.stateMachine.ChangeState(UseBattleActionState.Create(parentAI, parentAI.PickNextActionKey()));
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then		--MoveState
		if self.current_move_state == self.move_state.moving then
			if self.time_passed >= self.move_anim_duration then

				self.sfx_laugh_info.playPosition = self.destination
				music_player:PlaySfx(self.sfx_laugh_info)

				--이동 방향에 따른 애니메이션 세팅
				if self.destination.x < self.character.Position.x then
					self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('mad_move_left_end', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, false))
				else
					self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('mad_move_right_end', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, false))
				end

				self.character.Position = self.destination
				--self.current_location = self.destination_key
				self.time_passed = 0
				self.current_move_state = self.move_state.showing

			end
		elseif self.current_move_state == self.move_state.showing then
			if self.time_passed >= self.showing_anim_duration then
				self.character_stat_field_ui.Offset.gameObject:SetActive(true)
				self.character_stat_field_ui:Show()
				self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create()

				self.time_passed = 0
				self.current_move_state = self.move_state.move_end
			end

		elseif self.current_move_state == self.move_state.move_end then
			if self.time_passed >= self.move_end_anim_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.action)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then		--UseBattleActionState
		if self.battle_action_triggered == true then			--BattleAction 트리거 성공
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) == false then		--IsActive로 이중 체크
				if self.last_battle_action == self.action_drain then		--마지막이 드레인이였다면
					if self:can_trigger_battle_action() == true then
						self:change_state(self.state.move)
					end
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.rest)
				end
			end
		else
			-- 배틀액션을 쏘지 못하고 시간이 다 지나버렸다면, 일단 휴식상태로 돌린다.	--확인 필요하다
			if self.time_passed >= self.use_battle_action_time then
				self:change_state(self.state.rest)

			elseif self:battle_action_is_hittable() == true then
				if self:trigger_battle_action() == true then
					self.battle_action_triggered = true


					if self.last_battle_action == self.action_sentry or self.last_battle_action == self.action_ice_orb then
						if self.is_first_pattern == true then
							self.prev_used_action = self.last_battle_action
						end
					end
					self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
				else
					self:change_target(nil)
				end
			end
		end

	end
end

function local_class:can_trigger_battle_action()
	return CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stunned)
end

function local_class:battle_action_is_hittable()
	return CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target)
end

function local_class:trigger_battle_action()
	return CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.action_dark_missile = nil
	self.action_drain = nil
	self.action_ice_orb = nil
	self.action_meteor = nil
	self.action_meteor_strike = nil
	self.action_sentry = nil
	self.action_thunder = nil

	self.character_stat_field_ui = nil
	self.last_battle_action = nil
	self.prev_used_action = nil
	self.location_key = nil

	self.move_points = nil
	self.move_state = nil
	self.sfx_laugh_info = nil
	self.sfx_move_info = nil

	self.destination = nil

	self.state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
	end

		black_matter_action_name = "BossPriscillaBlackMatter"
	else
		black_matter_action_name = "BossPriscillaBlackMatter:"..self.black_matter_action_postfix
	end

	self.thunder_bolt_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossPriscillaThunderbolt")

		resentment_action_name = "BossPriscillaResentment"

		resentment_action_name = "BossPriscillaResentment:"..self.resentment_action_postfix
	end

	local center = battle_zone_bound.center
	local modX = battle_zone_bound.size.x / 3
	local modZ = battle_zone_bound.size.z / 3
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX, battle_zone_bound.size.y, modZ)

	self.sliced_zone_bounds = {}
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, modZ), size))

	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, 0), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, -modZ), size))

	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)

	local zone = battle_util.get_zone(self.character.Position)
	-- 보스이름 세팅 하여 컨트롤러 동작 하도록 수정됨
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {
		'init_bead_controller',
		self.character.Name,
		-- 존도 여기서 찾아서 세팅하도록 함.
		zone.Name
	}))

	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	-- 구슬 갯수 증감 이벤트
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'blood_bead_create' then
		self.current_bead_count = self.current_bead_count + 1
		self:check_bead_count()
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'blood_bead_dispose' then
		self.current_bead_count = self.current_bead_count - 1
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:check_bead_count()
	if self.picked_battle_action == self.explosion_action then
		return
	end
	-- 현재 구슬 갯수가 일정 이상 초과 시
	if self.current_bead_count >= self.explosion_bead_count then
		-- 진행중인 배틀액션 모두 취소시킴
		self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
		self.battle_action_triggered = false
		self.picked_battle_action = self.explosion_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
	end
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if self.ready_teleport then
		self.teleport_action.MetaTable:set_destination(self:decide_teleport_destination())
		self.picked_battle_action = self.teleport_action
		self:change_target()
	else
		local idx = self.battle_action_count % 4
		if idx == 0 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.summon_action
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		elseif idx == 1 then
			local action_idx = random_util.get_random_int(0, 1)
			if action_idx == 0 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.black_matter_action
				self.next_action = self.thunder_bolt_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.thunder_bolt_action
				self.next_action = self.black_matter_action
			end
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		elseif idx == 2 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.resentment_action
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		elseif idx == 3 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.next_action
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:decide_teleport_destination()
	-- 순간이동 위치 결정
	local available_points = {}

	for _, bound in ipairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
		-- 현재 캐릭터의 바운드와 겹치지 않는 곳만 추가
		if not CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(self.character.Bounds, bound) and CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(self.target.Bounds, bound) then
			table.insert(available_points, bound.center)
		end
	end

	local points = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_points, {count = 1})

	if #points > 0 then
		return points[1]
	else
		return self.sliced_zone_bounds[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.sliced_zone_bounds)].center
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()
	-- 소환되어있는 구슬 전체 해제 이벤트 보낼것.
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {
		'dispose_bead_controller'
	}))

	-- 구독 해제
	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil
	self.sliced_zone_bounds = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					if self.picked_battle_action == self.teleport_action then
						self.ready_teleport = false
					else
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
						self.ready_teleport = true
					end
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- 구독 해제
	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
	self.sliced_zone_bounds = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)

	self.is_super_slime = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsSuperSlime', false)

	self.current_rest_duration = 0

	-- 강인함 높은 순으로 정렬된 리스트
	self.target_list = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	self:set_action_and_battle_zones()

	self.battle_action_count = 0
	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	self.time_passed = 0

	self:set_target_list()
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_rest_duration > self.time_passed then
		return
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		return
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
			self.current_rest_duration = self.rest_duration
			self.time_passed = 0
		end
	else
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
		end
	end

function local_class:set_target_list()
	self.target_list = { }

	for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
		local toug = CS.Oak.StatCalculator.GetToughness(v)
		table.insert(self.target_list, { toug = toug, char = v })
	end

	local compare = function(a, b)
		return a.toug > b.toug
	end

	table.sort(self.target_list, compare)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	if self.is_super_slime then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.wave_action
		return
	end

	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 3
	if idx >= 0 and idx <= 1 then
		for _, v in pairs(self.target_list) do
			if not character_util.is_dead(v.char) then
				self.target = v.char
				break
			end
		end

		if self.target == nil then
			self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRangedTarget(self.cs_state)
		end

		self.picked_battle_action = self.proj_action

	else
		self.picked_battle_action = self.wave_action
	end

	self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:set_action_and_battle_zones()
	self.proj_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossPunchkingProjectile')
	self.wave_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossPunchkingShockwave')

	self.proj_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.wave_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
end

function local_class:exit()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

	self.phase2_panel_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossRedHoodPanel:SingleRaid")
	self.phase2_micro_missile_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossRedHoodMicroMissile:SingleRaid")
	self.cross_shot_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossRedHoodCrossShot:SingleRaid")
	self.cross_shot_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	local missile_point = self.character.Transform:Find('missile_point')
	local panel_point_l = self.character.Transform:Find('panel_point_l')

	self.projectile_action.MetaTable:set_missile_pos(missile_point)
	self.phase2_micro_missile_action.MetaTable:set_missile_pos(missile_point)
	self.phase2_panel_action.MetaTable:set_offsets({panel_point_l})

	self.projectile_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.phase2_panel_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.phase2_micro_missile_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.last_battle_action = nil
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.real_time_passed = 0

	self.select_path_queue = create_generic_queue(unity_class.vector3)

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()

	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	local phase_action_count = 4

	if self.current_repeat_count > 0 then -- 특정 배틀 액션의 반복
		self:change_target()
		self.picked_battle_action = self.last_battle_action
		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count - 1
	else
		local idx = self.battle_action_count % phase_action_count
		if idx == 0 then
			-- 0 번으로 첫 시작시에 판넬 사출
			self:change_target()
			self.picked_battle_action = self.phase2_panel_action
		elseif idx == 1 then
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
			self.picked_battle_action = self.phase2_micro_missile_action
		elseif idx == 2 then
			self:change_target()
			self.picked_battle_action = self.projectile_action
		elseif idx == 3 then
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
			self.picked_battle_action = self.cross_shot_action
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.projectile_action = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil
	self.current_repeat_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.real_time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self.real_time_passed = self.real_time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	self:update_phase2(dt)
end

function local_class:update_phase2(dt)
	--페이즈2로 넘어오자마자 위차 잡고 움직이기 전에 배틀액션이 발동하여 캐릭터가 안으로 이동한것으로 보임 Panel_Phase2 에서 이동 부분 확인해야 할것.
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 Idle 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					if self.current_repeat_count <= 0 then
						self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					else
						self.current_rest_time = 0
					end

					-- 페이즈 2 에서 공격 끝나면 추격상태로
					self:set_phase2_path()
					-- 3d 캐릭터가 아니므로 y 앵글은 항상 0 으로 유지한다.
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIOnThePathFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.select_path_queue, false, self.character.Direction, true, self.tracking_speed, 0))
				end
			else
				--아직 배틀액션 시작되지 않았다면
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					if self.current_repeat_count == 0 then
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end

				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						if self.current_repeat_count == 0 then
							self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
						end
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
						self.current_repeat_count = 0
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return
	elseif CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIEtherealMovePositionSubState)) then
		if self.cs_state.CurrentState.Done then
			-- 3d 캐릭터가 아니므로 y 앵글은 항상 0 으로 유지한다.
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIOnThePathFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.select_path_queue, false, self.character.Direction, true, self.tracking_speed, 0))
		end
	end

	if  CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIOnThePathFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				--추격중 배틀액션 발통시킬려면 Idle 상태로 이동
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_phase2_path()
	self.select_path_queue:Clear()
	local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir((self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position))
	local convert_path = nil
	if side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		for i = 0, self.move_path_right.Count - 1 do
			convert_path = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertToZoneRelativeToWorldToLua(self.zone_bound, self.move_path_right[i])
			self.select_path_queue:Enqueue(convert_path)
		end
	elseif side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		for i = 0, self.move_path_left.Count - 1 do
			convert_path = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertToZoneRelativeToWorldToLua(self.zone_bound, self.move_path_left[i])
			self.select_path_queue:Enqueue(convert_path)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil

	self.target_hp_ratio = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

	return self.target
end
