	self:change_state()
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not self.is_on_rampage_action then
		if self.current_signiture_cool_time > 0 then
			self.current_signiture_cool_time = self.current_signiture_cool_time - dt
		else
			self.is_on_rampage_action = true
		end
	end

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	end

	--TOOD:메뉴얼캐릭 또는 존외곽과의 거리에 따른 행동 결정정
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 거리 파악해서 다음행동 이행
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
				self.current_state = self.state.none
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
			end
		else
			-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
			-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
				-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.current_state = self.state.none
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {

		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 5

	if idx == 0 or idx == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action

		if self.battle_action_count ~= 0 and idx == 0 then
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		else
			self:change_target()
		end
	elseif idx == 1 or idx == 4 then
		if not self.is_start_duel_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.duel_action
			self:change_target()
			self.is_start_duel_action = true
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.clash_action
			self:change_target()
		end
	elseif idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.slash_action = nil
	self.clash_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
	self.duel_action = nil

	self.random = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					if self.picked_battle_action == self.duel_action then
						self.battle_action_count = 0
					end
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil

	self.circling_distance = nil
	self.circling_speed_factor = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossRoyalGuardBattleAIState')

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		range = 1,
		melee = 2
	}

	self.follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FollowTime', 1.0)
	self.rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RestTime', 2.0)
	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingDistance', 2.5)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingSpeed', 2)
	self.pattern_variant = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'PatternVariant', 3)
	self.rapid_fire_cooldown = 5;
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_key()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if self.pattern_variant == 1 then
		self:pick_battle_action_key_first()
	elseif self.pattern_variant == 2 then
		self:pick_battle_action_key_second()
	else
		self:pick_battle_action_key_third()
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.target) then
		self.current_state = self.state.none
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.melee then
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
	else
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_key_first()
	self:change_target()

	self.current_state = self.state.melee
	if self.battle_action_index == 0 then
		local target_dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, self.target)
		if target_dist <= 2 then
			self.battle_action_index = 2
			self.picked_battle_action = self.rush_action
		else
			self.battle_action_index = 1
			self.picked_battle_action = self.stomp_action
		end
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 1 then
		self.battle_action_index = 2
		self.picked_battle_action = self.rush_action
	else
		self.battle_action_index = 0
		self.picked_battle_action = self.lunge_action
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_key_second()
	self:change_target()

	if self.battle_action_index == 0 then
		self.current_state = self.state.melee
		self.battle_action_index = 1
		self.picked_battle_action = self.lunge_action
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 1 then
		if self.range_count >= 2 then
			self.lunge_hit = false
			self.range_count = 0
		end

		if self.lunge_hit then
			self.lunge_hit = false
			self.current_state = self.state.melee
			self.battle_action_index = 0
			self.picked_battle_action = self.blade_action
			self.range_count = self.range_count + 1
		else
			self.current_state = self.state.melee
			self.battle_action_index = 2
			self.picked_battle_action = self.rush_action
		end
	else
		self.current_state = self.state.range
		self.battle_action_index = 0
		self.picked_battle_action = self.missile_action
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_key_third()
	local close_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchClosestTarget(self.cs_state)
	local target_dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, close_target ~= nil and close_target or self.target)
	if target_dist < 5 then
		self:change_target(close_target)
		self.current_state = self.state.melee
		if self.battle_action_index == 0 then
			if self.lunge_hit then
				self.lunge_hit = false
				if target_dist <= 2 then
					self.battle_action_index = 3
					self.picked_battle_action = self.rush_action
				else
					self.battle_action_index = 2
					self.picked_battle_action = self.blade_action
				end
			else
				self.battle_action_index = 1
				self.picked_battle_action = self.counter_action
			end
		elseif self.battle_action_index == 1 then
			if target_dist <= 2 then
				self.battle_action_index = 3
				self.picked_battle_action = self.rush_action
			else
				self.battle_action_index = 2
				self.picked_battle_action = self.blade_action
			end
		elseif self.battle_action_index == 2 then
			self.battle_action_index = 3
			if target_dist <= 2 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.rush_action
			else
				local r = random_util.get_random_int(0, 1)
				if r == 1 then
					self.picked_battle_action = self.stomp_action
				else
					self.picked_battle_action = self.blade_action
				end
			end
		elseif self.battle_action_index == 3 then
			self.battle_action_index = 4
			self.picked_battle_action = self.counter_action
		else
			self.battle_action_index = 0
			self.picked_battle_action =  self.lunge_action
		end
	else
		self:change_target()
		if self.picked_battle_action == self.missile_action and
			self.rapid_fire_time_passed < self.rapid_fire_cooldown then
			self.current_state = self.state.none
		else
			self.battle_action_index = -1
			self.rapid_fire_time_passed = 0
			self.current_state = self.state.range
			self.picked_battle_action =  self.missile_action
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션
	if self.pattern_variant == 1 then
		self.rush_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossValanciaOraRush')
		self.lunge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'HomingStabNew:Valancia')
		self.stomp_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'Jingak')
	elseif self.pattern_variant == 2 then
		self.range_count = 0
		self.rush_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossValanciaOraRush')
		self.lunge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'HomingStabNew:Valancia')
		self.blade_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossValanciaBlade')
		self.missile_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossInvaderDirectorRapidFire:Valancia')
	else
		self.rush_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossValanciaOraRush')
		self.lunge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'HomingStabNew:Valancia')
		self.stomp_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'Jingak')
		self.counter_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossValanciaCounter')
		self.blade_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossValanciaBlade')
		self.missile_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossInvaderDirectorRapidFire:Valancia')
	end

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.rapid_fire_time_passed = 0
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_index = -1
	self.lunge_hit = false
	self.current_state = self.state.none

	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	if is_unity_null(self.target) then
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	else
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
				random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.rush_action = nil
	self.lunge_action = nil
	self.stomp_action = nil
	self.counter_action = nil
	self.blade_action = nil
	self.missile_action = nil

	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.picked_battle_action ~= self.lunge_action or not self.battle_action_triggered then
		return
	end

	local exclude_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive | CS.Oak.DamageType.DotDamage

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, self.character) and
			e.Info.type & exclude_damage_type == CS.Oak.DamageType.None and
			e.Info.type & CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee == CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee then
		self.lunge_hit = true
	end
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	self.rapid_fire_time_passed = self.rapid_fire_time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			self.current_state = self.state.none
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.time_passed = 0
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
							random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
					self.current_state = self.state.none
				end
			else
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.follow_time then
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
					else
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
								random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
						self.current_state = self.state.none
					end
				end
			end
		end
	else
		if self.time_passed >= self.rest_time then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_key()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossSalamandraBattleAIState')

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.action_flow = {
		--보스 버젼
		type_a = 1,
		--일반 몬스터 버전
		type_b = 2
	}

	self.action_type = {
		laser = 1,
		bone_fire = 2,
		explode = 3,
		teleport = 4,
		chain_bomb = 5,
	}

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		move = 1, --범위이내로 들어가서 이동 하는 상태
		battle = 2, --배틀액션 사용 가능 상태
		teleport = 3, --존외곽에 근접했을 때 중앙으로 텔레포트 해야되는 상태
		check_position = 4 --현재 위치를 파악
	}

	-- 추적하지 않고 일정 시간 대기 후 다음 패턴으로 감.
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 4)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 5)
	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingDistance', 2.5)
	self.circling_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingSpeed', 2)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingSpeed", 1)
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxFlowTime", 1)
	-- 용암폭발 사용 가능한 쿨타임
	self.explode_cool_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MeteorCoolTime', 30)

	-- 1.레이저, 2.모닥불, 3.용암폭발, 4.텔레포트, 5.연쇄폭발
	self.action_names = cs_util.get_string_table_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionNames')

	--사용할 흐름도는 enum으로 구분
	self.current_action_flow = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ActionFlow', 1)

	--타겟과 범위 이내이면 이동
	self.battle_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BattleDistance', 3)

	--도망 경과 시간
	self.run_max_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RunawayMaxTime', 1)

	--배틀존 벽과 범위 이내이면 중앙 텔레포트
	self.wall_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'WallDistance', 2)

	self.blink_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("fx_boss_salamandra_blink")
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
	end

	self.zone_bounds = battle_zone_bound

	self.battle_action_list = {}

	for _,v in pairs(self.action_names) do
		local ba = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, v)
		table.insert(self.battle_action_list, ba)
	end

	self.battle_action_list[self.action_type.laser].MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.battle_action_list[self.action_type.bone_fire].MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.battle_action_list[self.action_type.explode].MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)

	--self.current_state = self.state.none
	-- 플레임샤워 쿨타임 시간
	self.explode_cool_time_passed = 0
	-- 플레임샤워 준비
	self.is_explode_ready = true
	-- 진행시간
	self.time_passed = 0
	-- 도망 경과 시간
	self.runaway_time_passed = 0
	-- 선택된 배틀액션
	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	-- 배틀액션 실행중인지
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.battle_action_count = 0

	if self.blink_effect ~= nil then
		self.blink_effect:Instantiate(self.character.Position)
	end

	self.current_state = self.state.none
	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

	elseif idx == 1 then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
		self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_action_list[self.action_type.laser]
	elseif idx == 3 then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
		self.battle_action_list[self.action_type.teleport].MetaTable:set_destination(self.zone_bounds.center)
		self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_action_list[self.action_type.teleport]
	elseif idx == 4 then
		--쿨타임 중이라면 다음 액션으로 넘긴다.
		if self.is_explode_ready then
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
			self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_action_list[self.action_type.explode]
			self.explode_cool_time_passed = self.explode_cool_time
			self.is_explode_ready = false

		self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_action_list[self.action_type.bone_fire]
	elseif idx == 1 then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
		self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_action_list[self.action_type.laser]

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)

	end

	if self.explode_cool_time_passed > 0 then
		self.explode_cool_time_passed = self.explode_cool_time_passed - dt

	end

			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.check_position then
		self:update_state()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 거리 파악해서 다음행동 이행
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
				self.current_state = self.state.check_position
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
			end
		else
			-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
			-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then

				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			end
		end

		if self.runaway_time_passed > self.run_max_time then
			self.current_state = self.state.none
			self.runaway_time_passed = 0
		else
			self.runaway_time_passed = self.runaway_time_passed + dt
		end

		--이동하면서 거리유지
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
			if not self:is_come_close_target() then
				self:update_state()
			end
		else
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
					random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, true, self.circling_speed))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		--중앙 텔레포트
		self.battle_action_list[self.action_type.teleport].MetaTable:set_destination(self.zone_bounds.center)
		self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_action_list[self.action_type.teleport]
		self.current_state = self.state.battle
	end
end

function local_class:update_state()
	--타겟 거리에 따른 state설정
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < self.battle_distance then
		self.current_state = self.state.move
	elseif self:check_battle_zone_for_runaway() then
		self.current_state = self.state.teleport
	else
		self.current_state = self.state.none
	end

	if self.current_state ~= self.state.move then
		self.runaway_time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:is_come_close_target()
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < self.battle_distance then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:check_battle_zone_for_runaway()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.wall_distance)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
			return true
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)

local local_class = newclass("BossSandMonsterFuryBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	self.state = {

	}

	self.summon_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'SummonCount', 2)
	self.summon_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SummonRadius', 2.0)
	self.summon_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SummonDelay', 0.5)
	self.summon_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SummonTerm', 10.0)
	self.tentacle_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TentacleRadius', 0.5)

	self.flee_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FleeDistance', 5.5)
	self.flee_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FleeSpeed', 7.0)
	self.flee_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FleeRange', 3.0)
	self.flee_direction = nil
	self.flee_duration = nil
	self.flee_time_passed = 0

	self.tentacle_holder = nil
	self.act_tentacle_holder = { }
	self.tentacle_delay_holder = nil
	self.loop_count = 0

	self.fx_dust_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Trap_Sandmonster_Ready')
	self.fx_dust = nil

	self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func)

	self.on_normal_dying_end_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_normal_dying_end_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.NormalDyingEndEvent), self.on_normal_dying_end_event_func)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)

	self.cluster_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossSandMonsterFuryClusterBomb')
	self.clutch_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossSandMonsterFuryClutch')
	self.shockwave_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossSandMonsterFuryAreaShockWave')
	self.storm_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossSandMonsterFuryZigZagStorm')
	local tentacle_loader_action =  CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossSandMonsterFuryTentacleLoader')

	self.storm_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.flee_pos = nil

	self.summon_time_passed = 0

	if tentacle_loader_action ~= nil then
		self.tentacle_holder = tentacle_loader_action.MetaTable:get_tentacle_holder()
		if self.tentacle_holder ~= nil and #self.tentacle_holder > 0 then
			local t = self.tentacle_holder[1]
			self.tentacle_radius = math.max(t.Bounds.size.x, t.Bounds.size.z) / 2

			local x = self.zone_bound.size.x - (self.tentacle_radius + 0.1)
			local y = self.zone_bound.size.y
			local z = self.zone_bound.size.z - (self.tentacle_radius + 0.1)
			self.tentacle_zone = unity_class.bounds(self.zone_bound.center, vector(x, y, z))

			for i = #self.tentacle_holder, 1, -1 do
				t = self.tentacle_holder[i]
				t.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.down * 100

end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self:update_tentacle(dt)

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.flee then
		if self:update_flee(dt) then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
		return
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		return
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 다음액션 진행
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false

			local flee_pos = self:get_flee_pos()
			if flee_pos ~= nil then
				self.flee_pos = flee_pos
				self:change_state(self.state.flee)
			end
		end
	else
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_tentacle(dt)
	if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return
	end

	self.summon_time_passed = self.summon_time_passed + dt

	if self.summon_time_passed >= self.summon_term then
		self.summon_time_passed = 0
		self.loop_count = 0

		for _ = 1, self.summon_count do
			self:summon_tentacle()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_tentacle_delay(dt)
	for i = #self.tentacle_delay_holder, 1, -1 do
		local data = self.tentacle_delay_holder[i]
		data.time_passed = data.time_passed + dt

		if data.time_passed > self.summon_delay then
			self:push_ar(data.attack_range)
			self:summon_tentacle(data.tentacle, data.position)
			table.remove(self.tentacle_delay_holder, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_flee(dt)
	self.flee_time_passed = self.flee_time_passed + dt

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.flee_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.flee_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, CS.Oak.Direction.Down, false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_dust, self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)

	return self.flee_time_passed >= self.flee_duration
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	local action_idx = self.action_count % self.divide_action_num

	if action_idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.cluster_action
	elseif action_idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.clutch_action
	elseif action_idx == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.cluster_action
	elseif action_idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.cluster_action
	elseif action_idx == 4 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.shockwave_action
	elseif action_idx == 5 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.storm_action
	end

	self.action_count = self.action_count + 1
end

function local_class:summon_tentacle()
	if self.tentacle_holder == nil then
		return
	end

	local tentacle = self:pop_tentacle()
	if tentacle == nil then
		return
	end

	local thebattle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty()
	if thebattle == nil then
		return
	end

	tentacle.Position = self:get_summon_pos()
	thebattle:AddEnemy(tentacle)

	tentacle.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	tentacle.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
	tentacle.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.down * 100

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(tentacle, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
	message_system:Send(tentacle.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(v, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
end

function local_class:get_summon_pos()
	self.loop_count = self.loop_count + 1

	--들어온 위치가 기준이 되는 캐릭터 위치임.
	local new_position = self.target.Position
	local rand_dist = unity_class.random.Range(0, self.summon_radius)
	local rand_angle = unity_class.random.Range(0.0, 359.9999)
	local rand_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rand_angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * unity_class.vector3.forward
	new_position = new_position + rand_dir.normalized * rand_dist

	if not self.tentacle_zone:Contains(new_position) then
		new_position = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertPositionToInsideOfBounds(self.tentacle_zone, new_position, 0)
	end

	-- !!! LOOP !!!
	if not self:check_tentacle_position(new_position) then
		self:get_summon_pos()
	end

	return new_position
end

function local_class:check_tentacle_position(pos)
	if self.loop_count >= 100 then
		return true
	end

	local result = true

	for _, v in pairs(self.tentacle_holder) do
		local diff = (pos - v.Position).magnitude
		if diff > self.tentacle_radius * 2 then
			result = false
			break
		end

	end

	return result
end

function local_class:get_flee_pos()
	local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if target_list == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local target_poses = { }
	for _, v in pairs(target_list) do
		if v ~= nil then
			local sqr_dist = self.character.Position:SqrDistance(v.Position)
			if sqr_dist <= self.flee_distance * self.flee_range then
				table.insert(target_poses, v.Position)
			end
		end
	end

	local flee_pos = self:search_flee_pos(target_poses)
	target_list:Dispose()

	if flee_pos == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(flee_pos - self.character.Position)
	self.flee_direction = diff.normalized
	self.flee_duration = diff.magnitude / self.flee_speed

	return flee_pos
end

function local_class:search_flee_pos(pos_list)
	local flee_dist = self.flee_distance
	local flee_dir, free_dist = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.GetBestEtherealFleeDirection(self.cs_state, pos_list, self.flee_range, self.flee_distance)

	if vector_util.is_almost_zero(flee_dir) or math.abs(free_dist) < 0.0001 then
		return nil
	end

	local actual_move_dist = math.min(flee_dist, free_dist)
	local dest_pos = self.character.Position + flee_dir * actual_move_dist

	if field:IsThereFloorAt(dest_pos) == false then
		return nil
	end

	return dest_pos
end

function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	if self.current_state == self.state.flee then
		if self.fx_dust ~= nil then
			self.fx_dust:Dispose()
			self.fx_dust = nil
		end
	end

	if new_state == self.state.flee then
		self.fx_dust = self.fx_dust_pool:Instantiate(self.character.Position)
		self.flee_time_passed = 0
	end

	self.current_state = new_state
end

function local_class:pop_tentacle()
	if #self.tentacle_holder > 0 then
		local tentacle = table.remove(self.tentacle_holder, 1)
		table.insert(self.act_tentacle_holder, tentacle)
		return tentacle
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:push_tentacle(tentacle)
	for i = #self.act_tentacle_holder, 1, -1 do
		local v = self.act_tentacle_holder[i]
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v, tentacle) then
			table.remove(self.act_tentacle_holder, i)
		end
	end

	table.insert(self.tentacle_holder, tentacle)
end

function local_class:make_ar()
	local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, self.tentacle_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	ar:Hide()
	return ar
end

function local_class:pop_ar()
	if #self.ar_holder > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.ar_holder, 1)
	end

	return self:make_ar()
end

function local_class:push_ar(ar)
	ar:Hide()
	table.insert(self.ar_holder, ar)
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if e == nil or e.FieldObject == nil or self.character == nil then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.character) then
		for _, v in pairs(self.tentacle_holder) do
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.damage = character_util.get_max_hp(v) * 10
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end

		for _, v in pairs(self.act_tentacle_holder) do
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.damage = character_util.get_max_hp(v) * 10
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_normal_dying_end_event(e)
	if e.character.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy3 and e.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.Id == self.tentacle_id then
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
		heal_info.sender = self.character
		heal_info.target = e.character
		heal_info.heal = e.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

		e.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.down * 100
		e.character.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		self:push_tentacle(e.character)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	if self.fx_dust ~= nil then
		self.fx_dust:Dispose()
		self.fx_dust = nil
	end

	if self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func)
		self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_normal_dying_end_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.NormalDyingEndEvent), self.on_normal_dying_end_event_func)
		self.on_normal_dying_end_event_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action)

		elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.swing_action and self.time_passed >= self.attack_interval then
			local closest_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchClosestTarget(self.cs_state)
			if closest_target ~= nil then
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, closest_target) then
					self.target = closest_target
					local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
					command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
				end

				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, closest_target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.battle_action_triggered = true

				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_action_wait then
					-- 일정시간 발동하지 못했으면 강제 트리거
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
					else
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						self.time_passed = 0
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	if self.last_battle_action == nil then
		self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true)
		self.picked_battle_action = self.unburrow_action
		self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
		return
	end

	self.picked_battle_action = self.swing_action

	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_unburrow()
	local prog = 1 - CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutQuint(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.unburrow_duration)
	self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = self.burrow_height * prog * vector_util.down
end

function local_class:publish_damage_unburrow(dt)
	local calc = self.damage_calc
	local objects = calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - calc.Position).normalized
		if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
			dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
		end

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
		damage_info.direction = dir
		damage_info.convertAttackTo = CS.Oak.ElementalType.Earth
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce + 9000
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.attack_interval = nil

	self.battle_action = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
				self.time_passed = 0
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
							random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
						random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
end

return {

		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,

	end

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'init_summon_monster'}))

	-- 진행시간
	self.time_passed = 0

	-- 선택된 배틀액션
	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	-- 배틀액션 실행중인지
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.battle_action_count = 0
	self.current_state = self.state.none

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)

	--- 랜덤으로 선택된 패턴
	self.selected_rand_action = nil
end

function local_class:get_rest_time_for_action(params, data_name)
	local has_value, value = params:TryGetValue(data_name)

	local action_list = {}
	if has_value then
		for _, info in pairs(value) do
			local index = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(info, "Index", _)

			local action_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(info, "ActionName")

			local rest_time = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(info, "RestTime", 1)

			local show_arrow = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(info, "ShowTargetArrow", true)

			table.insert(action_list, {
				index = index,
				action_name = action_name, --배틀액션 스크립트명
				rest_time = rest_time, --해당 배틀액션의 resttime
				show_arrow = show_arrow --타겟팅 화살표 표시 여부
			})
		end
	end

	return action_list
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	--- 배틀액션 선택
	self:pick_battle_action()

	--- 배틀액션 루아 가져옴
	self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_action_list[self.picked_action_index]

	if self.picked_action_index == self.action_type.basic_action then
		self:change_target()
	else
		local target = battle_ai_util.search_target_ignore_summonables(self.cs_state, self.character)
		self:change_target(target)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션 선택
function local_class:pick_battle_action()

	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 11

	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_action_index = self.action_type.basic_action

	elseif idx == 1 then
		self.picked_action_index = self.action_type.stomp

	elseif idx == 2 then
		--- 50% 확률로 2개 중 한개 선택
		local rand = random_util.get_random_value()

		if 0.5 < rand then
			self.picked_action_index = self.action_type.spread_ball
		else
			self.picked_action_index = self.action_type.cross_laser
		end

		self.selected_rand_action = self.picked_action_index

	elseif idx == 3 then
		self.picked_action_index = self.action_type.charge_burst

	elseif idx == 4 then
		self.picked_action_index = self.action_type.basic_action

	elseif idx == 5 then
		self.picked_action_index = self.action_type.jump_press

	elseif idx == 6 then
		--- 10번 인덱스에서 선택했던 내역 반대로 설정
		if self.selected_rand_action == self.action_type.spread_ball then
			self.picked_action_index = self.action_type.cross_laser
		else
			self.picked_action_index = self.action_type.spread_ball
		end

	elseif idx == 7 then
		self.picked_action_index = self.action_type.find_fake

	elseif idx == 8 then
		self.picked_action_index = self.action_type.stomp

	elseif idx == 9 then
		self.picked_action_index = self.action_type.charge_burst

	elseif idx == 10 then
		self.picked_action_index = self.action_type.tracking
	end
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	for _,v in pairs(self.battle_action_list) do
		v = nil
	end
	self.battle_action_list = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target()
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		return
	end

	--TOOD:메뉴얼캐릭 또는 존외곽과의 거리에 따른 행동 결정정
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
				self.current_state = self.state.battle
				self.time_passed = 0
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			self.current_state = self.state.battle
			self.time_passed = 0

		elseif self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 대기시간동안 circling
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false

				self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
					random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))

				self.current_state = self.state.none
				self.time_passed = 0
			end

		else
			-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
			-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1

			elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
				-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wait then
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.action_data = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("BossShadowBeastGuildBattleAIState")

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	-- 기본 구현
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 1.2)
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 1.0)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 1.5)
	self.phase2_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Phase2Time", 30)
	-- 페이즈 전환 없는 경우
	self.is_phase2_only = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "IsPhase2Only", false)

	-- 협동원정대 사용여부
	self.coop_expedition_season = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'CoopExpeditionSeason', 0)

	self.phase = {
		phase1 = 1,
		phase2 = 2
	}
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 협동원정대용 액션 바리에이션
	if self.coop_expedition_season == 3 then
		-- 배틀 액션 데이터
		self.pounce_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossShadowBeastPounceSync")
		self.burrow_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossShadowBeastBurrowHomingTarget")
		self.charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossShadowBeastChargeSingleNew:coop_exp_s3")

		self.field_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossShadowBeastDecayField:coop_exp_s3")

		-- s3에서 안씀
		if not self.is_phase2_only then
			self.super_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossShadowBeastChargeLoopNew")
		end
	else
		-- 배틀 액션 데이터
		self.pounce_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossShadowBeastPounce:GuildRaid")
		self.burrow_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossShadowBeastBurrowHomingTarget:GuildRaid")
		self.charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossShadowBeastChargeSingleNew")

		self.field_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossShadowBeastDecayField:GuildRaid")

		if not self.is_phase2_only then
			self.super_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossShadowBeastChargeLoopNew")
		end
	end
	self.burrow_action:SetBattleZone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.field_action:SetBattleZone(battle_zone_bound)

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time

	self.current_phase = self.phase.phase1
	self.phase_time_passed = 0
	self.is_super_action = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0
	self.character.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	-- 페이즈 구분 있는 경우에만 탄다
	if not self.is_phase2_only then
		if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 and not self.is_super_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.super_action
			self:change_target()
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.is_super_action = true
			return
		end
	end

	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 4

	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.burrow_action
	elseif idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
	elseif idx == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.pounce_action
	elseif idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.field_action
	end

	--self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))

	self:change_target()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.pounce_action = nil
	self.burrow_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
	self.super_action = nil
	self.field_action = nil
	self.character.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 페이즈 도는 경우에만 전환 로직 타도록
	if not self.is_phase2_only then
		if self.current_phase ~= self.phase.phase2 and self.phase_time_passed >= self.phase2_time then
			self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
		end

		self.phase_time_passed = self.phase_time_passed + dt
	end

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

				if self.picked_battle_action == self.pounce_action then
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true, true))
				end
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				if self.picked_battle_action == self.super_action then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true, true))
					return
				end
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					if self.picked_battle_action ~= self.super_action then
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.time_passed = 0
					self.is_rest = true
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.action_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return
	end

	if self.is_rest then
		if self.time_passed >= self.rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self.time_passed = 0
				self.is_rest = false
			end
		end
	end
end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.rest_time = nil
	self.action_time = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

--3가지 액션을 시작할때 랜덤 순서로 결정
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.action_flow = {
		--일반
		type_a = 1,
		--하드코어
		type_b = 2
	}

	self.action_type = {
		laser_action = 1,
		fireball_action = 2,
		blast_action = 3
	}

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		wait = 1, --액션 후 대기상태
		battle = 2 --배틀액션 사용 가능 상태
	}

	-- 추적하지 않고 일정 시간 대기 후 다음 패턴으로 감.
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 4)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 5)

	-- 1.베이직 샷
	self.action_data = self:get_rest_time_for_action(params, 'ActionData')

	--사용할 흐름도는 enum으로 구분
	self.current_action_flow = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ActionFlow', 1)
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
	end

	self.zone_bounds = battle_zone_bound

	self.battle_action_list = {}
	self.picked_action_index = 0

	for _,v in pairs(self.action_data) do
		local ba = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, v.action_name)
		table.insert(self.battle_action_list, ba)
	end

	self.random_index_list = {}
	self:set_random_index()

	-- 진행시간
	self.time_passed = 0
	-- 선택된 배틀액션
	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	-- 배틀액션 실행중인지
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.battle_action_count = 0

	self.current_state = self.state.none
	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:set_random_index()
	self.random_index_list = {}
	for i = 1, #self.battle_action_list do
		table.insert(self.random_index_list, i)
	end

	self:shuffle(self.random_index_list)
end

function local_class:shuffle(list)
	for i = #list, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(i)
		list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
	end
end

function local_class:get_rest_time_for_action(params, data_name)
	local has_value, value = params:TryGetValue(data_name)

	local action_list = {}
	if has_value then
		for _, info in pairs(value) do
			local index = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(info, "Index", _)

			local action_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(info, "ActionName")

			local rest_time = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(info, "RestTime", 1)

			local show_arrow = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(info, "ShowTargetArrow", true)

			table.insert(action_list, {
				index = index,
				action_name = action_name, --배틀액션 스크립트명
				rest_time = rest_time, --해당 배틀액션의 resttime
				show_arrow = show_arrow --타겟팅 화살표 표시 여부
			})
		end
	end

	return action_list
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self:change_target()

	self.picked_action_index = self:get_next_index()
	self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_action_list[self.picked_action_index]

	self.current_state = self.state.battle
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:get_next_index()
	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 3

	return self.random_index_list[idx + 1]
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	for _,v in pairs(self.battle_action_list) do
		v = nil
	end
	self.battle_action_list = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target()
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		return
	end

	--TOOD:메뉴얼캐릭 또는 존외곽과의 거리에 따른 행동 결정정
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		elseif self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 거리 파악해서 다음행동 이행
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false

				self.current_rest_time = self.action_data[self.picked_action_index].rest_time
				self.current_state = self.state.none
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
			end
		else
			-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
			-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			elseif self.time_passed >= self.initial_rest_time then
				-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wait then
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.action_data = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("BossSuperInvaderBattleAIState")

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	-- 기본 구현
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	-- AI 스펙 로드
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 7.0)
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 1.0)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 1.5)

	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingDistance", 3.5)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingSpeed", 0.5)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	local get_battle_zone_name = CS.Oak.IFieldObjectControllerExtensions.GetZone(self.character.FieldObjectController)
	local battle_zone = field:GetZone(get_battle_zone_name);
	local battle_zone_bound = nil
	if battle_zone ~= nil then
		battle_zone_bound = battle_zone.Bounds
	else
		battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	end
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 배틀 액션 데이터
	self.slash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "CommonSlash:SuperInvader")
	self.bomb_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "CommonSpiritBomb:SuperInvader")
	self.charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossGraboidSpinCharge:SuperInvader")
	self.stomp_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossSuperInvaderFireStomp")

	self.stomp_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0

	self.final_action_seed = random_util.get_random_int(0, 9)

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false


	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 3

	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
	elseif idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
	else --if idx == 2 then
		if (self.final_action_seed + self.battle_action_count) % 2 == 0 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.stomp_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.bomb_action
		end
	end

	self:change_target()
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.slash_action = nil
	self.bomb_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
	self.stomp_action = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.final_action_seed = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil

	self.circling_distance = nil
	self.circling_speed_factor = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}
