local local_class = newclass("BossSymptomBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.params_dict = params

	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 0.1)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 0.5)

	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 7.0)
	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingDistance", 3.5)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingSpeed", 0.5)

	self.dist_check = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "DistanceCheck", 4)
	self.consecutive_check = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ConsecutiveCountCheck", 3)

	self.phase = {
		one = 1,
		two = 2,
	}

	self.current_phase = self.phase.one

	local enhanced = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "Enhanced", false)

	if enhanced then
		self.current_phase = self.phase.two
		self.phase_changing_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PhaseChangingTime", 1.5)
		self.phase2_period2_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Phase2Period2HpRatio", 0.7)

		self.nano_box_count_condition_stream_charge = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "NanoBoxCountConditionStreamCharge", 2)

		self.outgassing_elapsed_time = 0
		self.outgassing_cooldown = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "OutgassingCooldown", 180)

		self.distance_between_elapsed_time = 0
		self.distance_between_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DistanceBetweenDelay", 5)

		self.special_stream_charge_elapsed_time = 0
		self.special_stream_charge_cooldown = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SpecialStreamChargeCooldown", 60)
		self.special_stream_charge_used = false

		self.dist_check_period_one = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "DistanceCheckPeriod1", 6)

		self.camera_focus_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraFocusTime", 0.4)
		self.camera_focus_size = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "CameraFocusSize", 5)
		self.camera_focus_z_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraFocusZOffset", 3)

		self.camera_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraMagnitude", 0.25)
		self.camera_shake_start_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeStartTime", 1.8)
		self.has_done_camera_shake = false

		self.skin_name_period_2 = 'boss_symptom_enhanced_2'

		if character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character) <= self.phase2_period2_hp_ratio then
			self.character.SpineController.SkinName =  self.skin_name_period_2
			self.current_period_num = 2
			self.current_step = 3
		else
			self.current_period_num = 1
			self.current_step = 0
		end

	else
		self.current_phase = self.phase.one
		self.current_step = 0
	end

	self.current_rest_time = 0.0

	self.is_phase_changing = false;
	self.is_phase_sfx_played = false

	self.time_passed_phase = 0

	self.stamp_enhanced_ready = false
	self.max_ailment_gauge = 100

end

function local_class:get_target()
	return CS.Oak.PartyManager.Instance[0].Leader
end

function local_class:enter()
	local zone_name = self.character.FieldObjectController.Zone
	if zone_name then
		self.zone_bound = field:GetZone(zone_name).Bounds
	else
		self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

		-- 배틀액션 - phase1
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
		self.stream_charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossSymptomStreamCharge")
		self.teleport_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "CustomTeleport:BossSymptom")

		self.stamp_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossSymptomStamp")
		self.tail_smash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossSymptomTailSmash")
		self.barrage_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossSymptomBarrage")
		self.ring_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossSymptomRing")

		self.ring_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
		self.tail_smash_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
		self.barrage_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

		-- 배틀액션 - phase2
	elseif self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
		self.stream_charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossSymptomStreamCharge")
		self.teleport_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "CustomTeleport:BossSymptom")

		self.stamp_action_enhanced = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossSymptomStamp:Enhanced")
		self.tail_smash_action_enhanced = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossSymptomTailSmash:Enhanced")
		self.barrage_action_enhanced = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossSymptomBarrage:Enhanced")
		self.ring_action_enhanced = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossSymptomRing:Enhanced")

		self.ghost_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossSymptomGhost")
		self.outgassing_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossSymptomOutgassing")

		self.ring_action_enhanced.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
		self.tail_smash_action_enhanced.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
		self.barrage_action_enhanced.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	end

	self.consecutive_action_count = 0
	self.consecutive_last_action = nil
	self.nano_box_count = 0

	if self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {
			'start_battle_symptom',
			self.character.Name,
		}
		))
	end

	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)

	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.picked_battle_action = self:get_battle_action()

	self.target = self:get_target()
end

function local_class:check_consecutive_ring_action()
	if self.consecutive_last_action == self.ring_action then
		self.consecutive_action_count = self.consecutive_action_count + 1
		if self.consecutive_action_count >= self.consecutive_check then
			self.consecutive_last_action = self.stream_charge_action
			self.consecutive_action_count = 0
			return true
		end
	end

	self.consecutive_last_action = self.ring_action
	return false
end

function local_class:check_consecutive_ring_action_enhanced()
	if self.consecutive_last_action == self.ring_action_enhanced then
		self.consecutive_action_count = self.consecutive_action_count + 1
		if self.consecutive_action_count >= self.consecutive_check then
			self.consecutive_last_action = self.stream_charge_action
			self.consecutive_action_count = 0
			return true
		end
	end

	self.consecutive_last_action = self.ring_action_enhanced
	return false
end

function local_class:check_consecutive_barrage_action_enhanced()

		self.consecutive_action_count = self.consecutive_action_count + 1
		if self.consecutive_action_count >= self.consecutive_check then
			self.consecutive_last_action = self.stream_charge_action
			self.consecutive_action_count = 0
			return true
		end
	end

	self.consecutive_last_action = self.barrage_action_enhanced

function local_class:check_consecutive_stream_charge_action(replaced_action)
	if self.consecutive_last_action == self.stream_charge_action then
		self.consecutive_action_count = self.consecutive_action_count + 1
		if self.consecutive_action_count >= self.consecutive_check then
			self.consecutive_last_action = replaced_action
			self.consecutive_action_count = 0
			return true
		end
	end

	self.consecutive_last_action = self.stream_charge_action
	return false
end

function local_class:get_battle_action()
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
		return self:get_action_phase_one()
	elseif self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
		return self:get_action_phase_two()
	end
end

function local_class:check_special_condition_pattern_one(dt)

	if not (self.current_phase == self.phase.two) then
		return
	end

	if self.special_battle_action ~= nil then
		return
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == self.outgassing_action then
		return
	end

	self.outgassing_elapsed_time = self.outgassing_elapsed_time + dt
	if self.outgassing_elapsed_time >= self.outgassing_cooldown then
		self.outgassing_elapsed_time = 0
		self.special_battle_action = self.outgassing_action
	end
end

function local_class:check_special_condition_pattern_two(dt)

	if not (self.current_phase == self.phase.two) then
		return
	end

	if not self.special_stream_charge_used then
		return
	end

	self.special_stream_charge_elapsed_time = self.special_stream_charge_elapsed_time + dt

	if self.special_stream_charge_elapsed_time >= self.special_stream_charge_cooldown then
		self.special_stream_charge_elapsed_time = 0
		self.special_stream_charge_used = false
	end
end

function local_class:is_special_condition_pattern_two()

	if not (self.current_phase == self.phase.two) then
		return false
	end

	if self.special_battle_action ~= nil then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_period_num == 2 and self.current_step <= 1 then
		return false
	end

	if self.special_stream_charge_used then
		return false
	end

	if self.nano_box_count >= self.nano_box_count_condition_stream_charge then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:check_special_condition_pattern_three(dt)

	if not (self.current_phase == self.phase.two) then
		return
	end

	if self.special_battle_action ~= nil then
		return
	end

	if self.current_period_num == 2 and self.current_step <= 1 then
		return
	end

	local dist = battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, self:get_target())

	if dist >= self.dist_check then
		self.distance_between_elapsed_time = self.distance_between_elapsed_time + dt
	else
		self.distance_between_elapsed_time = 0
	end

	if self.distance_between_elapsed_time >= self.distance_between_delay then
		--print('Range Condition met, elapsed is'..self.distance_between_elapsed_time)
		self.distance_between_elapsed_time = 0

		if self.current_period_num == 1 then
			self.current_step = 3
			self.special_battle_action = self.barrage_action_enhanced
		elseif self.current_period_num == 2 then
			self.current_step = 5
			self.special_battle_action = self.barrage_action_enhanced
		end

	end
end

function local_class:get_action_phase_two()

	if self.current_period_num == 1 then
		if self:is_special_condition_pattern_two() then
			self.current_step = 2
			self.consecutive_last_action = self.stream_charge_action
			self.special_stream_charge_used = true
			--print('debug:stream_charge_action selected ')
			return self.stream_charge_action
		end

		if self.special_battle_action ~= nil then

			local result = self.special_battle_action
			self.special_battle_action = nil
			return result
		end

		return self:get_action_phase_two_period_one()
	else
		if self:is_special_condition_pattern_two() then
			self.current_step = 3
			self.consecutive_last_action = self.stream_charge_action
			self.special_stream_charge_used = true
			return self.stream_charge_action
		end

		if self.special_battle_action ~= nil then

			if self.current_step > 1 then -- 페턴 2 / 텔레포트 이후에는 고정적으로 Ghost 엑션을 쓰기 위함.
				local result = self.special_battle_action
				self.special_battle_action = nil
				return result
			end

		end

		return self:get_action_phase_two_period_two()
	end
end

function local_class:get_action_phase_two_period_one()

	if self.current_step == 0 then

		self.current_step = 1 -- reset
		return self.ring_action_enhanced
	elseif self.current_step == 1 or self.current_step == 3 then

		self.current_step = self.current_step + 1

		local diced_step = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-0.5, 0.5)
		if diced_step >= 0 then
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.tail_smash_action_enhanced, self.target) then
				return self.tail_smash_action_enhanced
			else
				return self.stamp_action_enhanced
			end
		else
			return self.stamp_action_enhanced
		end
	elseif self.current_step == 2 then

		self.current_step = self.current_step + 1
		return self.barrage_action_enhanced

	elseif self.current_step == 4 then
		if self.consecutive_last_action == self.stream_charge_action then
			--print('debug:stream_charge_action occured yes')
			self.current_step = 1 -- reset

			return self.ring_action_enhanced
		else
			--print('debug:stream_charge_action occured no')
			self.current_step = self.current_step + 1
			return self:get_action_phase_two_period_one()
		end
	elseif self.current_step == 5 then

		self.current_step = 1 -- reset
		local diced_step_2 = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-0.5, 0.5)
		if diced_step_2 >= 0 then
			if self:check_consecutive_ring_action_enhanced() then
				return self.stream_charge_action
			end
			return self.ring_action_enhanced
		else
			if self:check_consecutive_stream_charge_action(self.ring_action_enhanced) then
				return self.ring_action_enhanced
			end
			return self.stream_charge_action
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_action_phase_two_period_two()

	if self.current_step == 0 then

		self.current_step = self.current_step + 1
		self.teleport_action.MetaTable:set_destination(self.zone_bound.center)
		return self.teleport_action
	elseif self.current_step == 1 then

		self.current_step = self.current_step + 1
		return self.ghost_action
	elseif self.current_step == 2 then

		if self.ghost_action.MetaTable.alive_monster_count < 4 then
			self.current_step = self.current_step + 1
			return self:get_action_phase_two_period_two()
		else
			self.current_step = 5
			return self.ring_action_enhanced
		end
	elseif self.current_step == 3 then

		if self.consecutive_last_action == self.stream_charge_action then
			self.current_step = self.current_step + 1
			return self:get_action_phase_two_period_two()
		else
			self.current_step = 5
			self.consecutive_last_action = self.barrage_action_enhanced
			return self.barrage_action_enhanced
		end
	elseif self.current_step == 4 or self.current_step == 8 then

		self.current_step = self.current_step + 1

		local diced_step = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-0.5, 0.5)
		if diced_step >= 0 then
			if self:check_consecutive_barrage_action_enhanced() then
				return self.stream_charge_action
			end
			return self.barrage_action_enhanced
		else
			if self:check_consecutive_stream_charge_action(self.barrage_action_enhanced) then
				return self.barrage_action_enhanced
			end
			return self.stream_charge_action
		end
	elseif self.current_step == 5 or self.current_step == 9 then

		self.current_step = self.current_step + 1

		local diced_step_2 = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-0.5, 0.5)
		if diced_step_2 >= 0 then
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.tail_smash_action_enhanced, self.target) then
				return self.tail_smash_action_enhanced
			else
				return self.stamp_action_enhanced
			end
		else
			return self.stamp_action_enhanced
		end

	elseif self.current_step == 6 or self.current_step == 10 then

		if self.stamp_enhanced_ready then
			self.stamp_enhanced_ready = false
			return self.stamp_action_enhanced
		else
			self.current_step = self.current_step + 1
			return self:get_action_phase_two_period_two()
		end
	elseif self.current_step == 7 then

		self.current_step = self.current_step + 1
		return self.ring_action_enhanced
	elseif self.current_step >= 11 then

		self.current_step = 0
		return self:get_action_phase_two_period_two()
	end

	return self.ghost_action
end

function local_class:get_action_phase_one()
	if self.current_step == 4 then
		local dist = battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, self:get_target())

		if dist >= self.dist_check then
			self.current_step = 0
		else
			self.current_step = 5
		end
	end

	if self.current_step == 0 or self.current_step == 6 then
		self.current_step = 1 -- reset
		return self.barrage_action

	elseif self.current_step == 1 or self.current_step == 3 then
		self.current_step = self.current_step + 1
		local diced_step = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-0.5, 0.5)
		if diced_step >= 0 then
			if self:check_consecutive_ring_action() then
				return self.stream_charge_action
			end
			return self.ring_action
		else
			if self:check_consecutive_stream_charge_action(self.ring_action) then
				return self.ring_action
			end
			return self.stream_charge_action
		end
	elseif self.current_step == 2 or self.current_step == 5 then
		self.current_step = self.current_step + 1
		local stamp_hittable = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.stamp_action, self.target)
		local tail_smash_hittable = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.tail_smash_action, self.target)

		if stamp_hittable then
			return self.stamp_action
		elseif tail_smash_hittable then
			return self.tail_smash_action
		end

	end
end

function local_class:process_phase_changing(dt)

	if self.is_phase_changing then
		self.time_passed_phase = self.time_passed_phase + dt
		if self.current_phase == self.phase.two then

			if self.time_passed_phase >= self.camera_focus_time then

				if self.is_phase_sfx_played == false then
					music_player:PlaySfx({
						sfxName = '01_creature_17',
						type_priority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.BattleAttack,
						player_priority = CS.Oak.SfxPlayerPriorityExtensions.GetPlayerType(self.character)}
					)
					self.is_phase_sfx_played = true
				end

			end

			if self.time_passed_phase >= self.camera_shake_start_time then

				if self.has_done_camera_shake == false then
					local remain_time = self.phase_changing_time - self.camera_shake_start_time - self.camera_focus_time
					stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_magnitude, remain_time)
					self.has_done_camera_shake = true
				end

			end

			if self.time_passed_phase >= self.phase_changing_time then
				-- 2페이즈 내부 단계 변화
				self.time_passed_phase = 0
				self.current_step = 0
				self.current_period_num = self.current_period_num + 1
				self.consecutive_action_count = 0
				self.consecutive_last_action = nil
				self.is_phase_changing = false
				self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
				self:reset_ailment()
				stage_camera:Move(user_party.Leader, self.camera_focus_time, user_party.Leader, true)
				stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.BattleCamSize, self.camera_focus_time)
				CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:ChangeStageMusicVolume(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event, 1.0, 2)
				--print('phase 2 period changed, current period is: '..self.current_period_num)
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'start_phase2_period2'}))
			end

		end
	else
		if self.current_phase == self.phase.two then

			local cur_hp_ratio = character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character);

			if self.current_period_num == 1 and cur_hp_ratio <= self.phase2_period2_hp_ratio then

				self.is_phase_changing = true
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.current_rest_time = 0
				self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
				self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('phase_up',CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false))
				self.character.SpineController.SkinName =  self.skin_name_period_2
				self:set_ailment_resist()
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
				stage_camera:Move(self.character.Position + vector(0.0,0.0, self.camera_focus_z_offset), self.camera_focus_time, null, true)
				stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.camera_focus_size, self.camera_focus_time)
				CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:ChangeStageMusicVolume(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event, 0.5, 1)
			else
				return false
			end

		else
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- 상태이상 면역 추가 원혼 Post State에서 해제되어야 하기때문에 원혼CS를 넘겨줘서 상태이상 면역을 준다
function local_class:set_ailment_resist_by_battleaction(action)
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun | CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(action, options)
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state, options)
end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state)
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self:process_phase_changing(dt) then
		return
	end

	self:check_special_condition_pattern_one(dt)
	self:check_special_condition_pattern_two(dt)
	self:check_special_condition_pattern_three(dt)

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					if self.picked_battle_action == self.teleport_action then
						self.current_rest_time = 0
					else
						self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					end

					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false

					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					if self.picked_battle_action == self.teleport_action then
						self:set_ailment_resist_by_battleaction(self.ghost_action)
					end
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.

					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
		CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end

		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()
end

function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local event_string = e:GetParamAt(0)

	if event_string == 'regen_nano_box' then
		self.nano_box_count = self.nano_box_count + 1
	elseif event_string == 'remove_nano_box' then
		self.nano_box_count = math.min(self.nano_box_count - 1, 0)
	elseif event_string == 'hit_tail_smash_airborne' then
		if self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
			self.stamp_enhanced_ready = true
			self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("BossUngoliantBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	self.action_type = {
		ambush = 1,
		rush = 2,
		strike = 3,
		dolphin_ready = 4,
		dolphin = 5,
	}

	self.buff_id = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'BuffId', 'boss_ungoliant_buff_def')

	self.heal_percent = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'HealPercent', 15)

	self.fx_bead_list = { }

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.buffball_name)
	self.get_fx_bead_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.buffball_name) end

	self.buffball_break_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'BuffballBreakName', 'fx_boss_ungoliant_buffball_break')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.buffball_break_name)
	self.get_fx_bead_end_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.buffball_break_name) end

	self.buffbal_absorb_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'BuffballAbsorbName', 'fx_boss_ungoliant_buffball_absorb')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.buffbal_absorb_name)
	self.get_fx_bead_absorb_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.buffbal_absorb_name) end

	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.ambush_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self:get_battle_action_handle_name(self.action_type.ambush))
	self.rush_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self:get_battle_action_handle_name(self.action_type.rush))
	self.strike_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self:get_battle_action_handle_name(self.action_type.strike))
	if self.is_enhanced then
		self.dolphin_ready_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self:get_battle_action_handle_name(self.action_type.dolphin_ready))
		self.dolphin_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self:get_battle_action_handle_name(self.action_type.dolphin))
	end

	self:set_base_battle_zone_bound()
	self.ambush_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.rush_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.strike_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	if self.is_enhanced then
		self.dolphin_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	end

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.last_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.prev_rand_action = nil
	self.rand_action_count = 0
	self.limit_rand_action_count = 3

	self.ailment_count = 0
	self.count_ailment = false
	self.dolphin_count = 0
	self.max_ailment_gauge = 100

	self.current_rest_time = 1

	--- subscribe event
	self.on_battle_end_event_func = function(e) self:on_battle_end_event(e) end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	self:update_beads(dt)

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered == false then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
			end
		end
	else
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	-- 최초 1회 찢어발기기
	if self.last_battle_action == nil then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.ambush_action
	else
		if self.last_battle_action == self.ambush_action then
			-- 최초 1회 무조껀 찢어발기기 사용 후엔 매복 이후 50% 확률로 찢어발기기 or 돌진
			if self.rand_action_count == 0 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.strike_action
				self.rand_action_count = self.rand_action_count + 1

			elseif self.rand_action_count < self.limit_rand_action_count then
				-- 50% 찢어발기기 or 돌진
				if self.prev_rand_action == nil then
					local rand = random_util.get_random_int(0, 1)
					self.picked_battle_action = rand == 0 and self.strike_action or self.rush_action
					self.prev_rand_action = self.picked_battle_action

				elseif self.prev_rand_action == self.strike_action then
					self.picked_battle_action = self.rush_action
					self.prev_rand_action = self.picked_battle_action

				elseif self.prev_rand_action == self.rush_action then
					self.picked_battle_action = self.strike_action
					self.prev_rand_action = self.picked_battle_action

				else
					print('### 여기 들어오면 안되는디...?')
				end
				self.rand_action_count = self.rand_action_count + 1

			else
				if self.is_enhanced then
					self.picked_battle_action = self.dolphin_ready_action
					self.rand_action_count = 0
					self.prev_rand_action = nil
					self.ailment_count = 0
					self.count_ailment = true
					self:add_buff()
					self:start_bead()
				else
					self.picked_battle_action = self.ambush_action
					self.rand_action_count = 0
					self.prev_rand_action = nil
				end
			end

		elseif self.last_battle_action == self.dolphin_ready_action then
			self.count_ailment = false

			if self:get_remain_buff_stack() > 0 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.dolphin_action
				self.dolphin_action.MetaTable:set_ailment_resist()
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.ambush_action
			end

		elseif self.last_battle_action == self.dolphin_action then
			if self.dolphin_count < self:get_remain_buff_stack() then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.dolphin_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.ambush_action
				self.dolphin_action.MetaTable:reset_ailment()
				self:get_buff_by_remain_ailment_count()
				self:clear_buff()
				self:absorb_fx_bead()
			end
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.ambush_action
		end
	end

	-- set target
	if self.picked_battle_action == self.ambush_action then
		self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchClosestTarget(self.cs_state)

	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.strike_action then
		self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchClosestTarget(self.cs_state)

	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.rush_action then
		self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state)

	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.dolphin_ready_action then
		self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state)

	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.dolphin_action then
		self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state)
		if self.dolphin_count > 0 then
			local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
			if diff > self.dolphin_target_distance then
				self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchClosestTarget(self.cs_state)
			end
		end
	end

	-- set var
	if self.picked_battle_action == self.dolphin_ready_action then
		self.dolphin_count = 0
	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.dolphin_action then
		self.dolphin_count = self.dolphin_count + 1
		self.dolphin_ready_action.MetaTable:remove_animation()
	end

	self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
end

function local_class:get_remain_buff_stack()
	return math.max(0, self.buff_stack - self.ailment_count)
end

-- 남은 껍질강화 양에 따라 패턴 종료 시 버프 먹음
function local_class:get_buff_by_remain_ailment_count()
	local cnt = self:get_remain_buff_stack()

	if self.heal_percent > 0 then
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
		local max_hp = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.heal = math.floor(max_hp * self.heal_percent / 100 * cnt)
		heal_info.sender = self.character
		heal_info.target = self.character
		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
	end

	for i = 1, cnt do
		buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, 'boss_ungoliant_buff_stack_def', 0, false, false)
	end
end

function local_class:set_base_battle_zone_bound()
	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	-- FIXME : ai 이탈시 핸들링 되는 괴상한 이슈가 있어 임시로 lua_helper가 유효한지 체크함
	-- TODO : 근본적으로 ai가 Exit(혹은 해제된) 상태에서 핸들링 되지 않도록 수정 필요
	if lua_helper == nil then
		return
	end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
		return
	end

	if e.Info.forceAilment then
		if self.count_ailment == false then
			return
		end

		if e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Down] == self.max_ailment_gauge
				or e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Poison] == self.max_ailment_gauge
				or e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Aerial] == self.max_ailment_gauge then
			self:reduce_buff()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	-- FIXME : ai 이탈시 핸들링 되는 괴상한 이슈가 있어 임시로 lua_helper가 유효한지 체크함
	-- TODO : 근본적으로 ai가 Exit(혹은 해제된) 상태에서 핸들링 되지 않도록 수정 필요
	if lua_helper == nil then
		return
	end

	self:get_buff_by_remain_ailment_count()
	self:clear_buff()
	self:absorb_fx_bead()

	--- unsubscribe event
	if self.on_battle_end_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), self.on_battle_end_event_func)
		self.on_battle_end_event_func = nil
	end
end

function local_class:add_buff()
	if self.is_enhanced == false then
		return
	end

	if character_util.has_active_buff(self.character, self.buff_id) then
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, self.buff_id)
	end

	local cnt = self.buff_stack - self.ailment_count
	if cnt <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local buff_lv = cnt * self.buff_percent
	buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, self.buff_id, buff_lv, false, false)
end

function local_class:reduce_buff()
	if self.is_enhanced == false then
		return
	end

	-- 버프가 있을때만 작동
	if character_util.has_active_buff(self.character, self.buff_id) == false then
		return
	end

	self.ailment_count = self.ailment_count + 1

	self:remove_fx_bead()
	self:add_buff()
end

function local_class:clear_buff()
	if character_util.has_active_buff(self.character, self.buff_id) then
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, self.buff_id)
	end
end

function local_class:start_bead()
	for i = 1, self.buff_stack do
		local position, angle = self:get_fx_bead_position(i)
		local fx_bead = self.get_fx_bead_pool():Instantiate(position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.character.Transform)
		local bead = {
			fx = fx_bead,
			-- 구슬 회전시키면서 위치 저장해둿다가 해당 위치로 다시 복구 하기 위해서 위치값 따로 저장해둠.
			position = position,
			-- 기본 위치각도
			angle = angle
		}
		table.insert(self.fx_bead_list, bead)
	end

	self.degree = 0
end

function local_class:get_fx_bead_position(index)
	-- 보스 위치 기준으로 45도씩 돌아가면서 위치 확정 지어야 함.
	-- 생성기준은 12시 방향부터 ..
	local angle = 360 / self.buff_stack * (index - 1)
	local dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * unity_class.vector3.forward
	local new_position = self.character.Bounds.center + self.fx_bead_offset + dir.normalized * self.bead_fx_distance
	return new_position, angle
end

function local_class:remove_fx_bead()
	-- 성공한 액션 갯수 만큼 뒤에꺼부터 제거
	if self.fx_bead_list == nil or #self.fx_bead_list == 0 then
		return
	end

	local index = self.buff_stack - self.ailment_count + 1
	if index <= 0 then
		return
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_bead_list[index].fx) then
		self.get_fx_bead_end_pool():Instantiate(self.fx_bead_list[index].position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, nil)
		self.fx_bead_list[index].fx:Dispose()
		self.fx_bead_list[index].fx = nil
		table.remove(self.fx_bead_list, index)
	end
end

function local_class:absorb_fx_bead()
	if self.fx_bead_list == nil or #self.fx_bead_list == 0 then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.fx_bead_list do
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_bead_list[i].fx) then
			self.get_fx_bead_absorb_pool():Instantiate(self.fx_bead_list[i].position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, nil)
			self.fx_bead_list[i].fx:Dispose()
			self.fx_bead_list[i].fx = nil
		end
	end

	self.fx_bead_list = {}
end

function local_class:update_beads(dt)
	if self.fx_bead_list == nil or #self.fx_bead_list == 0 then
		return
	end

	local center = self.character.Bounds.center
	if self.degree >= 360 then
		self.degree = 0
	end
	self.degree = self.degree + dt * 15-- self.rotate_speed

	for i = 1, #self.fx_bead_list do
		local pos = self.fx_bead_list[i].position
		local each_degree = self.degree + self.fx_bead_list[i].angle
		if each_degree >= 360 then
			each_degree = each_degree % 360
		end

		local rad = math.rad(each_degree)
		local sin = math.sin(rad)
		local cos = math.cos(rad)
		local x = sin * self.bead_fx_distance
		local z = cos * self.bead_fx_distance

		pos = unity_class.vector3(x, 0, z) + center + self.fx_bead_offset
		self.fx_bead_list[i].position = pos

		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_bead_list[i].fx) then
			self.fx_bead_list[i].fx.transform.position = pos
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_battle_action_handle_name(action)
	local name = nil
	if action == self.action_type.ambush then
		name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(self.params_dict, 'AmbushActionName', 'BossUngoliantAmbushAssault')
	elseif action == self.action_type.rush then
		name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(self.params_dict, 'RushActionName', 'BossUngoliantRush')
	elseif action == self.action_type.strike then
		name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(self.params_dict, 'StrikeActionName', 'BossUngoliantStrike')
	elseif action == self.action_type.dolphin_ready then
		name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(self.params_dict, 'DolphinReadyActionName', 'BossUngoliantDolphinReady')
	elseif action == self.action_type.dolphin then
		name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(self.params_dict, 'DolphinActionName', 'BossUngoliantDolphin')
	end

	return name
end

function local_class:exit()
	--- unsubscribe event
	if self.on_battle_end_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), self.on_battle_end_event_func)
		self.on_battle_end_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

	self.rush_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.strike_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.dolphin_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.current_rest_time = 1

	self.ailment_count = 0
	self.count_ailment = false
	self.dolphin_count = 0
	self.max_ailment_gauge = 100

	self.action_count = 0
	self.max_action_count = 7

	--- subscribe event
	self.on_battle_end_event_func = function(e) self:on_battle_end_event(e) end
	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e) self:on_damage_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), self.on_battle_end_event_func)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	self:update_beads(dt)

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered == false then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
			end
		end
	else
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	-- 찢어 발기기 > 매복 - 강습 > 찢어 발기기 > 돌진 > 매복 - 강습 > 돌고래

	local act_cnt = self.action_count % self.max_action_count
	if act_cnt == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.strike_action

	elseif act_cnt == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.ambush_action

	elseif act_cnt == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.strike_action

	elseif act_cnt == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.rush_action

	elseif act_cnt == 4 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.ambush_action

	elseif act_cnt == 5 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.dolphin_ready_action
		self.count_ailment = true

	elseif act_cnt == 6 then
		if self:get_remain_buff_stack() > 0 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.dolphin_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.strike_action
			self.action_count = self.action_count + 1
		end
		self.count_ailment = false
	end

	self.action_count = self.action_count + 1

	-- set target
	if self.picked_battle_action == self.ambush_action then
		if self:get_target_distance() < self.ambush_target_distance then
			self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state)
		else
			self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchClosestTarget(self.cs_state)
		end

	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.strike_action then
		self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchClosestTarget(self.cs_state)

	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.rush_action then
		if self:get_target_distance() < self.rush_target_distance then
			self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state)
		else
			self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchClosestTarget(self.cs_state)
		end

	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.dolphin_action then
		self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state)
	end

	-- set etc
	if self.picked_battle_action == self.dolphin_ready_action then
		self:start_bead()

	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.dolphin_action then
		local cnt = self:get_remain_buff_stack()
		self.dolphin_action.MetaTable:set_dolphin_repeat_count(cnt)
		self:absorb_fx_bead()
		self.dolphin_ready_action.MetaTable:remove_animation()
	end
end

function local_class:set_base_battle_zone_bound()
	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end
end

function local_class:get_remain_buff_stack()
	return math.max(0, self.max_dolphin_count - self.ailment_count)
end

function local_class:get_target_distance()
	return vector_util.distance(self.target.Position, self.character.Position)
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	-- FIXME : ai 이탈시 핸들링 되는 괴상한 이슈가 있어 임시로 lua_helper가 유효한지 체크함
	-- TODO : 근본적으로 ai가 Exit(혹은 해제된) 상태에서 핸들링 되지 않도록 수정 필요
	if lua_helper == nil then
		return
	end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
		return
	end

	if e.Info.forceAilment then
		if self.count_ailment == false then
			return
		end

		if e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Down] == self.max_ailment_gauge
				or e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Poison] == self.max_ailment_gauge
				or e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Aerial] == self.max_ailment_gauge then
			self.ailment_count = self.ailment_count + 1
			self:remove_fx_bead()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	-- FIXME : ai 이탈시 핸들링 되는 괴상한 이슈가 있어 임시로 lua_helper가 유효한지 체크함
	-- TODO : 근본적으로 ai가 Exit(혹은 해제된) 상태에서 핸들링 되지 않도록 수정 필요
	if lua_helper == nil then
		return
	end

	self:absorb_fx_bead()

	--- unsubscribe event
	if self.on_battle_end_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), self.on_battle_end_event_func)
		self.on_battle_end_event_func = nil
	end
end

function local_class:get_fx_bead_position(index)
	-- 보스 위치 기준으로 45도씩 돌아가면서 위치 확정 지어야 함.
	-- 생성기준은 12시 방향부터 ..
	local angle = 360 / self.max_dolphin_count * (index - 1)
	local dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * unity_class.vector3.forward
	local new_position = self.character.Bounds.center + self.fx_bead_offset + dir.normalized * self.bead_fx_distance
	return new_position, angle
end

function local_class:start_bead()
	for i = 1, self.max_dolphin_count do
		local position, angle = self:get_fx_bead_position(i)
		local fx_bead = self.get_fx_bead_pool():Instantiate(position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.character.Transform)
		local bead = {
			fx = fx_bead,
			-- 구슬 회전시키면서 위치 저장해둿다가 해당 위치로 다시 복구 하기 위해서 위치값 따로 저장해둠.
			position = position,
			-- 기본 위치각도
			angle = angle
		}
		table.insert(self.fx_bead_list, bead)
	end

	self.ailment_count = 0
	self.degree = 0
end

function local_class:remove_fx_bead()
	-- 성공한 액션 갯수 만큼 뒤에꺼부터 제거
	if self.fx_bead_list == nil or #self.fx_bead_list == 0 then
		return
	end

	local index = self.max_dolphin_count - self.ailment_count + 1
	if index <= 0 then
		return
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_bead_list[index].fx) then
		self.get_fx_bead_end_pool():Instantiate(self.fx_bead_list[index].position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, nil)
		self.fx_bead_list[index].fx:Dispose()
		self.fx_bead_list[index].fx = nil
		table.remove(self.fx_bead_list, index)
	end
end

function local_class:absorb_fx_bead()
	if self.fx_bead_list == nil or #self.fx_bead_list == 0 then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.fx_bead_list do
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_bead_list[i].fx) then
			self.get_fx_bead_absorb_pool():Instantiate(self.fx_bead_list[i].position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, nil)
			self.fx_bead_list[i].fx:Dispose()
			self.fx_bead_list[i].fx = nil
		end
	end

	self.fx_bead_list = {}
end

function local_class:update_beads(dt)
	if self.fx_bead_list == nil or #self.fx_bead_list == 0 then
		return
	end

	local center = self.character.Bounds.center
	if self.degree >= 360 then
		self.degree = 0
	end
	self.degree = self.degree + dt * 15-- self.rotate_speed

	for i = 1, #self.fx_bead_list do
		local pos = self.fx_bead_list[i].position
		local each_degree = self.degree + self.fx_bead_list[i].angle
		if each_degree >= 360 then
			each_degree = each_degree % 360
		end

		local rad = math.rad(each_degree)
		local sin = math.sin(rad)
		local cos = math.cos(rad)
		local x = sin * self.bead_fx_distance
		local z = cos * self.bead_fx_distance

		pos = unity_class.vector3(x, 0, z) + center + self.fx_bead_offset
		self.fx_bead_list[i].position = pos

		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_bead_list[i].fx) then
			self.fx_bead_list[i].fx.transform.position = pos
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	--- unsubscribe event
	if self.on_battle_end_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), self.on_battle_end_event_func)
		self.on_battle_end_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	-- 블러디스톰 예약되어있으나 이전에 한번 실행 되었다면 중복해서 발동하지 않도록 함.
	if self.bloody_storm_reserved and self.last_battle_action == self.bloody_storm_action then
		self.bloody_storm_reserved = false
	end

	--콤보 액션이였을 경우
	if self.is_combo_action then
		-- 최초 시작 패턴 콤보
		self.picked_battle_action = self.combo_action
		self.battle_action_count = 0
		self.is_combo_action = false
	elseif self.blood_lust_reserved then
		self:pick_blood_lust()
	elseif self.bloody_storm_reserved then
		self:pick_bloody_storm()
	elseif self.bloody_hail_reserved then
		self:pick_bloody_hail()
	else
		local idx = self.battle_action_count % 2
		local random = random_util.get_random_int(0, 1)
		if idx == 1 then
			if random == 0 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.bomb_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.clone_charge_action
			end

		elseif idx == 0 then
			if self.last_battle_action == self.bomb_action then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.clone_charge_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.bomb_action
			end
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
			--50% 확률로 도는 루틴 끝났으면 다시 combo 액션으로 돌아감.
			self.is_combo_action = true
		end
	end
end


-- 블러디 스톰 실행 조건 체크
function local_class:try_check_bloody_storm()
	-- 블러디 헤일 이미 픽 되었다면 블러디 헤일 선택은 하지 않는다.
	if self.picked_battle_action == self.bloody_hail_action or self.picked_battle_action == self.bloody_storm_action then
		return
	end
	-- 타이밍 이슈로 캐릭터 ai 꺼진 경우 에러 발생 가능성이 존재하기 때문에 방지코드 삽입
	if self.character == nil then
		return
	end

	local targets = battle_manager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if targets then
		for idx = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
			local fo = targets[idx]
			-- 메뉴얼 캐릭터면
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) and fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour:HasAilment(CS.Oak.Ailment.Poison) then
				self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
				self.bloody_storm_target = fo
				self.bloody_storm_reserved = true
				self.is_combo_action = false
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
				break
			end
		end
		targets:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:try_check_bloody_hail()

	}))

	-- 구독 해제
	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	-- 블러디 스톰 조건 체크
	self:try_check_bloody_storm()
	--블러디헤일 조건체크 좀더 조건 확인 자주 하도록 수정함.
	self:try_check_bloody_hail()

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
		return false
	end

	if self.blood_lust_count <= #self.blood_lust_activate_hp_list then
		if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 < self.blood_lust_activate_hp_list[self.blood_lust_count] then
			self.blood_lust_count = self.blood_lust_count + 1
			self.blood_lust_reserved = true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	-- 구슬 갯수 증감 이벤트
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'blood_bead_create' then
		self.current_bead_count = self.current_bead_count + 1
		self:try_check_bloody_hail()
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'blood_bead_dispose' then
		self.current_bead_count = self.current_bead_count - 1
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- 구독 해제
	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("BossVeronicaBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		battle = 1, --배틀액션 사용 가능 상태
		groggy = 2, --그로기 상태
	}

	self.groggy_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "GroggyDuration", 4)
	self.groggy_anim = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('damaged', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true)

end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
	end

	self.zone_bounds = battle_zone_bound

	-- 배틀액션
	self.laser_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossVeronicaLaser")
	self.judgement_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossVeronicaJudgement")
	self.stone_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossVeronicaStone")

	self.judgement_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bounds)

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.pattern_max = 3
	self.pattern_state = -1

	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)

	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local event_name = e:GetParamAt(0)

	if event_name == 'laser_activated' then
		if self.current_state ~= self.state.groggy then
			self.current_state = self.state.groggy
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
			self.is_groggy = true
			self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
			self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.groggy_anim)
			self.character:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
		end
	end

end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	end

	local action_idx = self:get_action_index()

	if action_idx == 0 then			-- 정화의 빛
		self.picked_battle_action = self.laser_action

	elseif action_idx == 1 then		-- 염력
		self.picked_battle_action = self.stone_action

	elseif action_idx == 2 then		-- 천벌
		self.picked_battle_action = self.judgement_action

	end

	self.current_state = self.state.battle

end

function local_class:get_action_index()

	self.pattern_state = self.pattern_state + 1

	if self.pattern_state >= self.pattern_max then
		self.pattern_state = 0
	end

	return self.pattern_state
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		return
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 다음액션 진행
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self.current_state = self.state.none
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
			self.is_groggy = false
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion()
		end
	else
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	self:change_state()
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:dispose()

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.pattern_state = -1
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

--- 월드 22 volcano_mana 보스 손 monster의 AI
local local_class = newclass('BossVolcanoHandBattleAIState')

function local_class:init(owner, target, param, cs_state)
	-- 기본 구현
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.owner = owner
	self.target = target

	--- ai 상태
	self.ai_state = {
		wait = 1,
		acting = 2
	}
	--- 현재 이 ai의 상태
	self.current_state = nil

	--- 주인의 이름
	local master_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'MasterName')
	--- 주인 객체
	self.master = get_character(master_name)
	--- 액션 맵
	self.action_map = {}
	-- 테이블 순회하며 조회
	for trigger, reaction in pairs(cs_util.get_json_object_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionMap')) do
		self.action_map[trigger] = battle_util.get_battle_action_by_name(self.owner, reaction)
	end

	--- 버프 액션 맵
	self.buff_action_map = {}
	-- 테이블 순회하며 조회
	for trigger, reaction in pairs(cs_util.get_json_object_from_dictionary(param, 'BuffActionMap')) do
		self.buff_action_map[trigger] = battle_util.get_battle_action_by_name(self.owner, reaction)
	end
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	--- 가만히 있는다.
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	self:change_state(self.ai_state.wait)

	--- 액션 시전됨 이벤트
	self.on_action_started_func = function(e) self:on_action_started_event(e) end
	--- 버프 부여됨 이벤트
	self.on_buff_add_func = function(e) self:on_buff_add_event(e) end
	-- 액션 시전됨 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.battle_action_started, self.on_action_started_func)
	-- 버프 부여됨  이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.buff_add, self.on_buff_add_func)
end

function local_class:exit()
	-- 액션 시전됨 이벤트 구독 취소
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.battle_action_started, self.on_action_started_func)
	-- 버프 부여됨 이벤트 구독 취소
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.buff_add, self.on_buff_add_func)
	--- 액션 시전됨 이벤트 해제
	self.on_action_started_func = nil
	--- 버프 부여됨 이벤트 해제
	self.on_buff_add_func = nil

	self.cs_state:ChangeState(nil)
	self:change_state(nil)

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil

	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	-- cs_state가 해제된 뒤라면 처리할 필요가 없다.
	if not self.cs_state then return false end

	-- 타겟 변경됨 이벤트라면 타겟을 바꿔준다.
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TargetChangedEvent) then self.target = e.Target end

	return false
end

function local_class:change_target()
	--- 메뉴얼 타겟팅
	local new_target = battle_ai_util.search_random_manual_target(self.cs_state)
	-- 같은 타겟이면 굳이 갱신 X
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then return end
	-- 대상 일단 로컬에 갱신해둠
	self.target = new_target
	-- 대상이 변경되었음을 커맨드로 공유
	command_util.publish_change_target(self.owner, self.target)
end


function local_class:on_action_started_event(e)
	-- 이벤트 검증
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, event_type.battle_action_started) then return end
	-- 시전자 검증
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.master, e.Owner) then return end
	-- 액션 선택
	self:pick_battle_action_and_target(e.BattleAction)
	-- 정상적으로 pick에 성공한 경우
	if self.picked_battle_action and self.target then
		self:change_state(self.ai_state.acting)
	end
end

function local_class:on_buff_add_event(e)
	-- 이벤트 검증
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, event_type.buff_add) then return end
	--- 추가된 버프
	local buff = e.Buff
	--- 버프를 보낸 객체 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.master, buff.Sender) then return end
	--- 버프를 받은 객체 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.master, buff.Target) then return end
	-- 액션 선택
	self:pick_battle_action_and_target_on_buff(buff.BuffSpec.Name)
	-- 정상적으로 pick에 성공한 경우
	if self.picked_battle_action and self.target then
		self:change_state(self.ai_state.acting)
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target(triggered_action)
	local handle_name = battle_util.get_battle_action_handle_name(triggered_action)
	local next_action = self.action_map[handle_name]

	if next_action == nil then return end

	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.picked_battle_action = next_action

	--- 메뉴얼 타겟팅
	self:change_target()
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target_on_buff(buff_name)
	local next_action = self.buff_action_map[buff_name]

	if next_action == nil then return end

	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.picked_battle_action = next_action

	--- 메뉴얼 타겟팅
	self:change_target()
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	-- 조작 불가한 상태면 그냥 이탈
	if not can_control then return end

	if self.current_state == self.ai_state.rest then
		-- 아무것도 안함
	elseif self.current_state == self.ai_state.acting then
		self:update_acting(dt)
	end
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_acting(_)
	-- 배틀액션 종료를 대기하는 동안의 처리
	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 flee로 변경
		if not battle_ai_util.is_battle_action_active(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false

			self:change_state(self.ai_state.rest)
		end

		return
	end

	-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
	-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
	if battle_ai_util.is_battle_action_hittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
		battle_ai_util.trigger_battle_action(self.owner, self.picked_battle_action) then
		-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
		self.battle_action_triggered = true

		-- 시전 시도 시간을 지난 상태라면...
	elseif self.time_passed >= self.act_try_time then
		-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
		if battle_ai_util.trigger_battle_action(self.owner, self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		else
			-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리
			-- 대기 상태로 복귀한다.
			self:change_state(self.ai_state.rest)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- 액션 시전됨 이벤트 구독 취소
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.battle_action_started, self.on_action_started_func)
	-- 버프 부여됨 이벤트 구독 취소
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.buff_add, self.on_buff_add_func)
	--- 액션 시전됨 이벤트 해제
	self.on_action_started_func = nil
	--- 버프 부여됨 이벤트 해제
	self.on_buff_add_func = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.master = nil

	--- 캐싱한 액션들 전부 해제
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_map, self.buff_action_map)
	self.action_map = nil
	self.buff_action_map = nil

	self.action_index = nil
	self.action_count = nil
end

return { create = function(owner, target, param, cs_state) return local_class(owner, target, param, cs_state) end }

		rest = 1,
		acting = 2,
		rampage = 3
	}
	self.current_state = nil

	-- AI 스펙 로드

	--- 초회 대기 시간
	self.initial_rest_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'InitialRestTime')
	--- 최소 대기 시간
	self.min_rest_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MinRestTime')
	--- 최대 대기 시간
	local max_rest_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxRestTime')
	--- 최대 - 최소 대기 시잔
	self.additional_rest_time = math.max(max_rest_time, 0)

	--- 액션 시전 시도 기산
	self.act_try_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActTryTime')

	--- 기본 액션 테이블
	self.action_table = {}
	--- 순회
	for _, action_name in pairs(cs_util.get_string_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionFlow')) do
		table.insert(self.action_table, battle_util.get_battle_action_by_name(self.owner, action_name))
	end

	--- 폭주 액션 테이블
	self.rampage_action_table = {}
	--- 순회
	for _, action_name in pairs(cs_util.get_string_table_from_dictionary(param, 'RampageActionFlow')) do
		table.insert(self.rampage_action_table, battle_util.get_battle_action_by_name(self.owner, action_name))
	end

	--- 폭주 체크를 생략한 index
	self.rampage_ignore = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'RampageIgnore')

	--- 폭주 타이밍
	self.rampage_hp = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'RampageHp')
	--- 폭주 레벨
	self.rampage_level = nil
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	--- 가만히 있는다.
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	--- action idx 를 가지고 순차적으로 반복한다.
	self.action_index = 0

	-- 폭주 레벨 갱신
	self.rampage_level = self:calculate_rampage_level(0)

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(self.ai_state.rest)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(nil)
	self:change_state(nil)

	self.rampage_level = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.action_index = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	-- cs_state가 해제된 뒤라면 처리할 필요가 없다.
	if not self.cs_state then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟 변경됨 이벤트라면 타겟을 바꿔준다.
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TargetChangedEvent) then
		self.target = e.Target
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:change_target()
	--- 메뉴얼 타겟팅
	local new_target = battle_ai_util.search_random_manual_target(self.cs_state)
	-- 같은 타겟이면 굳이 갱신 X
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then return end
	-- 대상 일단 로컬에 갱신해둠
	self.target = new_target
	-- 대상이 변경되었음을 커맨드로 공유
	command_util.publish_change_target(self.owner, self.target)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	-- 패턴을 아직 고르지 않은 경우 (정규 루틴)
	self.action_index = (self.action_index % #self.action_table) + 1
	self.picked_battle_action = self.action_table[self.action_index]

	--- 메뉴얼 타겟팅
	self:change_target()
end

function local_class:pick_rampage_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	self.action_index = self.action_index + 1

	-- 폭주 액션을 전부 사용했으면 초기화 한다.
	if self.action_index > #self.rampage_action_table then
		self.action_index = 0
	else
		self.picked_battle_action = self.rampage_action_table[self.action_index]

		--- 메뉴얼 타겟팅
		self:change_target()
	end
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	-- 조작 불가한 상태면 그냥 이탈
	if not can_control then return end

	if self.current_state == self.ai_state.rest then
		self:update_resting(dt)
	elseif self.current_state == self.ai_state.acting then
		self:update_acting(dt)
	elseif self.current_state == self.ai_state.rampage then
		self:update_rampaging()
	end
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0

	if next_state == self.ai_state.rest then
		self.current_rest_time = self.current_rest_time and
			self.current_rest_time or
			self.min_rest_time + self.additional_rest_time * math.random()

		self.picked_battle_action = nil
		self.battle_action_triggered = false
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_resting(_)
	-- 대기 시간이 지나기 전이면 아무것도 하지 않는다.
	if self.time_passed < self.current_rest_time then return end

	--- 폭주 갱신되었는지
	local rampage_updated = not self:ignore_rampage_check() and self:refresh_rampage()

	-- 폭주 돌입 가능한 경우
	if rampage_updated then
		-- 배틀액션 및 대상 선정 시도
		self:pick_rampage_action_and_target()
		-- 대상이 없으면 다음번을 기약함
		if self.target == nil then return end
		-- 다음 상태로 넘어감
		self:change_state(self.ai_state.rampage)

	-- 기본 루틴
	else
		-- 배틀액션 및 대상 선정 시도
		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		-- 대상이 없으면 다음번을 기약함
		if self.target == nil then return end
		-- 다음 상태로 넘어감
		self:change_state(self.ai_state.acting)
	end
end

function local_class:update_acting(_)
	-- 배틀액션 종료를 대기하는 동안의 처리
	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 flee로 변경
		if not battle_ai_util.is_battle_action_active(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false

			self:change_state(self.ai_state.rest)
		end

		return
	end

	-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
	-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
	if battle_ai_util.is_battle_action_hittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
		battle_ai_util.trigger_battle_action(self.owner, self.picked_battle_action) then
		-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
		self.battle_action_triggered = true

	-- 시전 시도 시간을 지난 상태라면...
	elseif self.time_passed >= self.act_try_time then
		-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
		if battle_ai_util.trigger_battle_action(self.owner, self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		else
			-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리
			-- 대기 상태로 복귀한다.
			self:change_state(self.ai_state.rest)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_rampaging()
	-- 배틀액션 종료를 대기하는 동안의 처리
	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 다시 pick을 시도
		if not battle_ai_util.is_battle_action_active(self.picked_battle_action) then
			-- 다음 폭주 패턴 선정
			self:pick_rampage_action_and_target()
			-- 만약 선택된 패턴이 없다면, 그냥 쉰다.
			if not self.picked_battle_action then self:change_state(self.ai_state.rest) end
		end

		return
	end

	-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
	-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
	if battle_ai_util.is_battle_action_hittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
		battle_ai_util.trigger_battle_action(self.owner, self.picked_battle_action) then
		-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
		self.battle_action_triggered = true
		-- 시전 시도 시간을 지난 상태라면...
	elseif self.time_passed >= self.act_try_time then
		-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
		if battle_ai_util.trigger_battle_action(self.owner, self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		else
			-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리
			-- 대기 상태로 복귀한다.
			self:change_state(self.ai_state.rest)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:ignore_rampage_check()
	return self.action_index >= self.rampage_ignore[1] and self.action_index < self.rampage_ignore[2]
end

function local_class:refresh_rampage()
	--- 이전 폭주 레벨
	local prev_level = self.rampage_level
	--- 다음 폭주 레벨
	self.rampage_level = self:calculate_rampage_level(self.rampage_level, true)
	--- 레벨이 바뀌었는지
	local level_changed = prev_level ~= self.rampage_level
	-- 폭주 돌입 시 액션 인덱스 갱신
	if self.rampage_level ~= prev_level then self.action_index = 0 end
	-- 변경 여부 반환
	return level_changed
end

function local_class:calculate_rampage_level(level, one_by_one)
	local result = level

	-- one_by_one: 레벨이 하나씩 증가함, ai 플로우 중에 사용할 것
	-- 기본값 or false로 두는 경우 한번에 레벨의 최대치가 됨
	local start_point = one_by_one and level + 1 or #self.rampage_hp
	local end_point = not one_by_one and level + 1 or #self.rampage_hp
	local step = one_by_one and 1 or -1

	for idx = start_point, end_point, step do
		if character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.owner) <= self.rampage_hp[idx] then
			result = idx
			break
		end
	end

	return result
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.additional_rest_time = nil

	--- 캐싱한 액션들 전부 해제
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_table)
	self.action_table = nil
	self.rampage_action_table = nil
	self.rampage_hp = nil

	self.action_index = nil
	self.action_count = nil
end

return { create = function(owner, target, param, cs_state) return local_class(owner, target, param, cs_state) end }
