local local_class = newclass("BossWolfSingleRaidBattleAIState")

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	-- 기본 구현
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 7.0)
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 1.0)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 1.5)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 배틀 액션 데이터
	self.slash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossWolfSlash:SingleRaid")
	self.bomb_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossWolfBomb:SingleRaid")
	self.charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossWolfPounce:SingleRaid")
	self.big_bomb_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossWolfBigBombSingleRaid")

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time

	self.prev_battle_action = nil
	self.charge_count = 0
	self.cycle_count = 0
	self.character.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if self.prev_battle_action == nil then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
		self.charge_count = 0
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.slash_action then
		--거리에 따라 분기
		if vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.target.Position) < 4 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.bomb_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
			self.charge_count = 1
		end
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.charge_action and self.charge_count == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		self.charge_count = 2
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.charge_action and self.charge_count == 2 then
		self.cycle_count = self.cycle_count + 1
		if self.cycle_count >= 2 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.big_bomb_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
		end
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.bomb_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		self.charge_count = 2
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.big_bomb_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
	end

	self.prev_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
	self:change_target()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.slash_action = nil
	self.bomb_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
	self.big_bomb_action = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.prev_battle_action = nil
	self.character.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true, true))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

	self.charge_count = 0
	self.cycle_count = 0
	self.character.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if self.prev_battle_action == nil then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
		self.charge_count = 0
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.slash_action then
		--거리에 따라 분기
		if vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.target.Position) < 4 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.bomb_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
			self.charge_count = 1
		end
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.charge_action and self.charge_count == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		self.charge_count = 2
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.charge_action and self.charge_count == 2 then
		self.cycle_count = self.cycle_count + 1
		if self.cycle_count >= 2 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.big_bomb_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
		end
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.bomb_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		self.charge_count = 2
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.big_bomb_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
	end

	self.prev_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
	self:change_target()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.slash_action = nil
	self.bomb_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
	self.big_bomb_action = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.prev_battle_action = nil
	self.character.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true, true))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)

	self.kick_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossWrestlerSomersaultKick')
	self.spiral_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossWrestlerSpiralArrow')
	self.runaway_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'CommonRunaway:Wrestler')

	self.runaway_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.spiral_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.prev_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.action_amount = 6
	self.action_count = 0
	self.current_circling_duration = 0

	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
			random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_circling_duration then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
		end
		return
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			-- 배틀 액션 사용 끝나면 n%확률 & radius만큼 적이 있다면 런웨이 액션 실행
			if self.picked_battle_action ~= self.runaway_action and random_util.get_random_value() <= self.runaway_chance then
				local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.runaway_radius)
				local is_close = false
				for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
						is_close = true
						break
					end
				end
				fo_list:Dispose()

				if is_close then
					self.picked_battle_action = self.runaway_action
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					return
				end
			end

			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
			self.current_circling_duration = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_circling_duration, self.max_circling_duration)

			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
					random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
		end
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
		self.battle_action_triggered = true
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))

	local idx = self.action_count % self.action_amount
	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.combo_action
	elseif idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.lariat_action
	elseif idx == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.combo_action
	elseif idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.kick_action
	elseif idx == 4 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.lariat_action
	elseif idx == 5 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.spiral_action
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action ~= self.runaway_action then
		self.action_count = self.action_count + 1
	end
	self.prev_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

end

local local_class = newclass("BossYakshaPhase1BattleAIState")

local action_node = {}

function action_node:new_action(action, next_idx)
	local t = {
		action = action,
		next_idx = next_idx
	}

	setmetatable(t, {__index = action_node})
	return t
end

function action_node:new_condition(get_next_node)
	local t = {
		get_next_action_node_call_back = get_next_node
	}

	setmetatable(t, {__index = action_node})
	return t
end

function action_node:get_next_action_node()

	local next_node = self.owner.battle_action_index_map[self.next_idx]

	while next_node:is_condition_node() do
		next_node = next_node.get_next_action_node_call_back(self.owner)
	end

	return next_node
end

function action_node:is_condition_node()
	return self.action == nil
end

function action_node:dispose()
	self.action = nil
	self.next_idx = nil
	self.get_next_action_node_call_back = nil
end

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	action_node.owner = self

	self.follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FollowTime', 5)
	self.left_follow_time = self.follow_time
	self.follow_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FollowRestTime', 1)

	self.pattern_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PatternTime', 5)
	self.left_pattern_time = self.pattern_time
	self.pattern_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PatternRestTime', 1)

	self.is_hard = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsHard', false)

	self.wisp_cool_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'WispCoolTime', 15)
	self.wisp_time_passed = 0

	self.state = {
		follow_trigger = 0,
		follow_battle = 1,
		follow_rest = 2,
		pattern_trigger = 3,
		pattern_battle = 4,
		pattern_rest = 5,
	}
	self.current_state = -1
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.rest_time_passed = 0
	self.saya_stone_cnt = 0
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'groggy_started' then
		self.groggy_synced = true
		self.is_in_groggy = true
		if self.cs_state.CurrentState == CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState then
			self.prev_state = 'idle'
		else
			self.prev_state = 'follow'
		end
		self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'groggy_ended' then
		self.groggy_synced = true
		self.is_in_groggy = false
		if self.prev_state == 'idle' then
			self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
		elseif self.prev_state == 'follow' then
			self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
		end

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'update_stone_count' then
		self.saya_stone_cnt = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'groggy_sync' then
		self.groggy_synced = true
		self.is_in_groggy = e:GetParamAt(1) == 'true'

	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self:is_follow_state(self.current_state) then
		self.left_follow_time = self.left_follow_time - self.time_passed
	else
		self.left_pattern_time = self.left_pattern_time - self.time_passed
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	self.current_state = next_state

	--enter
	if not self:is_follow_state(prev_state) and self:is_follow_state(self.current_state) then
		self.cs_state:ChangeState((CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false)))
		self.left_follow_time = self.follow_time

	elseif self:is_follow_state(prev_state) and not self:is_follow_state(self.current_state) then
		self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
		self.left_pattern_time = self.pattern_time

	end

end

function local_class:is_follow_state(state)
	return state == self.state.follow_trigger or state == self.state.follow_battle or state == self.state.follow_rest
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()

	if self.is_hard then
		self.basic_attack_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossYakshaBasicAttack:Hard')

		self.water_storm_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossYakshaWaterStorm:Hard')
		self.perfect_wave_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossYakshaPerfectWave:Hard')

		self.battojutsu_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossYakshaBattojutsu:Hard')

		self.water_storm_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossYakshaWaterStorm')
		self.perfect_wave_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossYakshaPerfectWave')

		self.wisp_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossYakshaWisp')
		self.battojutsu_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossYakshaBattojutsu')
		self.fire_bounce_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossYakshaFireBounce')
	end

	self.pattern_idx = {
		wisp = 1,
		battojutsu = 2,
		fire_bounce = 3,
		water_storm = 4,
		perfect_wave = 5,

		wisp_condition = 10,
		seal_stone_condition = 11,
		water_storm_hit_condition = 12,
	}

	self.battle_action_index_map = {
		[self.pattern_idx.wisp] = action_node:new_action(self.wisp_action, self.pattern_idx.wisp_condition),
		[self.pattern_idx.battojutsu] = action_node:new_action(self.battojutsu_action, self.pattern_idx.fire_bounce),
		[self.pattern_idx.fire_bounce] = action_node:new_action(self.fire_bounce_action, self.pattern_idx.wisp_condition),

		[self.pattern_idx.water_storm] = action_node:new_action(self.water_storm_action, self.pattern_idx.water_storm_hit_condition),
		[self.pattern_idx.perfect_wave] = action_node:new_action(self.perfect_wave_action, self.pattern_idx.wisp_condition),

		[self.pattern_idx.wisp_condition] = action_node:new_condition(self.wisp_condition),
		[self.pattern_idx.seal_stone_condition] = action_node:new_condition(self.seal_stone_condition),
		[self.pattern_idx.water_storm_hit_condition] = action_node:new_condition(self.water_storm_hit_condition),
	}
	self.current_node = nil

	self:change_state(self.state.follow_rest)

	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'init_stone_count' }))

	self.groggy_synced = false
end

function local_class:wisp_condition()
	if self.wisp_time_passed >= self.wisp_cool_time then
		self.wisp_time_passed = 0
		return self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.wisp]
	else
		return self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.seal_stone_condition]
	end
end

function local_class:seal_stone_condition()
	if self.saya_stone_cnt > 0 then
		return self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.battojutsu]
	else
		return self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.water_storm]
	end
end

function local_class:water_storm_hit_condition()
	if self.water_storm_action.MetaTable:is_pattern_hit() then
		return self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.perfect_wave]
	else
		return self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.wisp_condition]
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action()

	if self.current_node == nil then
		self.current_node = self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.wisp]
	else
		self.current_node = self.current_node:get_next_action_node()
	end

	self:renew_target()
end

function local_class:renew_target()
	self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.basic_attack_action = nil

	self.wisp_action = nil
	self.battojutsu_action = nil
	self.fire_bounce_action = nil

	self.water_storm_action = nil
	self.perfect_wave_action = nil

	self.pattern_idx = nil

	self.battle_action_index_map = nil
	self.current_node = nil

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	-- return bool
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if not self.groggy_synced then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'init_groggy_info' }))

		return
	end

	if not can_control or self.is_in_groggy then

	end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	self.wisp_time_passed = self.wisp_time_passed + dt

	self:renew_target()

	if self.current_state == self.state.follow_trigger then
		if self.time_passed > self.left_follow_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.pattern_trigger)
		else

					and CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.basic_attack_action) then

local action_node = {}

function action_node:new_action(action, next_idx, callback)
	local t = {
		action = action,
		next_idx = next_idx,
		callback = callback
	}

	setmetatable(t, {__index = action_node})
	return t
end

function action_node:new_condition(get_next_node, is_yield_condition)
	local t = {
		get_next_action_node_call_back = get_next_node,
		is_yield_condition = is_yield_condition,
	}

	setmetatable(t, {__index = action_node})
	return t
end

function action_node:get_next_action_node()
	local next_node

	if not self:is_condition_node() then
		next_node = self.owner.battle_action_index_map[self.next_idx]
		if self.callback ~= nil then
			self.callback(self.owner)
		end
	else
		next_node = self
	end


	while next_node:is_condition_node() do
		if next_node.is_yield_condition then
			next_node = next_node.get_next_action_node_call_back(self.owner)
			break
		else
			next_node = next_node.get_next_action_node_call_back(self.owner)
		end
	end

	return next_node
end

function action_node:is_condition_node()
	return self.action == nil
end

function action_node:dispose()
	self.action = nil
	self.next_idx = nil
	self.get_next_action_node_call_back = nil
end

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)

function local_class:change_state(next_state, force_initialize_left_time)
	--exit

	elseif self:is_pattern_state(self.current_state) then
		self.left_pattern_time = self.left_pattern_time - self.time_passed
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	self.current_state = next_state

	if self:is_pattern_state(prev_state) and self:is_follow_state(self.current_state) or self:is_follow_state(self.current_state) and force_initialize_left_time then
		self.cs_state:ChangeState((CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false)))

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'sword_parked' then
		self.sword_parked = true
		self.all_sword_parked = e:GetParamAt(1) == 'all'
		if self.current_state == self.state.follow_battle then
			self.time_passed = 999
		elseif self.current_state == self.state.pattern_battle then
			self:change_state(self.state.pattern_battle, true)
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.pattern_trigger, true)
		end

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'sword_summoned' then
		self.current_element = e:GetParamAt(1)
		self.sword_summoned = true
		self.sword_park_time_passed = 0
		self.update_sword_park = true

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'lightning_one_canceled' then
		if self:is_in_ailment() then
			self.lightning_one_canceled = true
		end

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'groggy_started' then
		self.groggy_synced = true
		self.is_in_groggy = true
		if self.cs_state.CurrentState == CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState then
			self.prev_state = 'idle'
		else
			self.prev_state = 'follow'
		end
		self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
		if not self.is_hard then
			self.skip_lightning_one = true
		end

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'groggy_ended' then
		self.groggy_synced = true
		self.is_in_groggy = false
		if self.prev_state == 'idle' then
			self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
		elseif self.prev_state == 'follow' then
			self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
		end

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'sword_info' then
		self:determine_first_action(e:GetParamAt(1), tonumber(e:GetParamAt(2)), tonumber(e:GetParamAt(3)))

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'groggy_sync' then
		self.groggy_synced = true
		self.is_in_groggy = e:GetParamAt(1) == 'true'

	end
end

function local_class:determine_first_action(current_element, left_sword_count, summon_sword_time_passed)
	--현재 소환상태 검 o
	if current_element ~= nil then
		self.current_element = current_element
		self.current_node = self.first_element_action_table[self.current_element]
		self.update_sword_park = true
		self.sword_park_time_passed = summon_sword_time_passed

	else
		--소환된 검 x
		if left_sword_count == 3 then
			self.current_node = self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.first_perfect_wave]

		--소환된 검 o
		else
			--절명
			if left_sword_count == 0 then
				self.sword_parked = true
				self.all_sword_parked = true
				self.current_node = self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.wait_parking]

			--소환할 검 o
			else
				self:summon_sword()
				self.current_node = self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.wait_summon]

			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_in_ailment()
	return lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterDownState)
			or lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterCommonAilmentState)
			or lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterAerialState)
			or lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterPoisonState)
end

function local_class:get_lightning_random()
	return random_util.get_random_value() > 0.5
			and self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.random_thunder]
			or self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.random_lightning_storm]
end

function local_class:get_water_random()
	return random_util.get_random_value() > 0.5
			and self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.random_perfect_wave]
			or self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.random_water_storm]
end

function local_class:wait_parking()
	self:change_state(self.state.pattern_trigger, true)

	return self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.wait_parking]

function local_class:summon_sword()

function local_class:wait_summon()

	if self.sword_summoned then
		self.sword_summoned = false

		return self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.wait_summon]

function local_class:pick_battle_action()

	if self.current_node == nil then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'init_sword_info' }))

	else
		if self.sword_parked then
			self.sword_parked = false
			if not self.all_sword_parked then
				self:change_state(self.state.pattern_trigger, true)
				if self.is_hard then
					self:delayed_summon_random_sword()
					self:change_state(self.state.follow_rest)
				else
					self:delayed_summon_sword()
					self:change_state(self.state.follow_rest)
				end
				self.current_node = self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.wait_summon]
			else
				if self.skip_lightning_one then
					self.skip_lightning_one = false
					self:lightning_one_end()
					self.current_node = self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.first_perfect_wave]
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.pattern_trigger, true)
					self.current_node = self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.lightning_one]
				end
			end
		else
			self.current_node = self.current_node:get_next_action_node()
		end
	end

	self:renew_target()
end

function local_class:renew_target()
	self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.basic_attack_action = nil

	self.wisp_action = nil
	self.battojutsu_action = nil
	self.fire_bounce_action = nil

	self.water_storm_action = nil
	self.perfect_wave_action = nil

	self.pattern_idx = nil

	self.battle_action_index_map = nil
	self.first_element_action_table = nil
	self.current_node = nil

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentEndedEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Character) then
		if self.lightning_one_canceled then
			self.lightning_one_canceled = false
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'add_groggy', self.cancel_groggy }))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'pattern_canceled' }))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'try_groggy_trigger' }))
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if not self.groggy_synced then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'init_groggy_info' }))

		return
	end

	if self.update_sword_park then
		self:update_park_sword_time(dt)
	end

	if self.update_summon_sword then
		self:update_summon_sword_time(dt)
	end

	if self.update_summon_random_sword then
		self:update_summon_random_sword_time(dt)
	end

	if not can_control or self.is_in_groggy then
		return
	end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self:renew_target()

	if self.current_state == self.state.follow_trigger then
		if self.time_passed > self.left_follow_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.pattern_trigger)
		else
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.basic_attack_action, self.target)
					and CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.basic_attack_action) then
				self:change_state(self.state.follow_battle)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.follow_battle then
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.basic_attack_action) then
			if self.time_passed > self.left_follow_time then
				self:change_state(self.state.pattern_trigger)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.follow_rest)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.follow_rest then
		if self.time_passed > self.left_follow_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.pattern_trigger)

		elseif self.time_passed > self.follow_rest_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.follow_trigger)

		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.pattern_trigger then
		if self.time_passed > self.left_pattern_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.follow_rest)
		else
			self:pick_battle_action()
			if not self.current_node:is_condition_node() then
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.current_node.action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.current_node.action) then
					if self.current_node ~= self.battle_action_index_map[self.pattern_idx.lightning_one] then
						message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'trigger_action' }))
					end
					self:change_state(self.state.pattern_battle)
				end
			end

		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.pattern_battle then
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.current_node.action) then
			if self.time_passed > self.left_pattern_time then
				self:change_state(self.state.follow_rest)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.pattern_rest)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.pattern_rest then
		if self.time_passed > self.left_pattern_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.follow_rest)

		elseif self.time_passed > self.pattern_rest_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.pattern_trigger)

		end

	end
end

function local_class:update_park_sword_time(dt)
	self.sword_park_time_passed = self.sword_park_time_passed + dt

	if self.sword_park_time_passed > self.sword_park_time then
		self:park_sword()
		self.update_sword_park = false
		self.sword_park_time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:update_summon_sword_time(dt)
	self.summon_sword_time_passed = self.summon_sword_time_passed + dt

	if self.summon_sword_time_passed > self.summon_sword_delay then
		self:summon_sword()
		self.update_summon_sword = false
		self.summon_sword_time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:update_summon_random_sword_time(dt)
	self.summon_random_sword_time_passed = self.summon_random_sword_time_passed + dt

	if self.summon_random_sword_time_passed > self.summon_sword_delay then
		self:summon_random_sword()
		self.update_summon_random_sword = false
		self.summon_random_sword_time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.basic_attack_action = nil

	self.wisp_action = nil
	self.battojutsu_action = nil
	self.fire_bounce_action = nil

	self.water_storm_action = nil
	self.perfect_wave_action = nil

	self.pattern_idx = nil

	self.battle_action_index_map = nil
	self.current_node = nil

	action_node.owner = nil

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("ConquestPanelBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.circling_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'CirclingDuration')
	self.initial_circling_distance = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'InitialCirclingDistance')
	self.min_circling_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MinCirclingRadius')
	self.max_circling_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MaxCirclingRadius')
	self.circling_change_direction = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(params, 'CirclingChangeDirection')
	self.circling_change_direction_period = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'CirclingChangeDirectionPeriod')
	self.is_dash_circling = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(params, 'IsDashCircling')

	self.initial_rest_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, "InitialRestTime")
	self.min_rest_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MinRestTime')
	self.max_rest_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MaxRestTime')
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 몬스터 배틀 액션 등록 + 선 딜레이 적용
	self.battle_actions = {}
	local holding_actions = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions;
	for i = 0, holding_actions.Count - 1 do
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(holding_actions[i], typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterBattleAction)) then
			holding_actions[i]:ChangeBattleActionState2StartRest()
			table.insert(self.battle_actions, holding_actions[i])
		end
	end
	self.active_battle_action = nil

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.state_duration = 0
	self.circling_entered = false
	self:change_to_idle(self.initial_rest_time)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.battle_actions = nil
	self.active_battle_action = nil

	self.time_passed = nil
	self.state_duration = nil
	self.circling_entered = nil
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(nil)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target()
	local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchLeastTargetedOpponent(self.cs_state)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = new_target
	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action()
	for _, battle_action in ipairs(self.battle_actions) do
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsAvailable(battle_action) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(battle_action, self.target) then
			return battle_action
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function local_class:change_to_circling(radius)
	local circling_radius = radius and radius or unity_class.random.Range(self.min_circling_radius, self.max_circling_radius)
	self.state_duration = self.circling_duration
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, circling_radius, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5,
			self.circling_change_direction, self.circling_change_direction_period, self.is_dash_circling, 1))
end

function local_class:change_to_idle(duration)
	self.state_duration = duration and duration or unity_class.random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if self.active_battle_action and
			not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.active_battle_action) then
		self.active_battle_action = nil
		return
	end

	-- 배틀액션 시전중엔 time_passed를 갱신하지 않는다.
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		local battle_action = self:pick_battle_action()
		if battle_action and CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, battle_action) then
			self.active_battle_action = battle_action
			self:change_to_idle()
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.state_duration then
			self:change_target()
			self:change_to_circling()
		end
	elseif CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed > self.state_duration then
			self:change_target()
			if self.circling_entered then
				self:change_to_circling()
			else
				self:change_to_circling(self.initial_circling_distance)
				self.circling_entered = true
			end

		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.circling_duration = nil
	self.initial_circling_distance = nil
	self.min_circling_radius = nil
	self.max_circling_radius = nil
	self.circling_change_direction = nil
	self.circling_change_direction_period = nil
	self.is_dash_circling = nil

	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('CoopDefenseBossBattleAIState')

--[[
협동전 방어전 용 보스 AI
기본적으로 PatrolState 처럼 경로 이동
중간에 일정 구간에 도달할 때 커스텀 이벤트 받아서 돌진 처리(특수 공격)
최종 거점 존에 도달하면 일반적인 전투 상태로 전환하여 거점을 공격한다. (공격1,공격2)
]]

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c

	-- 타겟 무시하고 고정타겟 사용
	self.target = self.character.FieldObjectController.LockedTarget

	self.waypoints = c.FieldObjectController.Waypoints
	self.waypoint_index = 0

	-- 파라미터 스펙 로드
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FollowTime', 6.0)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MinRestTime', 1.0)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxRestTime', 1.5)

	self.signature_action_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'SignatureAction')
	self.normal_action_names = CS.Utils.GetStringListFromDictionary(params, 'NormalActions')
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션 데이터 가져오기
	if self.signature_action_name ~= nil then
		self.signature_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self.signature_action_name)
	end

	self.normal_actions = {}
	for i = 0, self.normal_action_names.Count - 1 do
		local action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self.normal_action_names[i])
		table.insert(self.normal_actions, action)
	end

	-- 중앙존에 있으면 일반 전투 상태, 아니라면 경로 이동 상태
	self.danger_zone = field:GetZone('danger_zone')

	self.on_zone_enter_event = function(e)
		if self.mode == 1 and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.character)
				and string.match(e.Zone.Name, 'danger_zone') then
			self:change_mode_to_battle()
		end

		return false
	end

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), self.on_zone_enter_event)

	if self.danger_zone:Contains(self.character.Position) then
		self:change_mode_to_battle()
	else
		self.mode = 1

		if self.waypoints.Count > 1 then
			local min_dist = 1000000
			local candidate_idx = 0
			local cur_pos = self.character.Position:GetXz()

			for i = 1, self.waypoints.Count - 1 do
				local p1 = self.waypoints[i - 1]:GetXz()
				local p2 = self.waypoints[i]:GetXz()
				local d = CS.GeometryUtils.PointLineDistance2D(cur_pos, p1, p2)

				if d < min_dist then
					min_dist = d
					candidate_idx = i
				end
			end

			-- 경로상에서 10 이상 벗어났다면 웨이포인트 벗어난 것으로 판단
			if (min_dist < 10) then
				self.waypoint_index = candidate_idx
			end
		end

		-- 여기서 이동 제어할 것이므로 C# 스테이트는 idle
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.on_zone_enter_event ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), self.on_zone_enter_event)
		self.on_zone_enter_event = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.mode == 1 and self.signature_action ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'trigger_signature_action' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.character) then
			-- 시그니처 공격 예약
			self.reserve_signature_action = true
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.reserve_signature_action == true then
		-- 시그니처 공격은 hittable 체크 안함
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.signature_action) then
			self.reserve_signature_action = false
		end
	elseif self.mode == 1 then
		self:update_waypoint_move(dt)
	else
		self:update_battle_ai()
	end
end

-- 웨이포인트 이동 업데이트 처리
function local_class:update_waypoint_move(dt)
	-- 배틀 액션이 행동 제어를 하고 있는 경우 이동 처리 안함
	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanControlCharacter(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return
	end

	local remain_move_dist = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.WalkSpeed * dt
	local pos = self.character.Position

	local target_pos = self.waypoints[self.waypoint_index]
	local diff = (target_pos - pos):GetX0z()
	local dest_diff = diff.magnitude
	local move_pos = unity_class.vector3.MoveTowards(pos, target_pos, remain_move_dist)

	while remain_move_dist > 0 and dest_diff < remain_move_dist do
		-- 다음 웨이포인트 체크
		if self.waypoint_index + 1 < self.waypoints.Count then
			pos = self.waypoints[self.waypoint_index]
			remain_move_dist = remain_move_dist - dest_diff

			self.waypoint_index = self.waypoint_index + 1
			target_pos = self.waypoints[self.waypoint_index]
			diff = (target_pos - pos):GetX0z()
			dest_diff = diff.magnitude
			move_pos = unity_class.vector3.MoveTowards(pos, target_pos, remain_move_dist)
		else
			-- 배틀 상태로 넘겨준다. (이 전에 존 처리에 의해 전환 될 것이므로 발생하지 않을 것)
			self:change_mode_to_battle()

			move_pos = target_pos

			break
		end
	end

	local move_diff = (move_pos - self.character.Position):GetX0z()
	local dest_amount = move_diff.magnitude
	local dir = move_diff.normalized

	if dir ~= unity_class.vector3.zero then
		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = dir
		move_info.magnitude = dest_amount
		move_info.types = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope

		-- 캐릭터에게 이동 이벤트를 보냄
		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, dir:ToDirection(), false)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
	end
end

function local_class:change_mode_to_battle()
	self.mode = 2
	self.action_count = 0
	self:process_to_next_action()

	-- 시그니처 액션 발동 중 존 입장했을 경우, 액션이 완료된 후 동작이 이어지도록 처리 (평타에 캔슬 안되도록)
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.signature_action) then
		self.battle_action_triggered = true
		self.picked_battle_action = self.signature_action
		-- 일반 패턴 순서에 영향 안끼치도록 다시 카운트 0으로
		self.action_count = 0
	end
end

-- 전투 상태 처리
function local_class:update_battle_ai()
	-- 중간에 쉬는 타임
	if self.idling == true then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:process_to_next_action()
		end
	else
		-- 배틀액션 사용 중
		if self.battle_action_triggered == true then
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.idling = true
				self.current_rest_time = self.min_rest_time + math.random() * (self.max_rest_time - self.min_rest_time)
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
			end
		else
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
			elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action)
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:process_to_next_action()
	self.idling = false
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.action_count = self.action_count + 1
	if self.action_count > #self.normal_actions then
		self.action_count = self.action_count - #self.normal_actions
	end

	self.picked_battle_action = self.normal_actions[self.action_count]

function local_class:update_circling_move()
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리

			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					if self.picked_battle_action == self.after_cc_action then

					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))

					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then

					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then

						-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then

	self.max_rest_time = nil

	self.circling_speed_factor = nil
	self.actions = nil

	--- 버프 추가시
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.CommonAilmentEvent)) then
		--self.need_buff_action = true
	end

	return false

	local far_targeting_action_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'FarTargetingAction')

	--- 일반 액션 테이블
	self.action_table = {}
	--- 이 캐릭터가 들고있는 액션들
	local held_actions = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions
	--- 순회
	for _, action in pairs(held_actions) do
		if battle_util.get_battle_action_handle_name(action) == far_targeting_action_name then
			self.far_targeting_action = action
		end

		table.insert(self.action_table, action)
	end

	self.action_index = 0

	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.action_index = 0

	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)

	self.battle_action_triggered = nil

		return false
	end

	-- 타겟 변경됨 이벤트라면 타겟을 바꿔준다.
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TargetChangedEvent) then
		self.target = e.Target
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		--- 어그로 가장 높은 놈을 타겟팅 한다.
		local new_target = battle_ai_util.search_target(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then

	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)

		self:change_target()

			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = unity_class.random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil

	self.circling_distance = nil
	self.circling_speed_factor = nil

	--- 캐싱한 액션들 전부 해제
	self.special_action = nil
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_table)
	self.action_table = nil
	self.action_index = nil
	self.action_count = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass("CoopExpeditionYakshaSwordBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	self.park_sword_message_name = 'sword_parked'
	self.summoned_message_name = 'sword_summoned'
	self.trigger_action_message_name = 'trigger_sword_action'
	self.boss_pattern = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'BossPattern', true)
	self.cool_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CoolTime', 5)
	self.cool_time_passed = 0
	self.delay_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ParkDelayTime', 5)
	self.delay_time_passed = 0
	self.element = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'Element', 'fire')
	self.coop_class_priority = {
		CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionClass.Dealer,
		CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionClass.Healer,
		CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionClass.Tanker,
	}
	self.aggro_table = {}

	self.normal_attack_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'NormalAttackDistance', 2)
	self.normal_attack_cool_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'NormalAttackCoolTime', 1)
	self.normal_attack_time_passed = 0
	self.modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'NormalAttackModifier', 1)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'NormalAttackKnockBackForce', 1)
	self.is_parked = false
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
	self.battle_action = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions[0]
	self.parked_battle_action = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions[1]

	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)

	self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.park_sword_message_name and e:GetParamAt(3) == self.element  then
		self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
		self.character.Position = self:string_to_vector(e:GetParamAt(2))

		self.is_parked = true
		self.delay_time_passed = 0
		self.in_parked_delay = true

		self.aggro_table = {}

		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == self.summoned_message_name and e:GetParamAt(1) == self.element then
		self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
		self.is_parked = false
		self.aggro_table = {}

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == self.trigger_action_message_name then
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.battle_action)
				and not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.parked_battle_action)
				and self.character.ActiveState & CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
				and self.boss_pattern
				and not self.in_parked_delay then
			if e.Sender ~= nil then
				self.sender = e.Sender
				self:renew_target()
			end

			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character,
					self.is_parked
							and self.parked_battle_action
							or self.battle_action)
		end
	end

	return false
end

--'a, b, c' 형태의 string
function local_class:string_to_vector(str)
	local value_table = {}

	local start_idx = 1
	local idx = string.find(str, ',', start_idx)
	while idx ~= nil do
		table.insert(value_table, tonumber(string.sub(str, start_idx, idx - 1)))
		start_idx = idx + 2
		idx = string.find(str, ',', start_idx)
	end
	table.insert(value_table, tonumber(string.sub(str, start_idx)))

	if #value_table == 3 then
		return vector(value_table[1], value_table[2], value_table[3])
	end

	return vector(0,0,0)
end

function local_class:renew_target()
	local class_character_table = {
		[CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionClass.Dealer] = {},
		[CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionClass.Tanker] = {},
		[CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionClass.Healer] = {},
	}
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if not user_party[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			table.insert(class_character_table[user_party[i].CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CoopExpeditionClass], user_party[i])
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.coop_class_priority do
		local current_class_table = class_character_table[self.coop_class_priority[i]]
		if #current_class_table ~= 0 then
			self.target =  self:get_most_aggro_target(current_class_table)
			return
		end
	end

	self.target = user_party[random_util.get_random_int(0, user_party.Count - 1)]
end

function local_class:get_most_aggro_target(characters)
	local max = -1
	local target = characters[random_util.get_random_int(1, #characters)]
	for i = 1, #characters do
		if self.aggro_table[characters[i]] ~= nil and self.aggro_table[characters[i]] > max then
			max = self.aggro_table[characters[i]]
			target = characters[i]
		end
	end

	return target
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self:renew_target()
	self:update_attack(dt)

	if self.in_parked_delay then
		self.delay_time_passed = self.delay_time_passed + dt
		if self.delay_time_passed > self.delay_time then
			self.in_parked_delay = false
		end

		return
	end

	if not self.boss_pattern
			and not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.battle_action)
			and not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.parked_battle_action) then
		self.cool_time_passed = self.cool_time_passed + dt
		if self.cool_time_passed > self.cool_time then
			self.cool_time_passed = 0

			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character,
					self.is_parked
							and self.parked_battle_action
							or self.battle_action)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack(dt)
	self.normal_attack_time_passed = self.normal_attack_time_passed + dt
	if self.normal_attack_time_passed > self.normal_attack_cool_time
			and self.target ~= nil
			and vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.target.Position) < self.normal_attack_distance
			and not self.is_parked then

		self.normal_attack_time_passed = 0

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = self.target
		damage_info.modifier = self.modifier
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Info.target) then
		if self.aggro_table[e.Info.sender] == nil then
			self.aggro_table[e.Info.sender] = e.Info:GetTotalDamage()
		else
			self.aggro_table[e.Info.sender] = self.aggro_table[e.Info.sender] + e.Info:GetTotalDamage()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("CoopMinotaursNewBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 6.0)
	self.rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RestTime", 1.0)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션
	self.slash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "MinotaursSlash")
	self.charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "MinotaursCharge")
	self.fireball_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "MinotaursFireballSlash")

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0

	-- 스테이트 변경
	if is_unity_null(self.target) then
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	else
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.slash_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
	self.fireball_action = nil
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

-- 타겟 전환
function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

-- 배틀액션 선택 및 타겟 변경
function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if self.battle_action_count == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.fireball_action
	elseif self.battle_action_count == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
	elseif self.battle_action_count == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
	else
		local r = random_util.get_random_int(0, 2)

		if r == 1 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.fireball_action
		elseif r == 2 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		end
	end

	self:change_target()
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("ExpeditionBrutalCandidateBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.rest_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RestDuration', 0.5)
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FollowTime', 5)

	self.state = {
		rest = 1,
		follow = 2,
		battle = 3,
	}
	self.current_state = self.state.rest
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 액션 데이터
	self.stomp_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BrutalStomp")
	self.rush_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BrutalRush")

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_index = 0

	self.battle_action_index_map = {
		[1] = self.stomp_action,
		[2] = self.rush_action,
		[3] = self.rush_action,
		[4] = self.stomp_action,
	}

	self.rush_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position))
	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	self:change_state(self.state.rest)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(nil)

	self.stomp_action = nil
	self.rush_action = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_index = nil
	self.battle_action_index_map = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action()
	self.battle_action_index = self.battle_action_index % 4 + 1
	self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_action_index_map[self.battle_action_index]
	self:change_target_with_picked_action()
end

function local_class:change_target_with_picked_action()
	if self.picked_battle_action == self.rush_action then
		return CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state)
	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.stomp_action then
		return CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)
	end
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if not can_control then
		return
	end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then
		if self.time_passed > self.rest_duration then
			self:pick_battle_action()

			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) then
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action)
				self:change_state(self.state.battle)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.follow)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.follow then
		if self.time_passed > self.max_follow_time then
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				self:change_state(self.state.battle)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.rest)
			end
		else
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) then
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action)
				self:change_state(self.state.battle)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil or not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self:change_state(self.state.rest)
		end
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('ExpeditionIceSpiritBattleAIState')

--[[
원정대 시즌3 얼음정령 용 AI
]]

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c

	self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.move_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MoveDuration', 2)
	self.action_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'BattleActionName')

	self.waypoints = c.FieldObjectController.Waypoints
	self.waypoint_index = 0
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션 데이터 가져오기
	self.battle_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self.action_name)

	-- 초기화
	self.reserve_trigger_action = false
	self.waypoint_index = 0
	self.displacement = self.waypoints[0] - self.character.Position
	self.speed = self.displacement.magnitude / self.move_duration

	-- 여기서 이동 제어할 것이므로 C# 스테이트는 idle
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.battle_action = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.reserve_trigger_action == true then
		-- hittable 체크 안함
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.battle_action) then
			self.reserve_trigger_action = false
		end
	else
		self:update_waypoint_move(dt)
	end
end

-- 웨이포인트 이동 업데이트 처리
function local_class:update_waypoint_move(dt)
	-- 배틀 액션이 행동 제어를 하고 있는 경우 이동 처리 안함
	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanControlCharacter(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return
	end

	if self.routine_ended then
		return
	end

	local need_move_dist = self.speed * dt
	local cur_pos = self.character.Position
	local target_pos = self.waypoints[self.waypoint_index]

	local diff = (target_pos - cur_pos):GetX0z()
	local dest_diff = diff.magnitude
	local move_pos = unity_class.vector3.MoveTowards(cur_pos, target_pos, need_move_dist)

	-- 웨이포인트 도착하면 배틀액션 시전
	if need_move_dist >= dest_diff then
		-- 다음 프레임 배틀액션 예약
		self.reserve_trigger_action = true
		self.battle_action.MetaTable:set_attack_range(self.displacement)
		-- 웨이포인트 순환이동
		if self.waypoint_index + 1 < self.waypoints.Count then
			self.waypoint_index = self.waypoint_index + 1
			self.displacement = (self.waypoints[self.waypoint_index] - self.character.Position:GetX0z())
			self.speed = (self.waypoints[self.waypoint_index] - self.character.Position:GetX0z()).magnitude / self.move_duration
		else
			self.routine_ended = true
		end
	end

	local move_diff = (move_pos - self.character.Position):GetX0z()
	local dest_amount = move_diff.magnitude
	local dir = move_diff.normalized

	if dir ~= unity_class.vector3.zero then
		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = dir
		move_info.magnitude = dest_amount
		move_info.types = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope

		-- 캐릭터에게 이동 이벤트를 보냄
		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, dir:ToDirection(), false)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

	self.meteor_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "TargetingTargetRange:LeftAlone")

	self.meteor_hp_ratio = {
		[1] = 0.75,
		[2] = 0.5,
		[3] = 0.25,
		[4] = -1
	}
	self.current_hp_ratio_idx = 1
	self.meteor_reserved = false

	local stone_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'LeftAloneStoneFall')
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	stone_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.rush_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, stone_action)

	self.on_damage = function(e)
		if e.Info.target == self.character and e.Info.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.meteor_hp_ratio[self.current_hp_ratio_idx] then

			self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,

	self.battle_action_triggered = false

		[3] = self.enhanced_arrow_action,
		[4] = self.shield_shove_action,
	}

	self.battle_action_index_map_second = {
		[1] = self.stomp_action,
		[2] = self.enhanced_arrow_action,
		[3] = self.rush_action,
		[4] = self.shield_shove_action,

		if self.meteor_reserved then
			self.meteor_reserved = false
			self.picked_battle_action = self.meteor_action
			self:change_target_with_picked_action()
			return
		end
		self.battle_action_index = self.battle_action_index % #self.current_battle_action_map + 1
		self.picked_battle_action = self.current_battle_action_map[self.battle_action_index]

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then
		if self.time_passed > self.rest_duration then
			self:pick_battle_action()

			if self.time_passed > self.rest_duration + self.limit_time or CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) then
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action)
				if self.picked_battle_action ~= self.meteor_action then
					self.last_action = self.picked_battle_action
				end
				self:change_state(self.state.battle)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil or not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self:change_state(self.state.rest)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then
		for i = 1, #self.short_range_attack do
			if self.short_range_attack[i] ==
					self.current_battle_action_map[self.battle_action_index % #self.current_battle_action_map + 1] then
				self.cs_state:ChangeState((CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false)))
				return
			end
		end
		self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
				random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {

		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
