local local_class = newclass('ExpeditionS4BossBattleEvaBattleAIState')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	-- Action Spec
	self.max_action_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxActionRestTime', 2)
	self.min_action_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MinActionRestTime', 1)
	self.charge_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeTime', 3)
	self.min_leader_dist = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MinLeaderDist', 2)
	self.max_leader_dist = math.max(CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxLeaderDist', 6), self.min_leader_dist)
	self.min_boss_dist = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MinBossDist', 4)
	self.max_boss_dist = math.max(CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxBossDist', 7), self.min_boss_dist)
	self.move_away_cool_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MoveAwayCoolTime', 1)

	-- Circling Spec
	self.circling_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingRadius', 5)
	self.circling_change_direction = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingChangeDirection', true)
	self.circling_change_direction_period = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingChangeDirectionPeriod', 3.0)
	self.is_dash_circling = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsDashCircling', false)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingSpeed', 1)
	self.circling_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingTime', 3)

	self.on_custom_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_event_func)

	self.leader_dist = {
		normal = 0,
		close = 1,
		far = 2,
	}

	self.move_state = {
		none = 0,
		toward = 1,
		away = 2,
		away_boss = 3,
		toward_boss = 4,
		circling = 5
	}
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_activate = false

	if self.action_triggered then
		self.is_persistent = false
		self.action_triggered = false
		self.picked_battle_action = self.trigger_action
	else
		self.is_persistent = true
		self.picked_battle_action = self.persistent_action
	end

	self:change_target(self.picked_battle_action)
end

function local_class:change_target(picked_battle_action)
	if picked_battle_action == nil then
		return
	end

	local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchClosestTarget(self.cs_state)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
		return
	end

	if new_target ~= nil then
		self.target = new_target

		local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
		command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	local battle = battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.character)
	local bosses = stage:GetBossCharacters()
	for i = 0, bosses.Count - 1 do
		if battle:IsInBattle(bosses[i]) then
			local zone_name = bosses[i].FieldObjectController.Zone
			self.zone_bound = field:GetZone(zone_name).Bounds
			self.boss = bosses[i]
			break
		end
	end
	if not self.zone_bound then
		self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	end

	local actions = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions

	local trigger_type = typeof(CS.Oak.ITriggerBattleAction)
	local persistent_type = typeof(CS.Oak.IPersistentBattleAction)

	for i = 0, actions.Count - 1 do
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(actions[i], trigger_type) then
			self.trigger_action = actions[i]
		elseif CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(actions[i], persistent_type) then
			self.persistent_action = actions[i]
		end
	end
	self.trigger_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.move_away_wait = 0
	self:change_state_to_circling()
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.character.CharacterBehaviour:EndBattleAction(self.persistent_action)
	self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.is_persistent = nil

	self.time_passed = nil
	self.action_rest_time = nil

	self.trigger_action = nil
	self.persistent_action = nil
	self:change_state(nil)
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'expedition_s4_shield_on' then
			local duration = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.trigger_action) then
				self.trigger_action.MetaTable:prolong_action(duration)
			else
				self.action_triggered = true
				self.character.CharacterBehaviour:EndBattleAction(self.persistent_action)
				self.picked_battle_action = nil

				self.trigger_action.MetaTable:set_action_duration(duration)
				if self.current_moving_state == self.move_state.away_boss or self.current_moving_state == self.move_state.toward_boss then
					local target_pos = self.cs_state.CurrentState.Destination
					self.trigger_action.MetaTable:set_move_destination(target_pos)
				else
					local boss_dist = self:get_distance_to_boss()
					if boss_dist then
						local dir = (self.character.Position - self.boss.Position):GetX0z().normalized
						if boss_dist < self.min_boss_dist then
							local target_pos = self.boss.Position + dir * self.min_boss_dist
							self.trigger_action.MetaTable:set_move_destination(target_pos)
						elseif boss_dist > self.max_boss_dist then
							local target_pos = self.boss.Position + dir * self.max_boss_dist
							self.trigger_action.MetaTable:set_move_destination(target_pos)
						end
					end
				end
				self:change_state_to_circling()
			end
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'expedition_s4_shield_off' then
			self.action_triggered = false
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.trigger_action) then
				self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
			end
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self:change_state_to_threaten()
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then -- TODO: 길막 문제 해결 필요
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIMovePositionSubState)) then
			self:change_state_to_threaten()
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_state_to_circling()
	self.current_moving_state = self.move_state.circling
	local is_circling_clock_wise = random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5 and true or false
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_radius,
			is_circling_clock_wise, self.circling_change_direction,
			self.circling_change_direction_period, self.is_dash_circling, self.circling_speed_factor))
end

function local_class:change_state_to_threaten()
	self.action_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_action_rest_time, self.max_action_rest_time)
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIThreatenSubState.Create(self.cs_state))
end

function local_class:change_state_to_move(move_state)
	self.current_moving_state = move_state
	local destination
	if self.current_moving_state == self.move_state.toward then
		destination = CS.Oak.PartyManager.Instance[0].Leader.Position
	elseif self.current_moving_state == self.move_state.away then
		local leader_pos = CS.Oak.PartyManager.Instance[0].Leader.Position
		local r1 = self.min_leader_dist + 1
		if self.boss then
			local leader_target_diff = self.boss.Position - leader_pos
			local leader_target_dist = leader_target_diff.magnitude

			local r2 = self.max_boss_dist

			if leader_target_dist > r1 + r2 then
				destination = leader_pos + leader_target_diff.normalized * r1
			elseif leader_target_dist < r2 - r1 then
				destination = leader_pos - leader_target_diff.normalized * r1
			else
				-- 두 원의 교점 중 선택
				local a = leader_target_diff.x
				local b = leader_target_diff.z
				local c = 0.5 * (- a * a - b * b + r2 * r2 - r1 * r1)

				local sqrt = math.sqrt(a*a*c*c - (b*b + a*a)*(c*c - r1*r1*b*b))
				local x_1 = (-a*c + sqrt) / (b*b + a*a)
				local x_2 = (-a*c - sqrt) / (b*b + a*a)

				local z_1 = (-a*x_1 - c) / b
				local z_2 = (-a*x_2 - c) / b

				local i_1 = unity_class.vector3(x_1, 0, z_1) + leader_pos
				local i_2 = unity_class.vector3(x_2, 0, z_2) + leader_pos

				local current_pos = self.character.Position
				if (i_1 - current_pos).magnitude >= (i_2 - current_pos).magnitude then
					destination = i_2
				else
					destination = i_1
				end

				local dest_bound = unity_class.bounds(destination, self.character.Bounds.size)
				if not CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.zone_bound, dest_bound) then
					destination = destination == i_1 and i_2 or i_1
				end
			end
		else
			local diff = leader_pos - self.character.Position
			destination = leader_pos + diff.normalized * r1
		end

		local dest_bound = unity_class.bounds(destination, self.character.Bounds.size)
		if not CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.zone_bound, dest_bound) then
			destination = leader_pos + (self.zone_bound.center - leader_pos).normalized * r1
		end
	elseif self.current_moving_state == self.move_state.away_boss then
		destination = self.boss.Position + (self.character.Position - self.boss.Position):GetX0z().normalized * (self.min_boss_dist + 1)

		local dest_bound = unity_class.bounds(destination, self.character.Bounds.size)
		if not CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.zone_bound, dest_bound) then
			self:change_state_to_move(self.move_state.toward)
			return
		end
	elseif self.current_moving_state == self.move_state.toward_boss then
		local rand_num = random_util.get_random_value()
		destination = self.boss.Position + (self.character.Position - self.boss.Position):GetX0z().normalized
				* (self.min_boss_dist * rand_num + self.max_boss_dist * (1 - rand_num))
	end
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIMovePositionSubState.Create(self.cs_state, destination, false, true))
end

function local_class:leader_dist_state()
	local dist = self:get_distance_to_leader()
	if dist > self.max_leader_dist then
		return self.leader_dist.far
	elseif dist < self.min_leader_dist then
		return self.leader_dist.close
	else
		return self.leader_dist.normal
	end
	return
end

function local_class:get_distance_to_leader()
	local leader_pos = CS.Oak.PartyManager.Instance[0].Leader.Position
	return (leader_pos - self.character.Position).magnitude
end

function local_class:get_distance_to_boss()
	if self.boss == nil then
		return
	end

	return (self.boss.Position - self.character.Position):GetX0z().magnitude
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.move_away_wait > 0 then
		self.move_away_wait = self.move_away_wait - dt
	end

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	-- Threaten, Move, 일정시간동안 대기
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIThreatenSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed > self.action_rest_time then
			self:change_state_to_circling()
		else
			local leader_dist = self:leader_dist_state()
			if leader_dist == self.leader_dist.far then
				self:change_state_to_move(self.move_state.toward)
				return
			elseif leader_dist == self.leader_dist.close and self.move_away_wait <= 0 then
				self.move_away_wait = self.move_away_cool_time
				self:change_state_to_move(self.move_state.away)
				return
			end

			local boss_dist = self:get_distance_to_boss()
			if not boss_dist then
				return
			end
			if boss_dist < self.min_boss_dist then
				self:change_state_to_move(self.move_state.away_boss)
				return
			elseif boss_dist > self.max_boss_dist then
				self:change_state_to_move(self.move_state.toward_boss)
				return
			end
		end

		return
	elseif CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIMovePositionSubState)) then
		local leader_pos = CS.Oak.PartyManager.Instance[0].Leader.Position
		local leader_dist = (leader_pos - self.character.Position).magnitude
		if self.cs_state.CurrentState.Done then
			self:change_state_to_circling()
		else
			if self.current_moving_state == self.move_state.toward then
				if leader_dist <= self.min_leader_dist then
					self:change_state_to_circling()
				else
					local target_pos = self.cs_state.CurrentState.Destination
					local current_diff = leader_pos - self.character.Position
					local current_dir = current_diff.normalized
					local target_diff = target_pos - self.character.Position
					local target_dir = target_diff.normalized
					local theta = math.acos(math.min(1, math.max(-1, vector_util.dot(current_dir, target_dir))))
					if theta > math.pi * 0.25 then
						self:change_state_to_move(self.move_state.toward)
					end
				end
			elseif self.current_moving_state == self.move_state.away and leader_dist >= self.min_leader_dist + 0.5 then
				self:change_state_to_circling()
			elseif self.current_moving_state == self.move_state.away_boss
					and self:get_distance_to_boss() >= self.min_boss_dist * 0.5 + self.max_boss_dist * 0.5 then
				self:change_state_to_circling()
			elseif self.current_moving_state == self.move_state.toward_boss then
				local boss_dist = self:get_distance_to_boss()
				if boss_dist <= self.min_boss_dist * 0.8 + self.max_boss_dist * 0.2 then
					self:change_state_to_circling()
				end
			end
		end
		return
	end

	-- Circling, 배틀액션은 이 시점에서 사용시도
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		end

		if self.battle_action_activate then
			if self:end_battle_action() then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self:change_state_to_threaten()
			end
		else
			if self:begin_battle_action() then
				self.battle_action_activate = true
				self.time_passed = 0
			elseif self.time_passed > self.circling_time then
				self.character.CharacterBehaviour:EndBattleAction(self.picked_battle_action)
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self:change_state_to_threaten()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:begin_battle_action()
	if self.is_persistent then
		-- 공격 가능한지 체크 후 지속형 배틀액션 시작
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.persistent_action, self.target)
				and not CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.IsProjectileBlockedBetween(self.character, self.target, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) then
			self.character.CharacterBehaviour:BeginBattleAction(self.persistent_action)
			return true
		end
	else
		-- 공격 가능한지 체크 후 배틀액션 실행
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:end_battle_action()
	if self.is_persistent then
		-- 지속형 배틀액션 유지시간이 지난경우 액션 종료 및 선택된 액션 초기화, 에바 평타가 attacking 인데 IsActive가 false인 경우가 있음
		if self.time_passed > self.charge_time or (self:leader_dist_state() ~= self.leader_dist.normal and self.move_away_wait <= 0) then
			self.character.CharacterBehaviour:EndBattleAction(self.persistent_action)
			return true
		end
	else
		-- 배틀액션이 끝났으면 선택된 액션 초기화
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_event_func)
	self.on_custom_event_func = nil

	-- Action Spec 해제
	self.max_action_rest_time = nil
	self.min_action_rest_time = nil
	self.max_target_distance = nil
	self.charge_time = nil

	-- Circling Spec 해제
	self.circling_radius = nil
	self.circling_change_direction = nil
	self.circling_change_direction_period = nil
	self.is_dash_circling = nil
	self.circling_speed_factor = nil
	self.circling_time = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
	self.boss = nil

	self.leader_dist = nil
	self.move_state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('ExpeditionSpiderTurretBattleAIState')

--[[
원정대 시즌2 거미터렛 용 AI
웨이포인트 간 이동 하면서 각 위치에 도달할 때 마다 배틀 액션 사용 후 다시 이동을 반복
* 최초 시작 지점에서 웨이포인트 까지의 거리를 유지하며 이동
]]

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.waypoints = c.FieldObjectController.Waypoints
	-- 0번은 offset 계산용 기준점 (스폰포인트) 이므로 1번이 첫 목적지
	self.waypoint_index = 1

	-- 파라미터 스펙 로드
	--self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FollowTime', 6.0)
	--self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MinRestTime', 1.0)
	--self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxRestTime', 1.5)

	self.action_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'BattleActionName')
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션 데이터 가져오기
	self.battle_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, self.action_name)

	-- 시작 위치 / 첫 포인트 오프셋 잡기
	self.waypoint_offset = self.character.Position:GetX0z() - self.waypoints[0]:GetX0z()

	-- 초기화
	self.reserve_trigger_action = false
	self.waypoint_index = 1

	-- 여기서 이동 제어할 것이므로 C# 스테이트는 idle
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.battle_action = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.reserve_trigger_action == true then
		-- hittable 체크 안함
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.battle_action) then
			self.reserve_trigger_action = false
		else
			-- 트리거 실패시 타겟 바꿔봄
			self:change_target()
		end
	else
		self:update_waypoint_move(dt)
	end
end

-- 웨이포인트 이동 업데이트 처리
function local_class:update_waypoint_move(dt)
	-- 배틀 액션이 행동 제어를 하고 있는 경우 이동 처리 안함
	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanControlCharacter(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return
	end


	local need_move_dist = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.WalkSpeed * dt
	local cur_pos = self.character.Position
	local target_pos = self.waypoints[self.waypoint_index] + self.waypoint_offset

	local diff = (target_pos - cur_pos):GetX0z()
	local dest_diff = diff.magnitude
	local move_pos = unity_class.vector3.MoveTowards(cur_pos, target_pos, need_move_dist)

	-- 웨이포인트 도착하면 배틀액션 시전
	if need_move_dist >= dest_diff then
		-- 다음 프레임 배틀액션 예약
		self.reserve_trigger_action = true

		-- 타겟 한번 갱신해 줌
		-- 매뉴얼일 필요는 없다? CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state)
		self:change_target()

		-- 웨이포인트 순환이동
		if self.waypoint_index + 1 < self.waypoints.Count then
			self.waypoint_index = self.waypoint_index + 1
		else
			self.waypoint_index = 0
		end
	end

	local move_diff = (move_pos - self.character.Position):GetX0z()
	local dest_amount = move_diff.magnitude
	local dir = move_diff.normalized

	if dir ~= unity_class.vector3.zero then
		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = dir
		move_info.magnitude = dest_amount
		move_info.types = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope

		-- 캐릭터에게 이동 이벤트를 보냄
		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, dir:ToDirection(), false)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
	end
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.waypoints = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

--360/N 각도를 무작위로 얻어 distance 만큼 떨어진 위치를 얻는다.

function local_class:select_next_destination()
    local destination = self:get_random_position(self.jump_distance, self.jump_direction_count)

    return destination
end

function local_class:get_random_position(jump_distance, count)
    if self.zone_bound == nil then
        return self.character.Position
    end

    if self.target ~= nil then
        local target_distance = vector_util.distance(self.target.Position, self.character.Position)

        if target_distance < self.keep_distance then
            --Runaway Shooter에서 백스텝 방향 결정 일부 발췌
            -- 거리 유지 범위 안이라면 백스탭을 밟는다.
            local runaway_angle = self.runaway_angle / 2
            local angle = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(runaway_angle * -1, runaway_angle)
            local runaway_direction = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, vector_util.up) * (self.character.Position - self.target.Position):GetX0z().normalized
            local destination = self.character.Position + runaway_direction * jump_distance

            return destination
        end
    end
    --아니라면 무작위로 뛴다.


    local candidate_pos_list = pattern_util.vertexes_on_circle(self.character.Position, jump_distance, count, 0)

    for index = #candidate_pos_list, 1, -1 do
        if self.zone_bound:Contains(candidate_pos_list[index]) == false then
            table.remove(candidate_pos_list, index)

            --이동중 벽과 충돌이 예상된다면 제거
        elseif CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.IsMovementBlockedBetween(self.character, self.character.Position, candidate_pos_list[index], CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == true then
            table.remove(candidate_pos_list, index)

        elseif self.last_move_point ~= nil then
            local distance = vector_util.distance(candidate_pos_list[index], self.last_move_point)
            if distance < 0.1 then
                table.remove(candidate_pos_list, index)
            end
        end
    end

    --하나도 없다면 마지막으로 이동했던 위치로 이동
    if #candidate_pos_list <= 0 then
        table.insert(candidate_pos_list, self.last_move_point)
    end

    local random_range = #candidate_pos_list
    local index = random_util.get_random_int(1, random_range)
    self.last_move_point = candidate_pos_list[index]
    return candidate_pos_list[index]
end

function local_class:on_fusion_event(e)
    if self.character.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
        return false
    end

end

        return false
    end

    if self.reserve_starter == nil then
        return false
    end

    if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.reserve_starter) then
        self.reserve_starter = nil
        -- DEBUG
        self:detach_count_ui()

        --키 몬스터가 죽었다. 다시 점유 가능하다는 것을 주변에 broadcast 한다.
        if self.reserve_starter == nil then
            message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEvent.Create(
                    self.character,
                    CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEventType.ResourceMove))
        end

        return false
        --message_system:Send(self.character.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.ActionStateChangeEvent.Create(nil))
    end
end

function local_class:on_fusion_event(e)
    if self.character.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
        return false
    end

    -- 보낸 사람이 나거나 없다면 취소
    if e.Sender == nil or e.Sender == self.character then
        return false
    end


    --합체 요청이 온경우
    if e.Type == CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEventType.Success then
        if self.reserve_starter ~= nil and e.Sender == self.reserve_starter then
            self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
            self:remove_invincible()

            self:kill_self()
        end

    -- 합체 실패로 자유의 몸이 되었을때.
    elseif e.Type == CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEventType.ReserveCancelRequest then
        if self.reserve_starter ~= nil and e.Sender == self.reserve_starter then
            self.reserve_starter = nil        --키 몬스터가 죽었다. 다시 점유 가능하다는 것을 주변에 broadcast 한다.
            self:detach_count_ui()

            message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEvent.Create(
                    self.character,
                    CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEventType.ResourceMove))

            self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

        end
    end
end

--endregion

function local_class:kill_self()
    if lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) == false then
        return
    end

    self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.Disappear

    self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
    local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
    damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
    damage_info.sender = self.character
    damage_info.target = self.character
    damage_info.damage = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
    command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

    self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
end

--region Util

--360/N 각도를 무작위로 얻어 distance 만큼 떨어진 위치를 얻는다.
function local_class:get_random_position(jump_distance, count)
    if self.zone_bound == nil then
        return self.character.Position
    end

    if self.target ~= nil then
        local target_distance = vector_util.distance(self.target.Position, self.character.Position)

        if target_distance < self.keep_distance then    --Runaway Shooter에서 백스텝 방향 결정 일부 발췌
            -- 거리 유지 범위 안이라면 백스탭을 밟는다.
            local runaway_angle= self.runaway_angle / 2
            local angle = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(runaway_angle * -1, runaway_angle)
            local runaway_direction = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, vector_util.up) * (self.character.Position - self.target.Position):GetX0z().normalized
            local destination = self.character.Position + runaway_direction * jump_distance

            return destination
        end
    end
    --아니라면 무작위로 뛴다.


    local candidate_pos_list = pattern_util.vertexes_on_circle(self.character.Position, jump_distance, count, 0)

    for index = #candidate_pos_list, 1, -1 do
        if self.zone_bound:Contains(candidate_pos_list[index]) == false then
            table.remove(candidate_pos_list, index)

            --이동중 벽과 충돌이 예상된다면 제거
        elseif CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.IsMovementBlockedBetween(self.character, self.character.Position, candidate_pos_list[index], CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == true then
            table.remove(candidate_pos_list, index)

        elseif self.last_move_point ~= nil then
            local distance = vector_util.distance(candidate_pos_list[index], self.last_move_point)
            if distance < 0.1 then
                table.remove(candidate_pos_list, index)
            end
        end
    end

    --하나도 없다면 마지막으로 이동했던 위치로 이동
    if #candidate_pos_list <= 0 then
        table.insert(candidate_pos_list, self.last_move_point)
    end

    local random_range = #candidate_pos_list
    local index = random_util.get_random_int(1, random_range)
    self.last_move_point = candidate_pos_list[index]
    return candidate_pos_list[index]
end

-- ☆☆☆☆☆☆ 무적 처리
function local_class:set_invincible()
    if self.character.DamagedBehaviour ~= CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance then
        self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
    end
end
function local_class:remove_invincible()
    -- 아닌 경우에만 할당한다
    if self.character.DamagedBehaviour ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) == false then
        self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create();
    end
end

--endregion

-- DEBUG
-- 카운트 UI 시작하기 위해 붙임
function local_class:attach_count_ui(count)
    if self.show_debug_mode == false then
        return
    end

    -- FIXME: 2.10에 X축 0 -> 0.25로 변경
    local target = self.character
    local offset = vector(0, target.Bounds.size.y + 2, -0.5)
    self.count_ui = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIDuelBuffState'):Instantiate(target.Position + offset,
            unity_class.quaternion.identity, target.Transform)

    self.count_ui.transform:Find('Offset').gameObject:SetActive(false)

    self.tmp = self.count_ui.transform:Find('BuffCountText'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.TMPro.TextMeshPro))
    self.tmp.text = count
    self.tmp.color = unity_class.color.white
end
-- DEBUG
function local_class:detach_count_ui()
    if self.show_debug_mode == false then
        return
    end

    if self.count_ui ~= nil then
        self.count_ui.transform:Find('Offset').gameObject:SetActive(true)
        self.count_ui:Dispose()
        self.count_ui = nil
    end
end
-- DEBUG
-- 카운트 UI 갱신
function local_class:update_count_ui(value)
    if self.show_debug_mode == false then
        return
    end

    self.tmp.text = value
end


function local_class:exit()
    self:change_state(self.state.none)
    self.time_passed = 0

    -- 죽었을 때 점유중인 본래 몬스터에게 메세지 보낸다.
    if self.reserve_starter ~= nil then
        message_system:SendSync(self.reserve_starter,
                CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEvent.Create(
                        self.character,
                        CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEventType.ResourceDead
                ))
    end
end

function local_class:dispose()
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEvent))

    self.cs_state = nil
    self.character = nil
    self.target = nil

    self.anim_idle = nil
    self.anim_jump = nil
    self.anim_prepare = nil
    self.battle_action = nil
    self.battle_action_name = nil

    self.jump_destination_pos = nil
    self.jump_direction = nil

    self.last_move_point = nil

    self.state = nil
    self.zone_bound = nil
    self.reserve_starter = nil
end

return {
    create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
        return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
    end,
}
